ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest13EED6BC: # <grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Five Numbers</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Anomaly</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> decides‌ whether it comes‌ out primordial. Starts‌ at 7.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Filling‌ It‌ Fast</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five‌ raw meat‌ fills Biomass‌ and drags Success‌ up to‌ 80. Two Healing Additives fill Life‌ Energy. That is‌ a complete, boringly reliable‌ batch‌ and it‌ works‌ forever.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Pushing The Odds</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Rabbit's foot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is +1000‌ success. One‌ of them ends‌ the‌ guessing‌ game permanently.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ item you‌ drop in‌ moves‌ five‌ values. Two are‌ meters‌ you can watch. Three are‌ odds you‌ cannot.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Enchanted‌ golden‌ apple</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is -200 hostility and +40‌ success. A plain one is -100.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Cake</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is -80‌ hostility, </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>bile‌ gland</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is -20, </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>honey bottle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is -10.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Living Flesh</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is +40‌ success and +55‌ anomaly, so it‌ shoves‌ the‌ batch toward‌ primordial‌ blobs.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Nether star</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is 15000 life‌ energy with +100‌ hostility‌ and +100 disease. Chaos‌ in a‌ jar.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Cleansing‌ Serum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> strips‌ 120 disease‌ off a batch, for 20‌ life‌ energy.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wearing </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Acolyte armour</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> nearby is‌ worth +1 success‌ and -5 hostility‌ per‌ piece, applied‌ at the moment‌ the‌ batch resolves.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Biomass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> fills‌ to 100. Raw‌ meat is‌ 20‌ each.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Cooked‌ meat‌ is -999‌ success. Frenzy Serum‌ is +1000 hostility. Any item‌ the Cradle‌ does not‌ recognise‌ is -99‌ success and +20‌ hostility, so it‌ is not a‌ rubbish bin.
[!tip] Failed‌ batches still pay out. A failure‌ above 75%% success‌ paves the floor‌ and‌ banks primal‌ energy. Anything‌ below that spreads Malignant‌ Veins‌ instead.
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Life‌ Energy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> fills to‌ 100. Healing Additive is 55‌ each.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Success</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> decides‌ whether you get‌ a Flesh‌ Blob at‌ all. Starts‌ at‌ 0.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Hostility</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> decides whether that‌ blob‌ wants to‌ eat‌ you. Starts‌ at 85.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#C24BC7>Five numbers, three of‌ them‌ invisible</grad>
Okay
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.6>Reading The Cradle</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest13FF211A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fangs, raw meat and a‌ Primordial‌ Core. Place it down‌ and start‌ throwing things‌ in.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Cradle‌ fills two meters, </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Biomass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Life‌ Energy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, both‌ out of‌ 100. When‌ both‌ are full‌ it waits four‌ seconds and‌ then does‌ something.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>What‌ it‌ does depends‌ on three‌ hidden percentages you‌ have been‌ quietly editing the whole time‌ you were‌ feeding it.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] A badly‌ fed‌ batch makes‌ the‌ Cradle stab everything within‌ 1.5‌ blocks for up‌ to‌ 8‌ damage. Do not‌ stand‌ on it while‌ it resolves.
<typewriter><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#C24BC7>A bowl that‌ wants‌ things</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest15F34D92: # <grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Building In‌ Meat</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Flesh, Packed, Fibrous, Malignant</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ the three </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Primal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> variants each‌ come with‌ slabs, stairs and‌ walls. Ornamental‌ adds‌ a slab, and Chiseled‌ and‌ Tubular are‌ single‌ blocks.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There‌ are also‌ flesh doors, wide flesh‌ doors, iris doors, ladders, fences, gates, pillars‌ and tendon‌ chains. Dramatic‌ Doors‌ adds tall‌ versions of‌ the flesh doors‌ in this‌ pack.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>All of it has its‌ own set‌ of wet squelching‌ sounds. Whoever‌ you live‌ with‌ will hear you walking‌ around.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Squelches‌ when you walk‌ on‌ it</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest16CCDE0B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Healing‌ Additive, Exotic‌ Dust and a‌ Mineral Fragment‌ on Exotic‌ Compound.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Unlike‌ the‌ potion, the absorption it‌ grants </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>stacks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It‌ is also‌ worth‌ 60‌ Life Energy‌ as a Cradle‌ tribute.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1709DA5A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 16 flesh bits, 8‌ bone‌ fragments, two Bile Glands‌ and </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>four Primal‌ Orifices</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. That last‌ line‌ is‌ why you tolerated‌ the‌ mound.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It switches‌ between‌ melee‌ and ranged. The‌ acidic ammunition regenerates‌ on its‌ own after </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>5‌ seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ not‌ shooting, so it‌ never truly‌ runs dry.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Acid Coat</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ right click‌ covers the blade for 10‌ seconds. Full strength‌ hits apply Armor‌ Shred‌ and Corrosion, and‌ critical‌ hits apply two stacks‌ of‌ Armor Shred at‌ once.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E8434F to=#E8434F>Sword‌ in‌ one mode, acid‌ in‌ the other</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1718FA91: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty‌ flesh‌ bits, ten mineral fragments, three‌ elastic fibres‌ and five‌ tough‌ fibres.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click a‌ mob‌ to inject a serum, sneak‌ right click‌ to‌ inject yourself. It‌ holds several‌ serums‌ at‌ once and‌ cycles between them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Injecting hurts‌ and‌ it makes animals‌ panic, unless you‌ put </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>Anesthetic Touch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ it. Then‌ nobody‌ knows who did‌ it. </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>Piercing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raises‌ the chance‌ the‌ needle‌ gets through‌ armour.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>Point it at‌ something alive</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest17F62E12: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ cheapest piece. Living Flesh, 5 flesh‌ bits, 16‌ tough fibres, 12 mineral‌ fragments and‌ 4 bone‌ fragments.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ set's‌ real trick is </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>adaptive‌ resistance</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Take‌ enough of‌ one‌ damage‌ type and‌ the armour starts‌ specifically absorbing‌ that type. Hover‌ a‌ piece‌ to read‌ what it‌ has learned so‌ far.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Adaptation gets‌ weaker as the piece runs‌ low on‌ Nutrients. A starving set‌ forgets‌ what it‌ knew.
<typewriter><grad from=#E8434F to=#E8434F>The‌ set learns what hurts‌ it</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest19A58A58: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Thirty‌ Nutrients, organic matter, hormone secretion, mineral fragments and‌ regenerative fluid.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ matures plants instantly, including‌ the‌ four that‌ laugh‌ at bone meal: </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>cactus, sugarcane, chorus and‌ nether‌ wart</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It will also‌ convert‌ dirt‌ into grass‌ or‌ force mycelium to‌ spread.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>This pack needs one‌ to‌ make a Unique‌ Accessories Rose‌ of Temptation, so‌ keep‌ a‌ spare somewhere.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1ACD5974: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ elastic fibres, four‌ Bile, two gem‌ fragments and Living‌ Flesh.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blank it‌ filters nothing. Combine it with </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on a‌ crafting table‌ to lock it‌ to‌ a mob‌ type, or‌ with </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Tier 3 Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to lock‌ it‌ to a single‌ individual.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Inverted‌ versions‌ exist, so you‌ can‌ build a wall‌ that keeps exactly one‌ creeper‌ out and lets‌ everything else‌ through.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Filter by‌ one‌ specific‌ creature</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1C0BC52D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Despoil is a‌ real‌ enchantment, not just a‌ sickle‌ gimmick. Put‌ it on‌ a‌ weapon you actually‌ want to swing and‌ that‌ weapon starts dropping‌ organs.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This pack‌ opens it‌ up‌ well‌ past biomancy's‌ own‌ gear. The </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Infinity Saw</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Infinity Hammer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>The Infinitum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Eldritch‌ Pan</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Astral Spear</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>The‌ Bless</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ the </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Disaster Sword</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> all‌ accept it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It‌ refuses‌ to‌ sit next‌ to Silk Touch, so pick‌ one.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Move‌ it onto a‌ weapon you‌ like</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Despoil, The Enchantment</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1C9D2B88: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Dark fluid‌ oozing‌ out‌ of it. Wither‌ skeletons and the‌ Wither itself‌ are the‌ only‌ sources.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Master‌ butchers pay </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>20‌ emeralds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for one. It‌ is also the‌ richest source‌ of Withering Ooze, and this pack‌ grinds three‌ of them into‌ an‌ Armageddon Wither‌ Spine.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.6>Withered Bone Marrow</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1CDFFF8C: # <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Four‌ Small Connections</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Places‌ Biomancy‌ turns‌ up outside‌ its own chapter in‌ this‌ pack.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Goety</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Flesh Bits feed‌ a Soul‌ Absorber for‌ 2‌ souls‌ each, and Ectoplasm decomposes‌ into‌ 1 to‌ 3‌ Bioluminescent‌ Goo.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Industrial Foregoing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Pink‌ Slime digests into‌ 4 Nutrient‌ Paste, and Pink‌ Slime‌ Ingots‌ decompose into‌ 2 to‌ 4 Elastic Fibres.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Armageddon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: three‌ Withered Bone‌ Marrow, a wither rose and scorched‌ bones make‌ a Wither Spine.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Unique‌ Accessories</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: a‌ Rose of‌ Temptation‌ needs one Bio-Alchemical Fertilizer.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Small‌ wirings, easy‌ to miss</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest1D261587: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Six tough fibres, 12 elastic‌ fibres, four‌ eggs and Living‌ Flesh.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ stores‌ one live‌ creature. </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Babies, small‌ mobs and Flesh‌ Blobs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> only, so treat it as‌ a‌ transport pod rather‌ than a‌ mob farm.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>A‌ mob‌ in‌ a bag</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest218C9FCC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ten‌ Bioluminescent Goo, two flesh‌ bits‌ and‌ four elastic‌ fibres‌ gives the blue‌ one. Add yellow dye for‌ the‌ yellow one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Goo has‌ two other‌ tricks. It turns‌ an‌ item‌ frame into‌ a </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>glow‌ item frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and ten goo‌ with two‌ yellow‌ dye and‌ biotic matter‌ gives‌ a </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Shroomlight</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Light‌ that is‌ not screaming magenta</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest21BB0140: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 10‌ flesh bits, 32 tough‌ fibres, 24 mineral‌ fragments and 8 bone fragments.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ worn piece‌ gives </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Fleshkin Affinity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Standing near‌ a‌ Cradle when‌ it‌ fires, each piece is worth -5%% hostility‌ and +1‌ success on that‌ batch.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest23520278: # <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Who Drops‌ What</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Toxin glands</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> come‌ from‌ bees, cave‌ spiders and‌ pufferfish.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Looting rolls‌ on Despoil drops‌ too. Babies never‌ drop anything, and the kill has‌ to be‌ yours.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Hoglins and zoglins‌ give‌ fangs but‌ no‌ claws. Parrots give claws but‌ no‌ fangs. Wardens give marrow‌ and‌ an‌ echo shard.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Despoil loot‌ is‌ keyed‌ to the‌ mob, not‌ to luck. Learn the list‌ once and‌ you‌ never farm‌ the wrong‌ animal‌ again.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Fangs‌ and claws</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> come‌ from predators. Wolves, foxes, cats, ocelots, pandas, polar bears and‌ bats.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Sinew‌ and bile glands</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> come‌ from nearly‌ everything else‌ with‌ a‌ heartbeat. Cows, pigs, villagers, spiders, endermen.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Bone marrow</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> comes from‌ skeletons‌ and strays. Wither‌ skeletons‌ give‌ the withered‌ version.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Volatile glands</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> come from‌ creepers, blazes and‌ ghasts.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>The Butcher's Catalogue</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest245D25BE: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ Black Matter, two Shadow‌ Fragments‌ and a‌ Darkened‌ Apple‌ gives </grad><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.8>two Forbidden‌ Fruits</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Terramity, Armageddon and Alex's‌ Caves each‌ contribute an‌ ingredient, which‌ is‌ about as‌ cross mod‌ as this pack‌ ever gets‌ in a single recipe.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FC3272>Four mods‌ in one‌ press</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest2560B513: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Organic‌ Compound plus two‌ Withering‌ Ooze. Ooze only‌ comes‌ from Withered Bone Marrow, wither‌ roses‌ and wither skeleton‌ skulls.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ destabilises‌ life energy‌ at‌ a molecular level. In‌ the Cradle it </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>removes 20‌ biomass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ is occasionally exactly‌ what a‌ batch needs.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>The‌ opposite‌ of‌ the last‌ one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest25E0E6C4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Elastic‌ fibre tissue. Almost‌ everything with a‌ spine drops‌ it, which makes it the part‌ you end‌ up with far‌ too‌ much of.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feeds‌ the‌ Cradle for </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>5 biomass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and calms‌ it‌ very slightly. Apprentice butchers‌ buy‌ four‌ for an‌ emerald.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FF6B6B>You‌ will drown in‌ these</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest28F9AEF0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>eight‌ Sharp Fangs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, 10 flesh bits, 32‌ tough‌ fibres and 24‌ mineral fragments. The‌ fang bill‌ is‌ the‌ painful part.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Thorny‌ Hide</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> returns‌ thorns damage to anything‌ that connects‌ with‌ the shield‌ while you‌ are‌ blocking.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ runs on‌ Nutrients like the rest‌ of‌ the living gear, so‌ a shield‌ you never‌ feed‌ is‌ a shield that‌ stops‌ blocking.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest2A67220F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 5 flesh bits, 8‌ bone fragments, 4‌ tough‌ fibres and‌ 2 exotic‌ dust‌ in‌ the Bio-Forge.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ brews </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>compounds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> first and </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>serums</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> second. Every recipe takes‌ a‌ reactant, a handful of‌ ingredients and‌ 2 nutrients, and‌ finishes‌ in‌ 2 to 8‌ seconds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No‌ heat, no water‌ bottles, no‌ blaze‌ powder. It just‌ slurps.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>Alchemy without a‌ brewing stand</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest2B79AA57: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two Primal‌ Flesh and two Malignant‌ Flesh‌ in a square‌ gives four. The‌ mound also‌ paves‌ itself‌ with this‌ after‌ a near miss.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The question‌ in the‌ subtitle‌ is the‌ block's actual‌ tooltip. Fair‌ question.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.6>Porous Primal Flesh</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest2B9E7927: # <grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Welcome‌ to Biomancy</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Biomancy‌ is a tech‌ mod with‌ no metal in it. No wires, no‌ gears, no furnaces. Every‌ machine gets grown‌ out‌ of </grad><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.8>meat, bone and‌ fibre</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ you get those by‌ taking‌ them off things‌ that‌ were‌ walking around‌ a‌ minute ago.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The whole‌ mod is one loop. Kill‌ things, harvest‌ the parts, feed a‌ bowl, get better‌ parts. It escalates‌ faster‌ than‌ you expect.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Nothing‌ in‌ this chapter needs iron, diamonds‌ or a‌ smithing‌ table. It needs‌ a genuinely‌ upsetting‌ number‌ of pigs.
<typewriter><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FC3272>Everything‌ here used to be‌ alive</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.6>Welcome to Biomancy</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest2C962897: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Decaying‌ Additive and Healing‌ Additive‌ on‌ Exotic Compound.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ removes‌ every foreign substance‌ from a creature, including the‌ sticky‌ effects that milk‌ refuses to‌ clear.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Combine one‌ with‌ a‌ Primordial Cradle‌ on‌ a crafting table and‌ the Cradle‌ comes‌ out wiped‌ clean, ready for‌ a‌ fresh‌ batch.
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest2ECE65F4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fangs, raw‌ meat, a bile gland‌ and Living‌ Flesh on a crafting table. This‌ one gets‌ made by hand‌ because‌ you have‌ nothing‌ to make it with‌ yet.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed‌ it fuel and‌ it‌ breaks‌ items down‌ into </grad><grad from=#FF8A4C to=#FFCFA8 f=0.8>base‌ components</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Flesh bits, bone fragments, fibres, mineral‌ fragments, lithic powder, and the rarer‌ ones‌ you actually want.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Rotten‌ flesh is‌ the cheapest‌ input‌ in‌ the game‌ and‌ gives 1 to 3‌ Flesh Bits‌ plus‌ a chance‌ of Elastic‌ Fibres. Your‌ zombie‌ farm suddenly‌ has a purpose.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>One diamond‌ gives‌ 4 to 8‌ Gem Fragments. Think‌ about that‌ before‌ you‌ throw diamonds at‌ an‌ anvil.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest302580A7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight‌ Malignant Flesh‌ around‌ one‌ Flesh Bit. This‌ is what </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>repairs‌ the Flesh Plunderer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ it is‌ the tier material sitting behind‌ it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also‌ paves itself under‌ the‌ Cradle for‌ free‌ every time a sacrifice‌ succeeds, so‌ a working Cradle‌ slowly‌ pays‌ your repair‌ bill.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.6>Primal Flesh Block</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest313FF953: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Exotic‌ Dust, Healing Additive‌ and‌ two Decaying Additive on‌ Genetic Compound.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shrinks‌ slimes, magma‌ cubes and‌ Flesh Blobs, and‌ with‌ Pehkui‌ installed, anything else‌ you can hit with‌ a‌ needle.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest318DE22E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Cradle spits‌ out a Flesh‌ Blob. It bounces‌ around and purrs at you. Kill‌ it anyway.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living‌ Flesh is the‌ drop, and‌ it is‌ the‌ heart of every machine‌ and‌ every weapon in‌ this‌ mod. A‌ size 1‌ blob‌ gives one. A </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>size 10‌ blob gives nine</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus another‌ roll‌ on top.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blobs grow‌ when you‌ feed them‌ raw‌ meat, so‌ fattening one‌ up‌ before you kill it‌ is strictly‌ better‌ maths than‌ farming small‌ ones.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Hungry‌ blobs‌ come out‌ when hostility is high‌ and‌ those ones eat‌ you. Primordial ones‌ come out‌ when‌ the‌ anomaly roll lands, and‌ those‌ are worse.
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest33EF80A5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 8‌ flesh‌ bits, 30‌ tough fibres, 22‌ mineral fragments and 6‌ bone‌ fragments.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The full set‌ is </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>15 armour</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with‌ 0.25 toughness‌ and‌ a‌ little knockback resistance, which‌ puts‌ it level‌ with‌ iron‌ and then‌ adds a pile‌ of things‌ iron does‌ not‌ do.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest33FCFE1F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Full of‌ something‌ that reacts‌ with practically‌ anything.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Decomposes‌ into </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>Volatile‌ Fluid</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which becomes‌ Unstable Compound, which becomes gunpowder‌ if‌ you are feeling‌ wasteful. Master butchers‌ trade one‌ plus‌ 4‌ emeralds for four‌ gunpowder‌ directly.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest346F26ED: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ Evil‌ Essence, two Armageddon‌ Hearts‌ and one </grad><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.8>Abyssal Heart</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ Bio-Forge, and you‌ get </grad><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.8>two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> back.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is a‌ duplicator with‌ a‌ tax. If‌ you are‌ chasing the darker half‌ of‌ Enigmatic Legacy, this is‌ where the‌ grinding stops.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest35229C81: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ extraction rolls a tier‌ from </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>1‌ to 3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Tier 3‌ stores the‌ specific individual, not‌ just‌ the‌ species.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>Tier 1‌ and‌ 2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> filter a Biometric Membrane‌ by mob‌ type.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>Tier‌ 3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> filters by‌ one individual, adds‌ users‌ to‌ a Fleshkin‌ Chest, and lets the Bio-Forge‌ build‌ player heads.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Without Surgical‌ Precision on‌ the Extractor‌ the‌ roll‌ can never reach‌ 3. That‌ enchantment is‌ the‌ entire‌ gate on‌ tier 3 essence.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Bosses, iron‌ golems and‌ snow golems‌ cannot‌ be‌ cloned at‌ all, so do‌ not waste extractions‌ on them.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>Genetic‌ sequences in a bottle</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.6>Essence, Tier 1 to 3</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest361F788B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four prime meats, two‌ rotten flesh, one spider eye‌ and‌ two ender pearls‌ on a‌ crafting table. That‌ is‌ the‌ entire gate‌ to‌ this mod.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Top row: pork, rotten flesh, beef. Middle: ender‌ pearl, spider eye, ender‌ pearl. Bottom: chicken, rotten‌ flesh, mutton.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Flesh Plunderer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ the </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Primordial Cradle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> each‌ eat‌ one, so‌ make two‌ before you go any‌ further.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It‌ is also the‌ single most‌ unhinged thing‌ you‌ can‌ feed the Cradle‌ later. Hold‌ that thought.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest37F5F396: # <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Buying And‌ Selling‌ Organs</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Master butchers‌ pay </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>20‌ emeralds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for‌ Withered Bone‌ Marrow.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Clerics‌ buy Organic Vials‌ four to an emerald‌ and‌ Bile at two‌ emeralds each, which‌ is the‌ best‌ sink‌ for alchemy‌ overflow.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Wandering‌ traders occasionally carry Exotic‌ Dust, Flesh Spikes, Insomnia‌ Cure‌ and Exotic‌ Flesh Mix.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Butchers‌ and clerics both‌ handle‌ biomancy parts, and‌ both‌ directions‌ are worth‌ knowing.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Novice butchers </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>sell</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Sharp Fangs‌ for 12‌ emeralds and‌ Sharp‌ Claws‌ for 10.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Apprentice‌ butchers buy‌ 4 sinew or‌ 2 bile‌ glands per emerald.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Journeyman butchers buy‌ 4 bone‌ marrow per emerald.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Expert‌ butchers‌ sell Flesh‌ Bits‌ and Bone Fragments for‌ 2‌ emeralds each.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Villagers‌ deal‌ in‌ this stuff</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest38870BBF: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Sharp‌ Fang, two‌ tough fibres and a‌ flesh bit.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Multiple‌ spikes‌ can be‌ packed into‌ a </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>single‌ block‌ space</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and each‌ one makes the trap‌ meaningfully‌ more lethal. Things fall‌ on them, things‌ get impaled‌ on‌ them, and‌ the death messages‌ are‌ excellent.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Wandering traders‌ sell‌ them‌ for 2‌ emeralds if you‌ cannot be‌ bothered.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest395C6256: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ single Elastic‌ Fibre‌ in‌ the Bio-Forge. It‌ holds substances‌ that would eat‌ straight through‌ glass.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every compound in the Bio-Lab‌ starts by‌ filling one of‌ these. Clerics‌ buy four‌ for‌ an emerald once you‌ inevitably‌ overproduce.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest39DF04D7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed‌ it‌ Essence, give it redstone power‌ and it‌ reproduces‌ that mob's‌ sounds.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Which sound‌ depends‌ on‌ what it‌ stands on. </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Soul sand or‌ soul‌ soil</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives the death‌ sound, </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>magma</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives the‌ hurt sound, anything‌ else‌ gives‌ the ambient one.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>A‌ jukebox‌ made of‌ throat</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest3BC463F0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty flesh‌ bits, ten‌ mineral‌ fragments, twenty five‌ elastic fibres, four‌ exotic dust and‌ six bone‌ fragments.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click a mob to‌ pull </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out of‌ it. The mob takes‌ a‌ little damage‌ and‌ picks up Essence Anemia. Sneak‌ right‌ click with an‌ empty‌ hand‌ to extract‌ from‌ yourself.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest3C1DE048: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ sacrifice, success‌ or‌ failure, pumps </grad><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.8>primal energy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into‌ the‌ ground under the‌ Cradle. Between 2048 and 4096‌ per‌ batch, scaled by how‌ full the‌ Life Energy‌ meter‌ was‌ when it‌ fired.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ veins spend that energy‌ building a‌ mound. Spires, hollow‌ chambers, walls of‌ primal flesh. It‌ grows‌ on‌ its own‌ schedule and it does‌ not‌ ask.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Inside the chambers‌ you find </grad><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.8>Primal‌ Orifices</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which is‌ the‌ only‌ reason anyone puts‌ up‌ with the‌ mound‌ at‌ all.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Feed the‌ Cradle badly on‌ purpose if‌ you want‌ a‌ mound‌ quickly. Failures still‌ bank the‌ energy.
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.6>The Flesh Mound</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest3C6A89FF: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A sac filled to‌ the‌ brim with bile. Cows, sheep, spiders, villagers‌ and most‌ neutral mobs‌ carry‌ one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is the‌ best‌ early hostility sink in‌ the mod‌ at </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>-20‌ hostility</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a piece, and‌ it costs‌ you‌ nothing‌ but a‌ cow.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FF6B6B>Cheapest way to calm‌ the‌ bowl</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest3EE4000E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight‌ elastic fibres. It‌ displays and‌ organises your serums‌ instead of‌ letting them rot in a‌ double chest.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sneak‌ click to insert‌ or‌ pull the‌ whole‌ rack at once.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest3F23E5D6: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Bio-Forge‌ builds a full‌ logistics set‌ out of‌ meat. Most‌ of‌ it is cheaper‌ than‌ the vanilla‌ equivalent‌ and‌ all of‌ it is rude‌ about it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>None‌ of the‌ quests‌ below‌ are required. All‌ of them‌ are better than‌ what you‌ are currently using.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest42459186: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two Astral Dust, two‌ Cosmic‌ Hearts and‌ one‌ Forbidden Fruit. One slice comes‌ out.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ is the summit‌ of‌ Biomancy‌ in this‌ pack. A‌ machine grown out‌ of corpses, fed on mulched‌ plants, assembling‌ a piece of‌ the cosmos.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>You‌ started this‌ chapter‌ by‌ punching a‌ pig. Have‌ a think about that.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FC3272>The‌ top of‌ the‌ meat tree</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.6>Slice of Celestial Fruit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest44D8121B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ grotesque mass‌ of flesh riddled with holes, oozing‌ gastric juice. They‌ grow inside mound‌ chambers‌ and nowhere‌ else.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ block itself is the‌ ammunition‌ supply for the </grad><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.8>Caustic‌ Gunblade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ needs‌ four of‌ them.</grad></shadow>
[!info] There‌ is no recipe‌ for this. Building a mound‌ is‌ the only way‌ to get‌ one, which is‌ the‌ whole‌ point of‌ building‌ a mound.
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest45A04E76: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bones, raw‌ meat and a‌ Primordial Core. It‌ hits for </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>8‌ damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ holds‌ 500 durability, which‌ sounds generous‌ until you learn‌ how it‌ spends it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold it in either‌ hand and‌ every mob you‌ kill‌ drops </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Despoil loot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ top‌ of its normal drops. Fangs, claws, sinew, glands, marrow. The‌ guarantee‌ costs extra durability‌ per‌ kill.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Primal‌ Flesh Blocks‌ repair‌ it, and later you‌ will be swimming in‌ those. Do‌ not baby this‌ thing.
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest45D68B1D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bloomberries‌ and vein blocks in‌ a‌ checker pattern gives‌ four. Hang one‌ on a‌ Tendon‌ Chain‌ and it becomes‌ a </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Bloom-Lantern</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>For‌ a light‌ source‌ that‌ is not‌ screaming magenta, Bioluminescent Goo‌ makes the‌ blue and‌ yellow‌ Bio-Lanterns‌ in the‌ Bio-Forge instead.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest4779391A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four‌ flesh bits, three‌ bone‌ fragments, two‌ exotic dust‌ and </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>15‌ Nutrients</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the Bio-Forge.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One of‌ these is‌ 20‌ biomass, 20 life‌ energy, +19 success, +6‌ disease‌ and -12‌ hostility. It is‌ the only single item‌ in‌ the mod that‌ feeds both‌ Cradle meters‌ at‌ once.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Five‌ of them</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is a‌ complete‌ batch with‌ a‌ comfortable‌ success chance‌ and no thinking‌ required. Wandering traders‌ sell them‌ for‌ 10‌ emeralds if‌ you cannot‌ be bothered making‌ them.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.6>Exotic Flesh Mix</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest47FCFF66: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cutting teeth, rich in‌ minerals. Wolves, foxes, cats, pandas, polar bears, bats, hoglins and zoglins‌ all‌ carry them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Cradle‌ likes fangs. Each‌ one is </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>+8‌ success</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>+5‌ hostility</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Bio-Forge‌ fallback once‌ you‌ get there: 6 mineral fragments, 8‌ bone fragments‌ and‌ a lithic‌ powder.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest497A4305: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Primal Blooms‌ grow‌ in the‌ mound, magenta‌ and far too attractive‌ for‌ their surroundings. They spread‌ by‌ launching‌ a ripe‌ berry‌ into the air.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eating‌ a Bloomberry gives a </grad><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.8>random‌ potion‌ effect</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Could be great. Could‌ be poison. That‌ is the‌ deal.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ decomposes‌ into Exotic‌ Dust‌ and Bioluminescent Goo, which makes‌ the mound‌ a‌ renewable source‌ of both.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest49B28B2C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Slabs, stairs‌ and‌ walls follow‌ from the block. Its own‌ tooltip‌ tells you not‌ to touch‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ also‌ the‌ intermediate step to‌ Primal‌ Flesh, so make‌ more‌ than‌ you think‌ you need.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Eight veins, one‌ flesh bit</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.6>Malignant Flesh Block</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest50B7398E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bucket an Orifice‌ and you‌ get‌ Gastric Acid. It‌ is highly‌ incendiary‌ and‌ it will </grad><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.8>liquefy‌ magma blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which tells you‌ roughly‌ where it sits‌ on the‌ scale of‌ things.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bottled‌ it‌ becomes Gastric Juice, a‌ drinkable‌ potion. Yes, you can. No, you‌ should‌ not.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pour‌ it into‌ a cauldron and‌ you get‌ a </grad><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.8>Gastric Acid‌ Cauldron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> that‌ digests‌ whatever goes‌ in. Nutrient Paste, Nutrient‌ Bars and Living‌ Flesh are‌ the only three things immune‌ to it.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest513221D0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put an Acolyte‌ Helmet‌ and‌ a </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Primordial Core</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a‌ crafting grid together. The‌ helmet comes out upgraded, permanently.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wearing‌ it‌ lets you peer‌ inside the‌ Cradle and‌ read‌ Biomass, Life‌ Energy and‌ the‌ three hidden odds directly. Every‌ bit of‌ tribute‌ arithmetic you‌ did by‌ hand‌ earlier‌ retires here.</grad></shadow>
[!info] One‌ upgrade per helmet, and the‌ helmet‌ needs Nutrients in‌ it for‌ the sight‌ to‌ work.
<typewriter><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#C24BC7>Stop‌ guessing at the‌ numbers</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest555E12B1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Biomancy wants </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>raw</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> meat. Beef, pork, chicken and‌ mutton are‌ the four‌ the‌ mod‌ calls prime, and it‌ never‌ stops asking‌ for‌ them.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fish‌ and rabbit‌ count as raw‌ meat too, and‌ this pack‌ throws‌ Alex's‌ Mobs and‌ Alex's Caves‌ meat into the‌ same pile.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Cooked‌ meat is worse than useless. Handing‌ the Primordial‌ Cradle a cooked‌ steak‌ drops your‌ success‌ chance by 999 and‌ ruins‌ the entire batch.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FF6B6B>Four‌ kinds, and‌ cook‌ none of‌ them</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.6>Meat Is A Resource</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest55FF68DA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nine of‌ them, each brewed‌ in the Bio-Lab‌ on‌ top of‌ one‌ of the three compounds. Load‌ one‌ into the Injector‌ and‌ go‌ find something‌ to‌ point it at.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Serums‌ are not potions. They ignore‌ milk, they‌ land on mobs‌ you cannot‌ normally affect, and‌ several‌ of‌ them are‌ permanent.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A‌ Vial Holder stores and‌ displays them‌ if‌ you want‌ to be‌ organised‌ about‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>Nine ways‌ to edit a creature</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.6>The Serum Rack</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest5652D76D: # <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Where‌ Each Part‌ Comes From</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Mineral‌ Fragments</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from clay, copper, chorus fruit‌ and shells.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Lithic Powder</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from clay, dirt, sand‌ and‌ raw ores.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Gem Fragments</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from‌ diamonds, emeralds, lapis, amethyst and‌ quartz.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Exotic Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from‌ blaze‌ rods, chorus‌ fruit, wither roses‌ and‌ totems.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Bioluminescent Goo</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from glow berries, glow‌ ink, shroomlight and‌ froglights.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything the‌ Bio-Forge builds‌ is made‌ of‌ nine‌ things. Learn this‌ table and‌ you never open‌ JEI for‌ this mod again.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Two‌ extra routes‌ exist only‌ in‌ this‌ pack. Goety Ectoplasm‌ decomposes into 1 to‌ 3‌ Bioluminescent Goo, and Industrial‌ Foregoing Pink‌ Slime Ingots‌ give‌ 2‌ to 4 Elastic‌ Fibres.
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Flesh Bits</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from rotten‌ flesh, raw meat‌ and flesh blocks.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Bone‌ Fragments</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from‌ bones, bone meal, skulls‌ and‌ whole fish.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Elastic Fibres</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from rotten‌ flesh, string, chicken‌ and phantom membrane.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Tough‌ Fibres</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from‌ leather, feathers, scutes, claws‌ and nautilus‌ shells.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>The‌ whole shopping‌ list</grad>
Filed away
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Base Components</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest56B8F6F5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 10‌ flesh bits, 12 bone‌ fragments, 8‌ mineral fragments‌ and‌ 32 tough fibres.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Only its‌ owner</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> can‌ open it. Anyone else‌ gets‌ bitten, and‌ the game‌ announces‌ that they tried‌ opening a chest and‌ were‌ eaten instead.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also‌ survives explosions. Add‌ more users‌ by‌ applying </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Tier‌ 3 Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ the‌ block.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Only the owner gets‌ in</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest56CCB63A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same‌ bill as‌ the Maw Hopper.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stick‌ it‌ on a‌ container‌ and it pulls up‌ to </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>3‌ items</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of one type‌ every‌ 24‌ ticks and‌ drops‌ them on the‌ floor. Pair it with a‌ hopper‌ unless you enjoy‌ sweeping up‌ after your‌ own‌ base.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest5812FD14: # <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Biomancy‌ Enchantments</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Self-Feeding</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> feeds‌ living‌ items‌ from Nutrients‌ in‌ your hotbar.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Injector‌ and Extractor also take </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Piercing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ raises‌ the chance the‌ needle gets‌ through armour.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Universal‌ Enchants‌ widens‌ all of‌ these‌ in this pack. Parasitic Metabolism‌ in particular‌ goes‌ on the‌ entire Confluence‌ accessory‌ list.
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Despoil</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes any‌ allowed weapon drop‌ organs on‌ kill. Will not‌ sit‌ next‌ to Silk‌ Touch.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Anesthetic Touch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> removes‌ the damage and‌ the aggro‌ from injecting a mob.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Surgical Precision</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raises‌ essence quality‌ and is the‌ only‌ route to‌ tier‌ 3.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Parasitic Metabolism</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> feeds living items‌ from‌ your food bar.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>One‌ of them‌ gates tier 3 essence</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest5BC0E3F3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 10‌ flesh bits, 3‌ bone‌ fragments, 8‌ elastic fibres‌ and 4 bile in‌ the‌ Bio-Forge.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It converts plants‌ and food‌ into </grad><grad from=#FF8A4C to=#FFCFA8 f=0.8>Nutrient Paste</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the‌ fuel‌ every‌ biomancy machine burns. Nine‌ paste‌ compresses into‌ a‌ Nutrient‌ Bar, and a‌ bar is a‌ perfectly decent‌ emergency snack.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Best‌ inputs‌ by‌ a mile: a‌ Nether Wart‌ Block gives 18‌ paste, a melon‌ gives 14, a cake gives 12, hay‌ bales and‌ dried kelp blocks‌ give‌ 9. Grass gives‌ 1, so‌ stop feeding it grass.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>In‌ this‌ pack Industrial Foregoing‌ Pink‌ Slime‌ digests into‌ 4‌ paste, which makes a‌ fully automatic fuel loop‌ very‌ easy to build.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest5DFAC628: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Skeletons, strays and skeleton‌ horses drop‌ it, and so‌ does‌ the‌ Warden. You can drink‌ it, which‌ is a‌ choice‌ the‌ mod lets‌ you make and‌ even provides‌ a slurping‌ sound‌ for.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cradle‌ value is </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>+5‌ success, -20 disease‌ and -10 hostility</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which makes‌ it the‌ tidiest single cleanup item in‌ the game.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest5E5878E7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hardened‌ claws‌ made‌ of tough‌ fibre. Same predator list as‌ fangs, minus‌ hoglins, plus parrots.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three of‌ them go‌ into the </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>Ravenous‌ Claws</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> much‌ later, so‌ do not burn‌ every‌ one you‌ find‌ on‌ Cradle tributes.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Bio-Forge‌ fallback: 7 mineral fragments, 8‌ tough fibres‌ and a‌ lithic‌ powder.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest64AE50B5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same‌ bill as‌ the‌ chestplate. Living Flesh, 10 flesh‌ bits, 32 tough fibres, 24 mineral‌ fragments‌ and 8 bone‌ fragments.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Bio-Alchemical Epidermis</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives +15%% resistance‌ to harmful‌ effects‌ applied‌ to you‌ from‌ outside, and cuts injection damage‌ and injection‌ resistance‌ by 25%% each, so‌ your own‌ serums‌ land‌ better.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6522C3C1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Cradle refuses‌ a‌ short list outright: dragon‌ eggs, spawners, hearts of the sea, name‌ tags, bundles, music‌ discs, elytra, armour, tools, netherite in any‌ form and‌ shulker boxes.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Weakness, wither, poison‌ and‌ Bleed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raise‌ Disease.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Bad omen, darkness, Corrosive‌ Acid and Primordial‌ Infestation</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raise Anomaly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything‌ else‌ it‌ will at‌ least‌ try to eat, and if‌ it does‌ not‌ recognise the‌ item it‌ treats‌ that‌ as an‌ insult.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Potions count, and the mod‌ reads‌ them by effect:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Regeneration, instant‌ health, health boost‌ and absorption</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> feed‌ Life‌ Energy.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Luck, saturation‌ and Fertility</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raise Success.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Hunger, nausea, blindness, harming, wither, poison‌ and‌ Bleed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raise Hostility.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>And‌ what it‌ spits‌ back‌ out</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>What Goes In The Bowl</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest65D51873: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Elastic‌ fibres plus one modifier‌ in the‌ Bio-Forge. Each‌ variant lets‌ one category‌ walk‌ straight‌ through while‌ everything else bounces off.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Impermeable</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lets‌ nothing‌ through at all.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Baby</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Adult</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> filter‌ by age.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Primal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lets‌ living mobs‌ through, </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>Undead</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lets‌ undead‌ through.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All five come‌ in‌ pane form‌ too, so‌ you‌ can build‌ actual windows out‌ of them.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Glass‌ that filters‌ by‌ species</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest67B2DF45: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>When‌ the anomaly‌ roll hits, the Cradle‌ skips the‌ normal blob‌ and‌ makes‌ a </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Primordial</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> one. Same drop, considerably‌ more menace, and‌ double the primal‌ energy pumped‌ into the ground.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh at +55‌ anomaly and‌ the Primordial Core‌ at +100‌ are the‌ two‌ big levers. Ender pearls add‌ 50‌ and Exotic Compound‌ adds‌ 20.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There‌ is also‌ a </grad><grad from=#C24BC7 to=#EFA9F2 f=0.8>Legacy‌ Flesh Blob</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in there. It‌ only appears if hostility‌ drops‌ below -420, which takes roughly‌ three enchanted‌ golden apples‌ in‌ one‌ batch. Nobody finds‌ this‌ by accident.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6822C517: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Claws, raw‌ meat, a‌ slime ball‌ and Living Flesh. From‌ here on‌ you barely‌ touch‌ a‌ crafting table‌ again.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Bio-Forge‌ pulls </grad><grad from=#FF8A4C to=#FFCFA8 f=0.8>loose components</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> straight out‌ of your‌ inventory and assembles them into‌ everything the‌ mod has. Machines, gear, blocks, tools. Tabs across‌ the‌ top sort‌ it‌ by category.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Recipe progression is‌ switched‌ off in this‌ pack, so‌ every‌ Bio-Forge recipe‌ is‌ available the moment‌ you place the block. There‌ is‌ nothing to unlock.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ runs on‌ Nutrients like‌ every‌ other‌ machine here, which‌ is‌ the next problem to‌ solve.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6842BDD9: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nutrient‌ Paste, any flower, Hormone‌ Secretion‌ and‌ cocoa beans‌ on Genetic Compound.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Animals breed‌ on‌ repeat for a‌ short window‌ with no‌ cooldown. The‌ mod‌ warns about </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>undesirable mutations</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the‌ offspring, which is‌ a‌ strange‌ thing for‌ a mod to‌ warn you‌ about and‌ worth‌ taking‌ seriously.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest68DAF743: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Organic Compound plus‌ two Regenerative‌ Fluid. That fluid‌ comes‌ out‌ of corals, slime, magma cream, oxeye‌ daisies‌ and enchanted‌ golden‌ apples‌ in the‌ Decomposer.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Remember it for‌ a second‌ reason. One of‌ these‌ is </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>55‌ Life Energy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the Cradle, so‌ two of them‌ fill the‌ meter on their own.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest68EB4579: # <grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Not‌ In The‌ Base‌ Mod</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ pack wires the‌ Bio-Forge‌ into three‌ endgame‌ recipes‌ that exist‌ nowhere else. Two of‌ them are‌ outright </grad><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.8>duplicators</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and the‌ third‌ turns‌ one of‌ those into‌ something better.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every one‌ of them‌ costs </grad><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.8>998 Nutrients</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in a single craft. That‌ is roughly‌ a stack and‌ a‌ half of‌ Nutrient‌ Paste per press, so build‌ the‌ Digester loop properly‌ before‌ you‌ come back‌ here.</grad></shadow>
[!info] All‌ three sit in‌ the Misc tab of‌ the‌ Bio-Forge, not in Tools‌ or Components.
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FC3272 to=#FCAEC7 f=0.6>Beyond The Mod</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6B0770FE: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Volatile‌ Fluid and‌ Hormone Secretion on‌ Exotic Compound.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Large‌ stackable boost‌ to‌ attack‌ damage and‌ attack speed. Stopping‌ brings weakness, sluggish movement‌ and nausea, which‌ you fix by taking more‌ or by‌ eating something sugary.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Rabbits‌ are‌ affected </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>permanently</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. That is‌ not‌ a bug.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] This is +1000 hostility‌ in‌ the Cradle. One vial‌ turns‌ a‌ batch into‌ an‌ ambush.
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6B758ACC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Healing Additive, Nutrient‌ Paste‌ and‌ Decaying Additive‌ on Genetic‌ Compound.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It reverses maturation. Either‌ a breeding‌ shortcut or a horror film, depending‌ on how‌ you look at‌ it. Also‌ 60 Life‌ Energy‌ in the Cradle.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6C6B69D4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Vial‌ as the‌ reactant, plus‌ two Bile, Biotic Matter‌ and Nutrients. Two seconds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This is‌ the‌ reactant for the‌ next tier‌ up. Everything in‌ this‌ mod‌ with a‌ colour‌ traces back to it.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The‌ reactant slot‌ is‌ not a‌ catalyst. It gets‌ consumed‌ alongside‌ the ingredients, every‌ single craft.
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>The root of‌ everything‌ liquid</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest6E8992D2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Biomancy gear‌ has no‌ durability‌ bar. It‌ has </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Nutrients</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. When the meter‌ empties‌ the item‌ goes‌ Dormant, then‌ Broken, and stops‌ working until you‌ feed it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed‌ it by‌ hand‌ the‌ way you‌ fill a‌ bundle, or enchant it‌ and let‌ it feed itself:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Parasitic Metabolism</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> drains your‌ food bar‌ to top the‌ item‌ up.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Self-Feeding</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> eats Nutrients‌ out‌ of your hotbar instead.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] This‌ pack‌ opens Parasitic Metabolism‌ up‌ to‌ almost every‌ Confluence‌ accessory as well, so‌ it is worth having‌ even‌ if you never‌ wear a‌ scrap of‌ biomancy‌ gear.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Everything‌ below is‌ made‌ in the Bio-Forge. No anvil, no‌ smithing table, no‌ netherite.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E8434F to=#E8434F>Living‌ equipment, fed not‌ repaired</grad>
Feed it, do not fix it
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.6>Growing Your Own Gear</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest74FED067: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, 3‌ bone‌ fragments, 5 flesh‌ bits, 4 elastic‌ fibres‌ and‌ 10 tough‌ fibres.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sneak click to flip‌ its‌ behaviour. It either fires </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>only‌ for its‌ owner</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>only for‌ everyone‌ else</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. One‌ of those is‌ a‌ door, the other‌ is‌ a‌ trap.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.6>Fleshkin Pressure Sensor</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest783E7677: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living Flesh, three‌ Sharp‌ Claws, 16‌ flesh bits, 18‌ tough fibres and‌ 15 mineral‌ fragments.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Dormant they‌ hit‌ for </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>+3‌ damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at 3.5‌ attack speed. Killing‌ mobs banks </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Blood Charge</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ spending it‌ flips them Awakened for </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>+5.5 damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ half a‌ block of extra‌ reach.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Eviscerating‌ Slash</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds a‌ Bleed‌ stack on a full‌ strength‌ hit, up to two. On‌ a‌ Bleed‌ stack there‌ is‌ a 20%% chance of </grad><grad from=#E8434F to=#FF9EA5 f=0.8>Blood‌ Explosion</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which deals 10%% of the‌ target's‌ maximum health.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Let them‌ run out‌ of Nutrients‌ and‌ they‌ go Broken. A‌ broken‌ pair has zero attack‌ damage and‌ shorter‌ reach than‌ your bare‌ fist.
<typewriter><grad from=#E8434F to=#E8434F>Starve‌ flesh, graft‌ claws on</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest7A85E347: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bees, cave‌ spiders‌ and pufferfish. The‌ tooltip‌ suggests drinking it, which is‌ the‌ mod being funny‌ at‌ your‌ expense.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Decomposes into </grad><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FFC2C2 f=0.8>Toxin‌ Extract</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the‌ base for the‌ nastier half of bio-alchemy. Master‌ clerics‌ will convert one‌ plus 4‌ emeralds into‌ four‌ extract‌ if you‌ are‌ short.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FF6B6B to=#FF6B6B>Do not drink this‌ one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest7F30882A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ failed‌ sacrifice paves‌ the block‌ under‌ the‌ Cradle and‌ throws veins across the‌ surrounding‌ area. They creep, they climb‌ walls, and they‌ convert what‌ they‌ touch.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shear‌ them off for‌ the‌ item. They are‌ the‌ base‌ for Malignant‌ Flesh Blocks and‌ for Bloomlight.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Veins‌ carry a‌ charge‌ up‌ to 15‌ and spread‌ on their own. If‌ you do‌ not want a meat farm‌ in your‌ base, put the Cradle‌ somewhere‌ you are‌ willing‌ to lose.
<typewriter><grad from=#B23A6B to=#B23A6B>The Cradle in‌ a‌ bad mood</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B23A6B to=#E88BAE f=0.6>Malignant Flesh Veins</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.quest9760C7BD: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Organic‌ Compound plus Hormone Secretion‌ and Nutrient‌ Paste. Hormone‌ Secretion comes‌ from eggs, ghast‌ tears, turtle‌ eggs‌ and bone‌ marrow.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is the reactant‌ behind‌ the four serums‌ that mess‌ with age, size‌ and‌ breeding.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.questB1C008E0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Organic Compound‌ plus Volatile Fluid, and‌ nothing‌ else.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Charcoal, one of‌ these‌ and blaze powder on‌ a‌ crafting table gives </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>gunpowder</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. A‌ strange‌ but‌ genuinely creeper‌ free‌ route to explosives.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>Combusts‌ on contact with anything</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.questB50F7126: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Living‌ Flesh, 5‌ flesh bits, 3‌ bone fragments and‌ 10 elastic‌ fibres.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A hopper‌ that‌ moves </grad><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#D8C6F2 f=0.8>16‌ items</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per transfer‌ instead of‌ one. Straight upgrade, and it‌ costs no‌ iron.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B7BD4 to=#9B7BD4>Sixteen items at a time</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.questD46D3243: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Organic‌ Compound‌ plus two‌ Exotic‌ Dust‌ and a‌ Mineral Fragment.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Reactant for‌ the cures‌ and the‌ stimulants. It‌ is‌ also </grad><grad from=#7BD64B to=#CFF2A6 f=0.8>+20 anomaly</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> as‌ a Cradle‌ tribute if you‌ are hunting‌ primordial blobs.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7BD64B to=#7BD64B>Reactant for the strange‌ ones</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.biomancy.questF493121F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cats‌ bring these‌ home‌ instead of the‌ usual morning gift. Objects wrapped‌ in‌ an organic layer‌ of skin, contents‌ unknown until‌ you‌ open‌ it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Its tooltip‌ claims‌ it might be filled‌ with toxin‌ if‌ your language‌ is set‌ to‌ German. That‌ is a‌ real joke sitting in‌ the‌ mod files.</grad></shadow>

[!success] On‌ a server‌ this means‌ one person builds‌ the giant‌ Altar and the Well of‌ Suffering, and everybody‌ else just uses‌ sigils. Nobody‌ else needs‌ an‌ Altar at all.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Simple‌ Key</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,500 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a‌ Tier‌ 1 Altar.</grad></shadow>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click the key to‌ bind‌ it to </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>your</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Soul Network.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hand‌ the bound‌ key to‌ a‌ friend.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They‌ hold it in‌ their‌ offhand or‌ in‌ the‌ key Curios‌ slot.</grad></shadow>

4. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Anything they bind‌ now draws‌ from </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>your</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> LP instead‌ of‌ theirs.</grad></shadow>
Share your‌ LP‌ with your friends

[!info] Added by `Animus`, not‌ base‌ Blood Magic.
Accelerate block‌ entities‌ up‌ to 32x‌ speed (furnaces, spawners, anything!)
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest1A5C0: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Incense Altar</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Wooden‌ Path</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, 3‌ rings‌ out, caps at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+60%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Stone‌ Path</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, 5‌ rings, caps at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+120%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Worn Stone Path</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, 7‌ rings, caps at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+200%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Obsidian‌ Path</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, 9‌ rings, caps at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+300%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tranquility‌ comes in‌ types: plants, crops, trees, earth, water, fire‌ and‌ lava. Each type‌ is square rooted before‌ they‌ are added together, so </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>variety‌ beats quantity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. A‌ pond, a small‌ farm, a‌ few‌ trees and one‌ lava‌ block beat‌ a‌ hundred‌ logs.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Hold a `Divination‌ Sigil` or `Seer's Sigil` and look‌ at the‌ Incense Altar. The‌ top‌ number‌ is total‌ Tranquility, the bottom‌ number is your‌ current bonus.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ single‌ biggest‌ early upgrade in‌ the‌ mod, and it‌ costs‌ almost‌ nothing. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4 Stone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2‌ Cobblestone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1 Charcoal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and your </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Weak‌ Blood Orb</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ you get‌ back.</grad></shadow>
[!success] At‌ the +300%% cap a single sacrifice is‌ worth four‌ times the LP. This‌ is‌ what turns‌ Tier‌ 4 and Tier 5‌ from‌ a grind into‌ an‌ afternoon.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place‌ it, then‌ stand within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5‌ blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of it. Your </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Sacrificial‌ Knife</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> starts to glow. Hold‌ right click‌ and release, and instead of one‌ heart you‌ sacrifice </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>90%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of your health‌ in‌ one go, multiplied‌ by‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Tranquility</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> bonus.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]

## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Growing the Bonus</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Lay three‌ wide </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Path</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ outwards from a‌ 3x3‌ platform‌ under the‌ Altar, in‌ all four cardinal‌ directions. Blocks near those paths‌ add‌ Tranquility.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No path at‌ all caps‌ you at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+20%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
Up‌ to 4x‌ LP‌ from every self‌ sacrifice

## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Well of Suffering</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The end‌ of‌ manual LP. This ritual‌ damages every‌ mob inside‌ its‌ area‌ and pipes‌ the‌ blood straight into a‌ nearby Blood‌ Altar.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Built‌ with the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ritual‌ Diviner [Dusk]</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It links‌ to‌ exactly‌ one Altar‌ at a time.</grad></shadow>

[!tip] Point it‌ at‌ a mob farm‌ or a‌ dark spawner‌ room, drop‌ a‌ Blood Orb in‌ the‌ linked Altar, and‌ stack `Runes‌ of‌ Sacrifice` on that‌ Altar. Your Soul Network‌ fills itself‌ while you‌ do‌ something‌ else entirely.
[!info] Mobs‌ killed this‌ way still drop‌ their normal‌ loot, so the farm pays you‌ twice.
Never stab‌ yourself again
Build a Well of Suffering
Well of Suffering
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Ritual of‌ the‌ Feathered Knife</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ lazy‌ option. This ritual repeatedly cuts‌ every‌ player standing inside‌ it‌ and‌ feeds the‌ blood‌ to a nearby‌ Altar. No clicking at all.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Also‌ built‌ with the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ritual Diviner [Dusk]</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] It‌ will absolutely‌ kill you. Pair‌ it‌ with‌ a `Ritual of‌ Regeneration`, a‌ regeneration effect, or simply do‌ not go‌ afk‌ inside it‌ on two‌ hearts.
[!tip] `Runes‌ of‌ Self Sacrifice` apply‌ to every cut it‌ makes, so‌ an Altar stacked‌ with them‌ turns this‌ into‌ a‌ very fast LP‌ engine.
Bleeds‌ you automatically
Build a Ritual of the Feathered Knife
Ritual of the Feathered Knife
