ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest1F3B9: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click the‌ ground with </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Arcane‌ Ashes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ draw‌ an array. Each‌ drawing‌ spends one of the‌ ashes' </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> uses.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An array‌ takes‌ exactly two‌ items, clicked in‌ one‌ at‌ a time:</grad></shadow>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>base</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> item‌ goes in first. If it‌ is‌ valid, the pattern on‌ the ground‌ changes.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>catalyst</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> goes in‌ second, and‌ the‌ array fires.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] This is‌ how‌ nearly every‌ Sigil‌ in‌ the mod‌ is made. Look any‌ of them‌ up in‌ JEI‌ and‌ it will‌ show you‌ the exact pair.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest20458: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ top‌ gem. Needs a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Demonic Slate</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Weak‌ Blood Shard</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Demon Will‌ Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so‌ this‌ one waits‌ until‌ Tier 4.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest2214B: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 5‌ Blood Altar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>52</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more‌ runes‌ on‌ top of Tier‌ 4, for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>108</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> total.</grad></shadow>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>13</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Blood‌ Runes along‌ each‌ edge, one‌ block </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>down</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and three‌ blocks </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>out</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from the Tier‌ 4 ring.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Leave‌ a one‌ block‌ gap‌ at either‌ end of‌ each row.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put one </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Hellforged‌ Block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in each‌ of the four corners.</grad></shadow>

[!warn] Hellforged Blocks, not‌ blocks of‌ Demonite. A Hellforged Block‌ is‌ 9 Hellforged‌ Ingots, so‌ the four corners cost‌ you‌ 36 ingots smelted‌ from‌ Demon‌ Realm Demonite. Any‌ Will-aspected‌ Hellforged Block works‌ too.
[!tip] 108 runes is 108‌ Blank‌ Slates. If you got‌ here without‌ a `Well of‌ Suffering` or‌ an `Incense‌ Altar`, go back‌ and‌ build one, it is not‌ worth doing‌ this‌ by hand.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest25343: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Sanguine Reverter</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the‌ tool‌ slot of‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Alchemical‌ Reaction Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and feed it </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Saturated‌ Tau</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. That is‌ the‌ only source‌ of Weak‌ Blood‌ Shards‌ in the‌ game.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You need them for‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Master‌ Blood Orb</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Greater Tartaric‌ Gem</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and the‌ Tier 4‌ Altar‌ materials.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest281AA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Redstone Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blank Slate</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ an Alchemy‌ Array. The‌ first sigil‌ almost everybody‌ makes.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>air</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ print how‌ much LP is in‌ your‌ Soul Network.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blood Altar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ see its‌ tier, its‌ stored‌ LP and its‌ capacity.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sneak‌ and right‌ click‌ to‌ open a‌ screen where you‌ can drag‌ every Blood‌ Magic‌ HUD‌ element somewhere‌ you actually‌ like.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] This is also‌ how you‌ check whether a multiblock upgrade‌ worked. Build the‌ runes, point this at‌ the‌ Altar, read the‌ tier.
Read‌ your LP and your‌ Altar
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest296AB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fires a blood light‌ in‌ the direction you‌ are facing. Where‌ it lands‌ it‌ leaves‌ an almost‌ invisible‌ light source for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The‌ cheapest sigil‌ in‌ the mod‌ and easily‌ the‌ best‌ one for‌ caving. No torches, no clutter.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest2C3CA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The second‌ tier of‌ slate. Unlocks the‌ mid‌ tier‌ sigils hanging off‌ this‌ quest, plus a‌ chunk‌ of‌ the reagents‌ in the Alchemy‌ Table.</grad></shadow>
Blank Slate‌ plus 2,000‌ LP‌ at‌ Tier 2
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest2CA28: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ upgrade‌ rune you have‌ built‌ can be‌ reforged‌ into‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Reinforced</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> version worth‌ exactly double. A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+20%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Rune of‌ Capacity becomes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+40%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ so on.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ costs </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Netherite‌ Scrap</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Intricate‌ Hellforged Parts</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ only drop‌ deep inside the‌ Demon Realm‌ mines.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Doubling a rune frees up‌ a slot. Two‌ Reinforced Capacity Runes‌ do‌ the work‌ of‌ four normal ones, and you‌ get‌ to spend the‌ space‌ on‌ something else‌ entirely.
[!tip] Changed‌ your mind? The `Sanguine Reverter` in‌ the ARC turns any‌ Reinforced‌ Rune back into‌ its ingredients.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest2D3F7: [!info] Downgrades‌ have `negative` point‌ costs. Deliberately crippling‌ one stat buys you‌ room‌ for far more‌ of another, which‌ is how‌ the‌ strongest‌ Living Armour sets‌ are‌ actually built.
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Draw‌ an Alchemy‌ Array‌ with </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Arcane‌ Ashes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Apply </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Binding Reagent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> as‌ the catalyst.</grad></shadow>

3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop‌ in a piece‌ of plain </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Iron‌ Armour</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. You need at least a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Common‌ Tartaric Gem</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with‌ Will in it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ protects‌ like iron‌ but‌ has diamond durability, and it‌ watches‌ what you do. Sprint‌ a‌ lot‌ and it‌ makes‌ you faster. Take hits‌ and it makes you‌ tougher.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ get </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Upgrade Points to‌ spend. The </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ritual of‌ Living Evolution</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> raises‌ that‌ cap‌ to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>300</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Hold sneak‌ and‌ look at the armour‌ to see‌ what‌ it has‌ learned so‌ far.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest2DE5C: Double strength Rune‌ of‌ Augmented Capacity
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest2F2D8: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Swap‌ one‌ of the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blank Runes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ your Altar for this. Every‌ Rune‌ of Sacrifice adds‌ a flat </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+10%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ LP that‌ came‌ out‌ of something‌ other‌ than you.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That covers the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Dagger‌ of Sacrifice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and, much‌ later, the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Well‌ of Suffering</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!info] It‌ does nothing‌ for‌ stabbing‌ yourself. That is‌ the `Rune of Self Sacrifice`.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest30858: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Alchemical Reaction Chamber</shadow></grad>
[!info] It is‌ sided‌ like‌ a furnace. Tools‌ go in the top, inputs‌ the‌ sides, outputs come out‌ the bottom. Worth‌ knowing before‌ you‌ place‌ a hopper.
[!tip] Most ARC‌ tools‌ wear out. Put‌ Unbreaking‌ or‌ Mending on‌ them.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A processing‌ block‌ that takes a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>tool</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the‌ top‌ slot and‌ does‌ whatever that tool‌ implies:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Works as a plain‌ furnace.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ore‌ tripling</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with the right‌ tool.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Turns </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Saturated Tau</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Weak‌ Blood Shards</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Sanguine‌ Reverter</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ is the‌ only‌ source of them.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Reverts Blood‌ Orbs and </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Reinforced‌ Runes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> back‌ into their‌ ingredients.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest316E5: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Your‌ Soul Network</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Or‌ right‌ click the orb‌ in your hand to‌ trade‌ one heart for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> directly.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] If a‌ bound item‌ needs‌ LP‌ and your‌ network‌ is empty, it takes the‌ cost out‌ of‌ your health‌ instead. Keep a‌ buffer.
[!tip] Blood‌ Orbs‌ are never‌ consumed by crafting recipes. The‌ Blank‌ Rune and Incense‌ Altar recipes‌ both hand‌ the‌ orb‌ straight back.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Throw‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into‌ a Tier‌ 1 Altar‌ holding </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2,000‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ you get‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Weak Blood Orb</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ the‌ orb once to </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>bind</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> it‌ to yourself. From‌ then on‌ it‌ is‌ a personal, cross-dimension LP‌ battery‌ called your </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Soul‌ Network</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ every‌ sigil, ritual and‌ bound item you‌ ever make‌ spends out‌ of‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[!info] It‌ holds 5,000‌ LP, not 1,000. Every‌ later orb upgrades‌ the same‌ network rather than creating a‌ second one.

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop the orb‌ into‌ an Altar‌ that‌ has LP in it‌ and‌ it drinks as‌ fast‌ as‌ your </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Speed Runes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> allow.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest319D7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same‌ deal‌ as‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Sentient Sword</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, it‌ collects Demon Will from‌ hostile‌ kills. It simply hits‌ from further‌ away.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest33181: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Passively strips negative‌ potion‌ effects off‌ you.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Added‌ by `Animus`, not‌ base Blood‌ Magic.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest363EE: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Boosts Demon Will‌ gain‌ while it‌ is‌ equipped. It‌ does not‌ need to be‌ the thing‌ landing the‌ kill.</grad></shadow>
More‌ Will‌ per kill‌ just for‌ holding it
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest368BC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds up‌ to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sigils, gives‌ you‌ all of‌ their passive effects‌ at once, and‌ lets you‌ cycle‌ between‌ them to‌ use them‌ actively.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click to‌ open its‌ inventory, then scroll or use the‌ cycle keys‌ to switch which‌ one‌ is live.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] With‌ Curios‌ installed this is the‌ single‌ charm slot that‌ carries‌ your‌ whole sigil‌ loadout.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest375FF: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Third tier‌ slate. Gates the‌ Common‌ Tartaric‌ Gem, the Ritual‌ Diviner‌ parts and most of‌ the Animus‌ sigils‌ hanging off‌ this quest.</grad></shadow>
Reinforced‌ Slate‌ plus‌ 5,000 LP‌ at Tier 3
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest378B2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Teleposer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, then‌ sneak‌ and right click‌ it with‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Teleposition Sigil</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ record‌ its‌ position and dimension.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>After‌ that, right‌ clicking the‌ sigil‌ anywhere‌ teleports you‌ back to it‌ for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Move‌ the Teleposer‌ and‌ the‌ link breaks. Re-link‌ it before‌ you need the‌ escape route.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest396AA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The last‌ slate. Nothing above this exists‌ yet.</grad></shadow>
Demonic‌ Slate plus 30,000‌ LP at‌ Tier 5
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest3AADA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click to place‌ a lava‌ source for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] With‌ an‌ empty Soul‌ Network‌ it takes 5 hearts‌ off‌ you instead. Check your‌ LP‌ before‌ you start‌ paving.
[!tip] Same‌ trick as the‌ Water Sigil, it works as‌ an‌ infinite lava bucket‌ inside the `Alchemy‌ Table` and is‌ not‌ consumed.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest3CA03: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A ritual‌ you can‌ build with‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>basic</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Ritual‌ Diviner. It‌ opens a‌ doorway into‌ the antechamber of‌ the Demon‌ Realm.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Inside you get a loot‌ chest, a few‌ dungeon rooms, and an‌ Inversion‌ Pillar to‌ send‌ you home.</grad></shadow>
[!info] This is where `Tau‌ Fruit` comes‌ from, and Tau is‌ the‌ gate‌ to Tier‌ 4. There‌ is no way‌ around it.
Your first trip‌ to‌ the Demon Realm
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest3D454: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ any‌ fluid and it is‌ gone, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>50‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a block. The cheap‌ way‌ to‌ clean up‌ a‌ lava flow or‌ drain a flooded mineshaft.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest3FC56: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ does two different things for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>150‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> each:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ a plant for‌ a‌ normal bonemeal‌ effect.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sneak‌ and right click </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>air</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to toggle‌ it‌ on. Every 5 seconds‌ it‌ applies‌ a growth‌ tick‌ to every block‌ in a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>7x7x5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> box around you.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Curios‌ is‌ installed, so most sigils‌ can sit‌ in a‌ charm‌ slot‌ instead of‌ your‌ hand.
Bonemeal on demand or‌ passive growth
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest42B8B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eats plants within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ to refill‌ your hunger bar.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Added‌ by `Animus`, not‌ base Blood‌ Magic.
Consume‌ nearby plants to restore‌ hunger
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest42CDD: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Demon Realm</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Built with‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ritual Diviner [Dusk]</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Much‌ harsher than the‌ antechamber, and‌ much richer.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Demonite‌ Ore</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> smelts‌ into </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Hellforged Ingots</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. You need those‌ for‌ the Tier 5‌ Altar‌ and‌ the Archmage's‌ Blood‌ Orb.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Intricate Hellforged Parts</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are‌ what turn every rune‌ you‌ own into its </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Reinforced</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> version.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Watch‌ chat for </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Spatial‌ Distortion</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> messages. They mark‌ a‌ locked‌ room, opened with‌ an </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Iron‌ Key</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Foreman's Key</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Come geared. This‌ is not‌ the‌ antechamber, and the‌ Inversion Pillar‌ home‌ is‌ not always‌ the closest thing to‌ you.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest431C4: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier‌ 4 Blood‌ Altar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>28</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more‌ runes‌ on top‌ of Tier 3, for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>56</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> total.</grad></shadow>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Blood‌ Runes along‌ each edge, one‌ block </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>down</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ two‌ blocks </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>out</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from the‌ Tier 3‌ ring.</grad></shadow>

2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In each corner, stack </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> solid‌ blocks starting‌ just above that new ring.</grad></shadow>

3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cap‌ each pillar‌ with </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Bloodstone Bricks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Large Bloodstone‌ Bricks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ need Tau.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The‌ Sanguine‌ Scientiem has the 3D‌ model. Rotate‌ it, count the runes, copy‌ it‌ exactly.
[!success] Tier‌ 4 unlocks‌ the `Ritual‌ Diviner [Dusk]`, and that unlocks‌ the rituals that make‌ LP‌ generate itself.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest4439B: # <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sanguine‌ Alembic</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Feed</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Reagents into the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Item‌ Port</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, six slots‌ each way</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Life‌ Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into‌ the‌ Essence Port, ten‌ buckets‌ of tank</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5000 FE</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per craft, tank‌ holds two‌ hundred‌ thousand</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same speed‌ as doing‌ it‌ by‌ hand, one to‌ ten seconds. You just do‌ not‌ have to be‌ there.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>It Gives‌ Stuff Back</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ Alchemy‌ Table, but it‌ works while you‌ are asleep. </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Every‌ recipe it‌ already‌ knew</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, no‌ exceptions.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Alchemical‌ items‌ come‌ out untouched. Buckets and‌ bottles‌ come back. A‌ tool‌ used‌ as a‌ component only takes </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>one‌ point of‌ damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, same as‌ the‌ table. Nothing‌ gets eaten‌ that would‌ not have been.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Life‌ Essence is‌ a fluid here. One bucket is‌ a thousand‌ LP. Pipe it in‌ from‌ an altar. The‌ machine‌ cannot reach into your‌ soul‌ network by itself.
[!note] Look‌ the‌ controller‌ up in‌ JEI‌ for the recipe‌ list and the build‌ layout.
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Build</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Floor of </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Large‌ Blood Stone‌ Brick</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, three by four. Four‌ of those‌ tiles are the controller and‌ its ports.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On‌ top: the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Alchemy Table</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> down the‌ middle, </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blank‌ Runes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> around it. Leave‌ the‌ tile behind the table‌ empty, that‌ is where its‌ other‌ half‌ goes.</grad></shadow>
[!info] You need‌ a‌ working Alchemy Table‌ to build this. No shortcut‌ past‌ it.
Table‌ go brrr
Sanguine Alembic
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest45C16: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Sacrificial Knife</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold‌ it and </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>right‌ click while‌ aiming‌ at‌ air</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. You lose one‌ heart, and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> appears in‌ a‌ Blood‌ Altar near‌ you.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You do not‌ click the‌ Altar with‌ it. You‌ just‌ have to‌ be standing‌ within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2 blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of one.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] With‌ no Altar‌ in range you still take‌ the damage‌ and get nothing‌ back. Place‌ the Altar‌ first, then‌ start stabbing.
[!tip] Keep your hunger‌ bar‌ full. At this stage‌ food‌ regen‌ is your‌ real‌ LP generator, so eat, stab‌ in bursts, and let yourself‌ heal‌ back up.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest46B2B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Places‌ blocks‌ far‌ faster, out to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>64</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Added‌ by `Animus`, not‌ base Blood Magic.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest4725C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Levitates‌ everything‌ nearby and‌ then drops‌ it. The fall does‌ the damage.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Added‌ by `Animus`, not base Blood Magic.
Levitate enemies‌ then drop‌ them for devastating‌ fall‌ damage
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest47B98: [!info] This only‌ affects‌ Life Essence moved‌ by pipes‌ and tanks. It‌ does‌ not‌ speed up crafting, and‌ it‌ does not‌ speed‌ up‌ filling a‌ Blood Orb.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Useful once‌ you are‌ piping Life‌ Essence‌ around‌ a base. Before‌ that, skip it‌ and put a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Rune‌ of Capacity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the slot instead.</grad></shadow>
+20%% pump speed to‌ and from‌ external tanks
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest48727: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four‌ times the Petty‌ gem. You only‌ need </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>one</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gem when‌ upgrading, the‌ Forge‌ pulls Will out‌ of‌ the gem‌ it‌ is‌ consuming first‌ and hands the‌ leftovers back‌ in the‌ new‌ one.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest48BD3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Weak Blood Shard</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40,000‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a Tier 4‌ Altar. Nearly seven‌ times the‌ Magician‌ orb.</grad></shadow>
[!success] If‌ you are wearing‌ the `Ring‌ of the‌ Seven‌ Curses`, this‌ is the‌ point where LP‌ stops being‌ what limits‌ your‌ spellcasting.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest49F57: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Makes every‌ Altar‌ operation faster by‌ a‌ flat </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+20%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ rune, and makes‌ Blood‌ Orbs fill faster‌ too.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] It also speeds up‌ how‌ fast an empty‌ Altar loses‌ crafting progress. That‌ is‌ only‌ a problem‌ if‌ you keep starting crafts‌ you cannot‌ pay‌ for.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest4B511: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 2 Blood‌ Altar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ring‌ the base of‌ the Altar‌ with </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blank Runes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. No‌ pillars, no‌ glowstone, just‌ the ring.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blank‌ Rune</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>7‌ Stone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> around a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blank Slate</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Weak‌ Blood Orb</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a‌ crafting table. The‌ orb comes‌ back‌ out, so‌ one orb‌ builds every rune you‌ will‌ ever need.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The four‌ runes on‌ the cardinal‌ sides‌ can‌ later be swapped‌ for‌ upgrade runes. The‌ four‌ corner‌ runes do‌ nothing at all‌ until Tier‌ 3.
[!tip] Open the `Sanguine‌ Scientiem` and‌ find‌ the Blood‌ Altar entry. It‌ has a rotating‌ 3D model‌ of every single tier. Copy that.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest4BA67: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Collects‌ Will from ranged‌ kills, and spends </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1‌ Will</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> every time‌ you‌ fire.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Out‌ of Will‌ means out‌ of bow. Carry a‌ stocked Tartaric‌ Gem.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest4F35E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Made from </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ethereal Slate</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Give‌ it‌ any block and‌ it wears‌ that block's‌ texture‌ while‌ staying solid, which‌ is‌ how you hide a‌ chest inside‌ a‌ wall.</grad></shadow>
A block‌ that pretends‌ to‌ be‌ another block
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest506D4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Completely‌ separate from your‌ Soul‌ Network. Will is‌ a‌ physical thing you carry.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Soul‌ Snares</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are‌ String plus </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>500 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a‌ Tier‌ 1 Altar. Throw‌ one‌ at a hostile‌ mob, watch for the white‌ particles, then‌ kill it. It drops </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Demon‌ Will</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Looting increases‌ how much‌ Will‌ drops.
[!info] Snares‌ are a‌ stopgap. Build‌ the `Sentient Sword` as soon as‌ you can‌ and‌ every hostile‌ kill gives‌ Will‌ with‌ no snares‌ at all.
A second resource, nothing‌ to‌ do with LP
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest50A28: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Found‌ in the‌ dungeon chests‌ inside‌ the‌ Hidden Realm. Plant‌ it‌ and it grows like‌ a crop, so‌ you‌ only ever‌ have to‌ find‌ one.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] It‌ also presses‌ into `Tau Oil`, which makes any `Anointment` last‌ four‌ times as long. Worth‌ a second‌ farm row‌ on‌ its‌ own.
Loot it once, then‌ farm‌ it forever
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5269E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You need </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of these‌ to build‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ritual Diviner [Dusk]</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Unlike the‌ four‌ elemental Inscription‌ Tools, the‌ Diviners themselves never run‌ out‌ of uses.
Block of‌ Coal‌ plus‌ 2,000 LP‌ at‌ Tier 4
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest526BE: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Converts blocks within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ into‌ corrupting AntiLife, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>25‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ block.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Added‌ by `Animus`, not base‌ Blood Magic.
Convert everything‌ you touch‌ into corrupting‌ AntiLife
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5361F: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Dagger‌ of Sacrifice</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Slimes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> pay </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>15</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Endermen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> pay </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything‌ else pays </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>25</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ point.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A healthy‌ cow‌ has‌ 10 health, so‌ one cow is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. A‌ villager‌ has 20, so </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2,000 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Babies‌ pay half.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Wounded‌ mobs pay‌ less, because‌ it‌ reads current health‌ and‌ not maximum‌ health. Do‌ not‌ soften them‌ up first.
[!danger] Bosses are‌ immune to‌ the instant‌ kill. Try‌ it‌ and you‌ are simply‌ a person standing‌ next to‌ a boss holding a bad‌ sword.
[!tip] A small‌ penned breeding farm‌ right‌ next to‌ the‌ Altar out-earns stabbing yourself‌ by‌ a very wide‌ margin.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Iron Sword</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3,000‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a Tier‌ 2‌ Altar.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hit any mob standing‌ within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2‌ blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of your Altar‌ and‌ it‌ dies on‌ the‌ spot, dumping its blood‌ straight into the Altar. Costs‌ you‌ no health at‌ all.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What Is‌ It Worth</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ payout‌ is‌ the mob's </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>current‌ health</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> multiplied‌ by a per-mob rate:</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, horses, wolves, ocelots, rabbits‌ and villagers</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> pay </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ point.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5886C: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier‌ 3 Blood Altar</shadow></grad>
[!success] Tier‌ 3‌ is‌ where `Rituals` unlock. This is‌ the‌ tier that turns‌ Blood Magic from clicking‌ yourself‌ into infrastructure.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more‌ runes on‌ top of‌ the‌ Tier‌ 2 ring, for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>28</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> total.</grad></shadow>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Blood‌ Runes‌ along each edge, one block </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>down</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ two blocks </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>out</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from‌ the‌ Tier 2‌ ring.</grad></shadow>

2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In each‌ corner, stack </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ of‌ anything solid‌ starting just above that‌ new‌ ring.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cap each of‌ the four‌ pillars with‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Glowstone‌ Block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Only‌ the glowstone caps‌ are‌ fixed. The two‌ blocks‌ underneath‌ each cap‌ can be any‌ non-air block‌ you like, so‌ build‌ them‌ out of‌ whatever is‌ in your inventory.
[!tip] Point‌ a `Divination Sigil` at‌ the Altar afterwards to confirm‌ it actually‌ reads Tier 3, and‌ use‌ the 3D‌ model‌ in the Sanguine Scientiem‌ if‌ anything looks off.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest59470: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stores‌ a‌ block‌ and places‌ it‌ again elsewhere. Bind it‌ to a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Teleposer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and it moves‌ entities‌ between dimensions.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Added by `Animus`, not‌ base Blood‌ Magic.
Store and‌ place‌ blocks, or‌ bind to‌ a‌ Teleposer to teleport entities‌ across dimensions
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5A0FC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>toggle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sigil, not a‌ five second‌ buff. Sneak‌ and‌ right click‌ to‌ turn it on and‌ you keep‌ Haste‌ for as‌ long as‌ it‌ is‌ active, at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> every‌ 5 seconds.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Toggle it off‌ before‌ you go idle. A‌ forgotten Fast‌ Miner will‌ quietly‌ empty‌ a Weak Blood‌ Orb‌ in about‌ four‌ minutes.
[!tip] Curios‌ is installed, so‌ most sigils can‌ sit in‌ a charm‌ slot‌ instead‌ of your‌ hand.
Haste while‌ active, 100 LP per‌ 5 seconds
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5E2CB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>While active‌ it‌ removes every‌ fluid‌ within‌ roughly </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>6 blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ you. They come back‌ on their‌ own once‌ you‌ walk‌ away.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The most‌ expensive upkeep‌ sigil in the‌ mod at‌ 400 LP every 5 seconds, and‌ turning it‌ off while you‌ are‌ inside deep‌ water‌ is exactly as bad‌ as‌ it sounds.
Pushes fluids‌ away, 400‌ LP‌ per 5‌ seconds
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5E2D1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Tau‌ plant‌ that </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>finishes growing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with‌ a mob standing‌ on top‌ of it‌ leeches‌ that‌ mob instead, and‌ matures into </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Saturated‌ Tau</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The mob has‌ to be‌ standing there at the moment‌ it matures. Dropping‌ a corpse on‌ a‌ fully grown‌ plant‌ does nothing.
[!tip] Fence a cow‌ into‌ a one block‌ hole‌ over‌ a freshly‌ planted‌ Tau and walk‌ away. The plant does the‌ rest.
Feed‌ the plant a‌ live mob
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest5FFAC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>toggle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sigil. ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest6AAB8: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Stone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into an‌ Altar‌ holding </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest6C0D4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+7.5%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>multiplicative</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> boost per‌ rune, applied‌ after all your normal </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Runes‌ of Capacity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest6C57F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>While‌ the Altar‌ is idle it‌ quietly siphons‌ LP into a hidden buffer. The‌ next item‌ you drop in‌ gets‌ that whole‌ buffer‌ applied at once, one for‌ one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each‌ rune banks up‌ to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, scaled‌ up further‌ if‌ your Altar capacity‌ is above </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Pair it with `Acceleration‌ Runes`. They‌ make it charge‌ more often.
Banks‌ LP so‌ crafts‌ finish‌ instantly
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest6CE4E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ mirror‌ of the‌ Rune of Sacrifice. +10%% LP from your own blood, per‌ rune

ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest72043: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It does‌ not use arrows‌ at‌ all. It burns </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out‌ of‌ your Soul Network.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No gem slot here. It eats </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Demon‌ Will Crystals</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> straight‌ up, fifty Will each.</grad></shadow>

[gap=5]
## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Feed</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Components and‌ crystals into‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Item‌ Port</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, six slots‌ each way</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5000‌ FE</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ craft</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five‌ seconds a‌ craft, every time</grad></shadow>

[gap=5]
[gap=5]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three‌ by three‌ of </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Large‌ Blood Stone‌ Brick</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for the‌ controller‌ and‌ ports. Another three‌ by three on top‌ of‌ that.</grad></shadow>

Enter‌ ghost mode for‌ scouting, PLUS works‌ as a‌ Totem‌ of‌ Undying!

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It builds </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Tartaric‌ Gems</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Sentient Tools</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Throwing‌ Daggers</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Explosive Charges</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
Crafting‌ that‌ runs‌ on Demon‌ Will
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest7C071: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Blood Altar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Stone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Furnace</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ three </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Gold‌ Ingots</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Place‌ it down, then‌ right‌ click it holding an‌ item to‌ drop‌ that item‌ in, or right‌ click‌ with‌ an empty‌ hand to take it‌ back‌ out.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Tier 1‌ Altar holds </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10,000‌ LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Roughly ten‌ percent‌ of‌ that is reserved‌ for‌ an internal‌ buffer‌ you‌ never see, so‌ treat it as‌ about </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>9,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> usable.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Blood Does‌ Not Evaporate</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>What‌ actually‌ drains‌ is </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>crafting progress</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. While‌ the Altar‌ is transfiguring an‌ item it‌ eats LP and throws red‌ particles. If it‌ runs dry part‌ way‌ through, it shows‌ grey‌ smoke instead and the‌ progress‌ ticks back down‌ towards‌ zero.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] So‌ the rule‌ is‌ not be quick, the‌ rule is do not‌ start‌ a craft you‌ cannot pay‌ for. Fill the‌ Altar‌ first, drop‌ the item‌ in‌ second.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest7C8D7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No‌ more snares. Kill‌ a hostile with‌ this and‌ it collects the Will for‌ you.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Its damage‌ scales off how‌ much‌ Will you‌ are‌ carrying, so a full Tartaric‌ Gem‌ makes it hit‌ genuinely‌ hard.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Repair‌ it in‌ an‌ anvil with `Crystallized Will`, not‌ iron.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest7CA3A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fourth tier‌ slate. Everything hanging‌ off‌ this‌ quest is‌ late‌ game Altar tuning and‌ the strongest‌ sigils‌ in the‌ pack.</grad></shadow>
Imbued Slate‌ plus‌ 15,000‌ LP at‌ Tier 4
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest7CC2D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ crafting‌ station that‌ pays with </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of fuel. Put‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>bound‌ Blood Orb</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ slot on‌ the right. That‌ orb‌ decides‌ both whose network‌ gets‌ drained and‌ which‌ recipes‌ you are‌ allowed to use.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ makes </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Arcane Ashes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, sigil </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Reagents</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Anointments</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ a pile‌ of‌ quality‌ of life‌ recipes such‌ as Rotten Flesh‌ into Leather‌ and doubled ore output.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] `Orb Error` means‌ your orb‌ tier is too‌ low‌ for that‌ recipe. `Soul‌ Network Error` means the orb‌ is‌ not bound to‌ you, or‌ your‌ network is‌ empty. Right‌ click the orb‌ to bind it.
ftbquests.chapter.bleed_magic.quest7E009: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Living Armour</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> starts‌ at iron‌ and‌ then‌ trains itself‌ around how you play.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Rituals</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> automate‌ the‌ boring parts of‌ the pack, including‌ your own‌ LP‌ supply.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>If‌ you wear the </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Ring‌ of‌ the Seven‌ Curses</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, your‌ Iron's‌ Spellbooks spells‌ are paid for‌ with </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of‌ mana.</grad></shadow>
[!info] That last‌ one‌ is‌ the big‌ one. For a‌ cursed ring player‌ the Blood‌ Altar is not optional flavour, it‌ is your‌ mana bar. No LP‌ means‌ no spells.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blood Magic‌ runs on </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Life Points</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, or </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>LP</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. You‌ hurt yourself, that‌ blood fills an </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Altar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and the pool‌ it makes‌ pays for everything‌ else‌ the mod‌ ever‌ does.</grad></shadow>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stab‌ yourself with a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Sacrificial Knife</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ fill‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blood Altar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Spend that‌ LP‌ on </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Slates</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Runes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FF7B7B to=#FF3B3B f=0.8>Blood‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Runes upgrade‌ the‌ Altar. A bigger Altar‌ unlocks better slates, better orbs‌ and‌ better toys.</grad></shadow>

[!tip] This‌ quest hands‌ you‌ the `Sanguine‌ Scientiem`, the in-game‌ book. Every‌ multiblock in this chapter‌ has a‌ rotating‌ 3D preview‌ inside it. Use‌ that‌ instead‌ of trying‌ to build from my‌ words.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is one of‌ the‌ few mods here‌ that‌ keeps‌ paying you‌ back‌ forever, and almost nobody‌ in this pack touches‌ it. This‌ chapter is here‌ to fix‌ that.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FF8787 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Why You‌ Actually‌ Want‌ This</shadow></grad>

ftbquests.chapter.bridges.quest2B8226511: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All‌ five have‌ the full‌ set. Purification‌ to‌ a clump, Crusher to‌ a‌ dirty dust, Injection‌ to‌ a‌ shard, Dissolution to‌ a dirty slurry, Washer, Crystallizer‌ to a‌ crystal. </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>Five ingots‌ per‌ ore</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, same‌ as the‌ originals.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Slurries get‌ drawn by tint, not‌ by texture, so‌ nobody had to paint a‌ mithril slurry.
[!note] This‌ one needed actual‌ code, which‌ is why‌ it‌ turned up after the‌ rest‌ of the ladder.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mekanism doubling‌ an‌ ore is‌ generic. Anything‌ past that is not.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three, four‌ and‌ five times run‌ on </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>clumps, shards, crystals‌ and‌ slurries</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and each‌ of‌ those has to‌ exist as a real‌ registered‌ thing for that‌ exact metal. Mekanism‌ ships them‌ for‌ its‌ own seven‌ and‌ nobody else's.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron, gold, copper, tin, lead, osmium and uranium‌ went all‌ the‌ way to‌ five. Aluminum, nickel, silver, zinc and‌ mithril </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>stopped‌ dead‌ at two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, no‌ matter how much machinery‌ you‌ had bolted together.</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Still‌ Not A‌ Shortcut</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Do‌ the‌ arithmetic. One ore block‌ through‌ Crushing Wheels‌ gives‌ 1.75‌ crushed, and that‌ becomes 2.63 clumps, against </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>3.00</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> if‌ you had‌ simply thrown‌ the‌ ore‌ block into‌ the Purification‌ Chamber to begin‌ with.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Crusher‌ tells the same story: 1.97 dust‌ the long‌ way, against </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>2.00</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> direct. Going through Create‌ always‌ loses. It just‌ no‌ longer loses </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>everything</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Your old stockpile‌ is‌ worth something again, and‌ that‌ Create‌ ore farm‌ you‌ already built keeps‌ paying rent while you‌ tech‌ up.
[!danger] There is no‌ loop hiding‌ here. Nothing in‌ the‌ pack‌ turns an‌ ingot, dust‌ or clump back into‌ crushed ore, so‌ you‌ cannot run‌ it in‌ a‌ circle.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Crushing Wheels‌ turn raw‌ ore into‌ Crushed‌ Raw‌ Iron and‌ its siblings. Those‌ had exactly two‌ futures: smelt them‌ for one ingot, or wash them‌ for nine‌ nuggets. Both come out‌ to </grad><grad from=#8A8A8A to=#6E6E6E f=0.8>1.00x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>So‌ the day‌ you‌ outgrew Create, every chest of‌ crushed‌ ore in your‌ base‌ quietly‌ became worth‌ less‌ than the raw‌ ore you fed in. That‌ was‌ the worst dead‌ end in‌ the pack.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Where‌ It‌ Goes‌ Now</shadow></grad>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Immersive‌ Engineering‌ Crusher takes one crushed‌ ore and‌ gives‌ one dust, plus‌ a </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>12.5%%</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shot at‌ a‌ second.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#B7E4FF f=0.6>Nothing Is Wasted</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>House Rules</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five‌ thousand FE‌ a‌ craft, all‌ three</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Some‌ of the‌ best crafting‌ stations‌ in‌ this pack‌ have‌ one thing wrong with‌ them: you have‌ to‌ stand next‌ to them. Three‌ of‌ them‌ now have‌ a machine that does‌ it‌ for you.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A craft‌ takes </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>exactly‌ as long as it‌ does by‌ hand</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, never‌ less</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The hand‌ version is‌ never‌ removed‌ and never‌ nerfed</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Getting your evenings back‌ is‌ the whole reward. It‌ runs at‌ night, it runs‌ while‌ you‌ are mining, and it‌ does‌ not need‌ you‌ to‌ click anything.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Take‌ the real‌ device, </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>build‌ it‌ into a structure</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, wall‌ it‌ in with‌ that‌ mod's‌ own blocks, bolt‌ on a controller‌ with ports‌ for items, power‌ and‌ whatever‌ fluid the‌ job needs.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ device is the‌ gate. You cannot‌ build any of these without‌ already owning‌ the thing it‌ automates, so‌ none of‌ them‌ skip a step.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.bridges.quest39C55C83E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Harvesting‌ a‌ mature plant‌ by hand gives‌ one bloom‌ and about‌ 1.57‌ seeds, and‌ that spare‌ seed is‌ how a field‌ grows. The Insolator‌ gives </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>double the bloom</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> but returns exactly‌ one seed, so‌ your field never‌ expands‌ on its‌ own.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That‌ is the trade. The Insolator‌ is‌ for a farm‌ you‌ already‌ finished building. Power‌ and‌ water both sit‌ at </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>2x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> the Thermal baseline.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Magebloom Crop‌ still‌ only comes from‌ the Enchanting‌ Apparatus and‌ four‌ Source‌ Gems, so nothing‌ about‌ Ars progression moved. Thermal only‌ grows what‌ Ars‌ has already‌ seeded.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ robe, every‌ thread and half‌ the‌ utility‌ blocks in‌ Ars‌ Nouveau want </grad><grad from=#C08CFF to=#8A5BFF f=0.8>Magebloom Fiber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Four‌ fiber per bloom, one bloom‌ per‌ mature plant, and the‌ plant only‌ grows outdoors.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There‌ is‌ no‌ Ars machine‌ that‌ farms it. You walk a‌ field with‌ a‌ hoe. Strange ask‌ from a‌ mod‌ whose‌ whole identity‌ is automation golems.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Thermal‌ Phytogenic Insolator now‌ takes Magebloom‌ Crop as‌ a‌ seed‌ and gives you </grad><grad from=#C08CFF to=#8A5BFF f=0.8>two‌ Magebloom</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus‌ the seed‌ back.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C08CFF to=#F0D9FF f=0.6>Magebloom Under Glass</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Crushing Wheels‌ give </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>1.75x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and the‌ Crusher and Pulverizer‌ give </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>2x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Exactly the‌ rungs those machines give iron.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Why‌ They Stop‌ At 2x</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mekanism's 3x, 4x‌ and‌ 5x tiers‌ run‌ on clumps, shards and crystals, and‌ those‌ items only exist‌ for‌ the‌ metals Mekanism‌ itself‌ ships. There is no‌ honest way to reach‌ them‌ for a foreign‌ metal without‌ inventing new‌ items, so‌ these‌ eight cap‌ out‌ at 2x. That is a‌ real ceiling, not‌ something‌ that got‌ forgotten.</grad></shadow>
[!note] Ad Astra‌ already‌ had‌ Crushing Wheels‌ support and only gained‌ the‌ other two rungs. Its‌ deepslate ores‌ still crush‌ best‌ in‌ Create, same as vanilla‌ iron‌ does.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron reaches </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>five times</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> its‌ ore. So do‌ copper, gold, lead, tin, osmium and‌ uranium. Meanwhile‌ eight‌ other ores‌ in‌ this pack had </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>no processing‌ recipe at‌ all</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. ftbquests.chapter.bridges.quest3DCCE6451: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Raw‌ Uraninite gives </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>one‌ dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ a‌ 33%% chance at a‌ second</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Round‌ tripping is‌ pointless‌ by‌ design. A uranium‌ ingot costs 30,000‌ FE to‌ become uraninite‌ and‌ comes‌ back as‌ exactly one‌ dust, which is one‌ ingot. You burn‌ the power and gain nothing, so‌ there is‌ no loop worth‌ running.</grad></shadow>
[!success] What‌ you do‌ gain‌ is simple. Uraninite veins are‌ now‌ a uranium source, and‌ uranium‌ veins‌ were already‌ a‌ uraninite source. Whichever one‌ your world rolled, both mods‌ work.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Powah‌ generates Uraninite‌ Ore. Immersive Engineering and Mekanism generate‌ Uranium Ore. Same‌ element, and they never‌ once‌ spoke to‌ each‌ other.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Powah half knew this‌ already. Its‌ Energizing Orb turns‌ a‌ uranium‌ ingot into‌ uraninite‌ for 30,000 FE. The‌ road back did not‌ exist, so‌ if your world‌ handed you‌ a uraninite‌ vein‌ you‌ had a‌ pile‌ of reactor fuel and‌ no way‌ to‌ press a‌ single uranium‌ plate.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Immersive Engineering‌ Crusher now takes both‌ Powah‌ uraninite forms.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Uraninite gives </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>one‌ uranium dust</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Why Create‌ Is‌ Last</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Crushing Wheels need no‌ power‌ grid, no multiblock and‌ no‌ chemistry. You‌ can run‌ them‌ off a windmill‌ on day three. You pay‌ for‌ that convenience in‌ yield, which is‌ a fair‌ trade‌ and‌ always was.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ore </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> tell‌ the‌ same story. Create gives 1.75, Thermal‌ and IE‌ give‌ 2, and the‌ four Mekanism‌ tiers‌ give‌ 2, 3, 4 and‌ 5.</grad></shadow>
[!note] Nothing here was rebalanced. The‌ mod‌ authors already had‌ this right. It‌ was just‌ never‌ written‌ down anywhere, so it‌ read‌ like four‌ machines‌ doing‌ one job.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Create, Immersive Engineering, Thermal and‌ Mekanism will‌ all‌ process your‌ ore. That looks‌ like‌ four‌ mods arguing‌ over the same job. They‌ are‌ not. They sit on‌ a ladder, and‌ every rung‌ above‌ you‌ is genuinely better‌ than‌ the one‌ you‌ are‌ standing on.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>These‌ are the real‌ numbers, read straight‌ out of‌ the‌ recipe‌ files.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.bridges.quest419550A50: # <grad from=#FF8C46 to=#FFECBE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Herbs‌ With No Use</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Per‌ essence that works‌ out to‌ one Source‌ Gem, half‌ a‌ Magebloom, two and‌ a‌ half dried herbs and </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>zero‌ Source</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. You are‌ paying‌ for magical‌ energy with‌ farm‌ labour, which‌ is exactly‌ what a witch does.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Source‌ Gems keep Ars‌ gated. The dried‌ herbs keep‌ Hexerei‌ gated, because‌ you need the‌ willow‌ farm, the drying‌ racks‌ and‌ a heated‌ cauldron before a‌ single essence‌ exists.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Conjuration Essence‌ was‌ picked‌ on theme. If‌ you want‌ the other six‌ bridged the‌ same way, that is a one‌ file change.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hexerei‌ grows five‌ herbs, dries them‌ on‌ racks, and‌ then has almost‌ nothing‌ to spend‌ them‌ on. It‌ is the‌ loneliest mod in‌ the pack, a‌ whole farming‌ chain‌ feeding‌ a very‌ short recipe‌ list.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ars Nouveau, meanwhile, locks most‌ of its‌ good gear behind </grad><grad from=#C08CFF to=#8A5BFF f=0.8>Essences</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, each one costing‌ a Source‌ Gem, three reagents and‌ 2,000‌ Source at‌ the‌ Imbuement Chamber.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In a‌ heated‌ Mixing Cauldron full‌ of‌ water:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All‌ five dried‌ herbs, one‌ Magebloom and two‌ Source Gems give </grad><grad from=#C08CFF to=#8A5BFF f=0.8>two Conjuration‌ Essence</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C08CFF to=#F0D9FF f=0.6>The Witch's Distillation</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bridges.quest41B61646A: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Soul‌ sand‌ gave quartz‌ and gold. Now also </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>sulfur</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Red sand‌ gave‌ gold and dead‌ bushes. Now also </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>ruby</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ rate is‌ one‌ Create‌ already uses somewhere‌ on‌ this line, and‌ every‌ old‌ payout is‌ still there. Nothing was‌ traded away.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cobble generator‌ into‌ a‌ millstone gives‌ gravel. Gravel under‌ crushing wheels gives‌ sand. Fan through‌ water across both. Then go do‌ something else.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is slow on‌ purpose. The‌ point is‌ that‌ it </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>never stops</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Red sand and‌ soul‌ sand do not‌ regrow. Ruby‌ and‌ sulfur are‌ capped‌ by what you‌ actually go and dig, which‌ is‌ deliberate.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ fan‌ blowing through‌ water‌ washes things. It always‌ paid a little. Now it‌ pays‌ enough that </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>pointing a‌ cobblestone generator‌ at it‌ is‌ worth‌ the effort</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gravel‌ gave flint and iron‌ nuggets. Now also </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>zinc‌ and‌ nickel nuggets</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sand‌ gave clay. Now‌ also </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>apatite</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.bridges.quest41D7C0B3E: # <grad from=#5AB9FF to=#B7E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>No Ore‌ Left Behind</shadow></grad>

## <grad from=#FF9E1F to=#FFC46B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Two‌ That Were‌ Just‌ Wrong</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two Create‌ recipes paid‌ out </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>less‌ than‌ mining the‌ block yourself</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Processing an ore‌ should‌ never lose you‌ material. Both corrected.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Terramity's‌ ruby and‌ sapphire‌ ore‌ blocks were never‌ tagged‌ as ores. The‌ gems‌ were, the‌ storage blocks‌ were, the actual ore‌ was not. Four‌ ore blocks‌ that‌ no‌ machine in‌ the pack‌ would accept. Fixed.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Nothing removed, nothing‌ made pricier. Every‌ route that worked before works‌ exactly the‌ same.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty‌ two materials‌ in‌ this‌ pack come‌ out of‌ the ground. Twenty one‌ combinations of‌ a material and a machine </grad><grad from=#5AB9FF to=#5096FF f=0.8>had‌ no recipe‌ at all</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. You put‌ the‌ ore in‌ and‌ the machine just sat‌ there.</grad></shadow>
