ftbquests.chapter.enigmatic_charms.quest: ## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Ocean‌ Monument‌ Solver</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any‌ water you‌ walk into is instantly‌ absorbed‌ in a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> block radius‌ around you.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Sponge, a Nautilus‌ Shell, a‌ Heart‌ of the Sea, an‌ Eye‌ of Ender‌ and‌ a‌ Ghast Tear.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Wear‌ this while raiding‌ a monument‌ and the‌ whole‌ building‌ drains itself‌ as you‌ swim through it.
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Water‌ simply stops.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Extrapolated Megasponge</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Tightest Slot‌ In The Mod</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Cradle of‌ Rebirth</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds‌ one more on top‌ of that.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Nothing‌ here‌ is mandatory. Pick‌ the one‌ charm‌ that‌ fixes the‌ problem you actually have‌ and‌ move on.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Charms‌ are the‌ widest category here and you‌ begin with‌ a single slot‌ for‌ all of‌ them. Getting‌ more room is a‌ whole‌ project.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Bottle of Ichor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds‌ one‌ permanently.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Enchanter's‌ Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds one‌ while‌ worn, if you are‌ cursed.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Potioneer's Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds one while‌ worn, if‌ you are virtuous.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Charming‌ Insignia</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds one‌ on the‌ light‌ aligned‌ version.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>You start‌ with exactly‌ one slot.</grad>
One slot, many opinions
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Charms</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Visiting‌ From Another Chapter</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enigmatic Delicacy‌ has‌ its own questline. This‌ charm‌ lives‌ here because‌ it‌ goes in the‌ charm slot and hiding‌ it‌ would be silly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold‌ Shift on‌ the item‌ for‌ the‌ full list‌ of‌ what it does.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Belongs to‌ Enigmatic Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Hungry Charm</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Combat Charm</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+25 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage against‌ undead.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+10‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage against other‌ hostile‌ creatures.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Looting.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Monsters‌ drop double‌ experience.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A‌ Skeleton Skull, a Soul‌ Lantern, Blaze Powder, a Bottle o' Enchanting‌ and‌ a Netherite Ingot.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>For‌ people who‌ fight things.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Emblem of Monster Slayer</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Free One</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ very first‌ vanilla‌ chest‌ you ever‌ loot in‌ a world hands‌ you one‌ of these. Exactly one, ever.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It sits there‌ doing nothing‌ until you decide‌ to‌ awaken it, which‌ the‌ item warns you is‌ a‌ bad idea in‌ the‌ most‌ ominous way‌ it‌ can manage.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Once awakened‌ it reveals the true‌ name‌ of any player‌ wearing a‌ Charming Insignia, and‌ something‌ starts‌ paying attention‌ to‌ you. That second part is‌ mostly flavour. Mostly.
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Do‌ not‌ wake it‌ up. Or do.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Dormant Eye</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Aggressive‌ Insignia</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack Damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+16 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack‌ Speed.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+5‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Movement Speed.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ item's‌ own tooltip refuses to‌ explain‌ itself beyond one‌ sarcastic‌ line, which‌ is very‌ much‌ on brand for‌ this addon.</grad></shadow>

[!warn] It cannot share‌ your‌ inventory with the‌ Emblem of‌ Adventurer, it locks‌ itself‌ in‌ place once‌ equipped, and‌ it goes on a‌ 30 second‌ cooldown‌ the moment‌ you put‌ it‌ on. Cursed‌ players get‌ a full minute instead.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Maybe‌ a‌ bit different from‌ usual.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Insignia of Despair</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Enchanting‌ Table‌ Cheat Code</shadow></grad>
[!danger] This one will‌ not‌ go in‌ the‌ slot unless you are‌ wearing‌ the Ring of‌ the‌ Seven‌ Curses.
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Charm Slot‌ while worn.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>More‌ enchantments, at higher‌ levels.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Both‌ curses‌ and treasure enchantments‌ can‌ now roll‌ from‌ the‌ table.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You no‌ longer need Lapis‌ Lazuli to‌ enchant. At all.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Curses‌ rolling‌ from‌ the table‌ is a‌ feature if you‌ are also‌ wearing the Scroll of a‌ Thousand Curses. Free‌ stats.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Free enchanting, plus‌ a‌ slot.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Enchanter's Pearl</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Visiting‌ From‌ Another Chapter</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enigmatic‌ Delicacy has‌ its‌ own‌ questline. This charm‌ lives here because it‌ goes‌ in the charm‌ slot and‌ hiding it‌ would‌ be‌ silly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold Shift on‌ the‌ item for‌ the‌ full‌ list of‌ what it does.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Belongs‌ to Enigmatic‌ Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Gluttony Charm</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Fire Charm</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Immune to‌ most fire‌ damage, and‌ you can‌ walk on‌ lava.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Standing‌ in‌ lava heals‌ you.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lifesteal when you‌ hit‌ a burning target.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance to‌ shrug off‌ an‌ attack‌ entirely.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Wants a Purified‌ Heart‌ and a‌ Blazing‌ Core, so‌ you are‌ giving up a‌ spellstone to‌ build it.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Lava‌ is‌ now‌ a swimming‌ pool.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Charm of Scorched Sun</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Bound‌ On First Touch</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ Enigmatic‌ Amulet plus‌ a‌ Fragment‌ of the‌ Earth and gold‌ nuggets. It binds‌ to the‌ first‌ person‌ who claims‌ it and‌ their fate is‌ then, in the‌ item's own words, preordained.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Which is a‌ very dramatic‌ way of saying‌ it‌ stays yours.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>It‌ picks‌ its owner and never‌ lets‌ go.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Unwitnessed Amulet</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Raid Insurance</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+150 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage‌ against Illagers.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> less damage from‌ Illagers.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ saves you‌ from‌ death and blasts everything‌ around‌ you when it‌ fires.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Totem‌ of Undying, Nefarious‌ Essence‌ and Netherite. It works‌ from the inventory or‌ a‌ curio slot, so it‌ does not‌ need to‌ be‌ in‌ your hand.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Every‌ single‌ line above is switched‌ off unless‌ you‌ are wearing‌ the Ring‌ of‌ the‌ Seven Curses. It‌ will happily sit in‌ the‌ slot doing nothing.
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>A‌ Totem of‌ Undying you‌ can‌ wear.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Totem of Malice</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Fake Your Own‌ Death</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Instead‌ of‌ dying you‌ recover </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>15‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> health and become‌ Imperceptible for </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>5 minutes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Everyone else‌ sees‌ a death message.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nothing‌ can see‌ or target‌ you‌ while‌ it lasts, players‌ included.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Attacking‌ or touching anything ends‌ it early.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10‌ minute</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown, and‌ it breaks‌ after </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> uses.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The mod‌ tags‌ this‌ one as‌ unfinished. It works, but do not‌ build‌ a plan around‌ it.
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Marked as‌ work in‌ progress‌ by‌ the mod itself.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Amulet of Deception</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Visiting From‌ Another‌ Chapter</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enigmatic‌ Delicacy has‌ its own‌ questline. This charm lives‌ here because‌ it goes in the charm‌ slot and‌ hiding it would‌ be‌ silly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold Shift‌ on‌ the item for the‌ full‌ list of what‌ it‌ does.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Belongs‌ to Enigmatic‌ Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Curse Crystal Pendant</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A Self‌ Imposed Challenge</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ cannot‌ break‌ blocks while this‌ is‌ equipped. In exchange‌ you‌ get </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack‌ Damage and </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+10‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack Speed.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holding Shift‌ turns the‌ restriction off, so‌ it‌ is‌ less brutal‌ than it‌ sounds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A Diamond Sword, emeralds, gold‌ and obsidian.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Stops‌ you mining. On purpose.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Emblem of Adventurer</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A Quiet‌ One</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This amulet has‌ no crafting‌ recipe and no loot table‌ entry in‌ this pack. If you‌ have‌ one, you got‌ it‌ from something else.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ listed‌ here so the‌ collection‌ is‌ complete. Everything it‌ does‌ is written on‌ the item itself.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Hold Shift‌ on‌ the item for‌ details.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Amulet of Ascension</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Trade</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every point‌ of your armour stops‌ working. All‌ of it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every point‌ of damage‌ you deal‌ is‌ doubled.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Once‌ a hit‌ takes‌ a target below </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>75 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ its health, or </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for‌ a cursed‌ target, it deals‌ a‌ chunk‌ of extra‌ damage and heals you.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] There‌ is‌ a 60 second‌ cooldown after‌ equipping it, so‌ you‌ cannot‌ swap this in‌ mid‌ fight.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This pack‌ rewrote‌ the‌ recipe. Hellspec Alloy‌ Ingots around two‌ Netherite Swords.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] This‌ one will‌ not‌ go‌ in the‌ slot unless‌ you are wearing‌ the Ring‌ of the Seven Curses.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Double damage. Zero‌ armour.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Charm of Hell Blade</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Rename‌ Yourself</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Rename‌ the‌ insignia in‌ an‌ anvil and that name‌ replaces your‌ nametag‌ above your‌ head. You can‌ also‌ see‌ your own‌ tag, which no other item‌ lets‌ you do.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift and‌ right click‌ toggles seeing‌ your‌ own‌ tag.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Desert pyramid chests‌ are‌ the only‌ place‌ it‌ generates, and the‌ light aligned version‌ also adds‌ a charm‌ slot.
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Purely‌ cosmetic, and‌ people love‌ it.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Charming Insignia</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Missing Health‌ Is A Resource</shadow></grad>
[!warn] At full‌ health it does absolutely‌ nothing. At‌ one heart it‌ is the‌ strongest charm‌ in‌ the‌ mod.
[!danger] This one‌ will‌ not go in the‌ slot unless‌ you‌ are wearing‌ the Ring‌ of‌ the‌ Seven Curses.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ stat here‌ is multiplied by the percentage‌ of your‌ health pool you‌ are‌ currently missing.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack‌ Damage‌ at full multiplier.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack Speed‌ at‌ full multiplier.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+0.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Movement Speed‌ at‌ full‌ multiplier.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Damage Resistance‌ at‌ full multiplier.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Weaker‌ you get, scarier you get.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Emblem of Bloodstained Valor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Death Stops‌ Costing You</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ entire‌ inventory‌ survives death‌ while‌ this is worn. Experience and‌ Soul Crystals‌ still‌ go, but the‌ gear stays.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack‌ Damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+15‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Lifesteal.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Creatures‌ you look‌ at get slowed and‌ weakened.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Worth‌ more than the‌ Scroll of‌ Postmortal Recall‌ in‌ almost‌ every situation, because it‌ costs‌ you nothing‌ on‌ death.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Keep‌ your inventory‌ when you die.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>The Testament of Contempt</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Visiting‌ From‌ Another Chapter</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enigmatic‌ Delicacy‌ has‌ its own‌ questline. This charm lives‌ here because‌ it goes‌ in‌ the‌ charm slot‌ and hiding‌ it would be‌ silly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold Shift‌ on the item for the‌ full list‌ of what it‌ does.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Belongs‌ to Enigmatic‌ Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Weapon Charm</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Halve‌ Every Anvil Cost</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Forging costs half‌ the experience‌ it should.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your anvils‌ last‌ far longer.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ unenchanted, undamaged‌ tools of the same‌ kind‌ forge into an </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>unbreakable</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> one.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] That‌ last‌ line‌ is not‌ a‌ typo and it‌ is the real reason‌ to‌ make this. A Magic‌ Quartz Ring, a‌ diamond, iron and‌ a‌ Netherite‌ Scrap.
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>Anvils stop‌ being‌ a tax.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Forger's Gem</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Mining, Solved</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+30‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mining‌ speed.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Fortune.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2.15</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> block‌ reach, which is far‌ more‌ useful than‌ it‌ sounds.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Night‌ Vision underground, automatically. Right‌ click the charm‌ to turn‌ that off.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs‌ a‌ Heart‌ of the‌ Earth, so it‌ is not a‌ day one‌ item, but it is usually the‌ first one‌ worth making.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#E86BB4>The charm‌ most‌ people never‌ take‌ off.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E86BB4 to=#FFD1EC f=0.6>Charm of Treasure Hunter</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.enigmatic_curses.quest: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Second‌ Thoughts</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drink‌ it and‌ the Forbidden‌ Fruit‌ is‌ undone. Hunger comes‌ back, healing works properly again, and‌ the‌ Life Force safety‌ net goes‌ away with‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Think‌ carefully. The‌ safety net is‌ the‌ only thing‌ standing‌ between‌ a bad‌ spell rotation and‌ instant death.
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Undo‌ the fruit.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Potion of Redemption</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sworn To The‌ Geo</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Dormant Blasphemy and‌ three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Geo‌ Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in a‌ Hellfire‌ Forge.</grad></shadow>

[gap=3]

## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Being Worthy</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ lot‌ of the best‌ items‌ check‌ a hidden‌ number: the‌ fraction of your‌ total time in the‌ world‌ that you have‌ spent wearing‌ the ring.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ mod‌ ships‌ that threshold‌ at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>99.5‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. [!warn] Taking‌ a long break‌ from the‌ ring drags‌ that‌ percentage‌ back down. It is‌ a‌ running average, not‌ a‌ one‌ time check.

## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Better Escape</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Carry this stone and go looking for death. When you die with it, the Ring of the Seven Curses becomes the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Ring of Redemption</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of shattering.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>How good that ring is depends on how much of your playtime you spent wearing the cursed ring by the moment you die. The stone's tooltip shows your current percentage. Aim for </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>75 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or more if you want to keep using cursed relics.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Purified Heart, Astral Dust, a Heart of the Cosmos and an Unholy Stone.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Compare this with the Unholy Stone, which simply destroys the ring and costs you a Soul Crystal on top.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>A‌ way out‌ that‌ does‌ not destroy the‌ ring.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Holy Stone</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Another‌ Mod's Answer</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enigmatic Delicacy adds its‌ own take‌ on the Soul‌ Crystal. It‌ has its‌ own‌ chapter, and the item explains‌ itself‌ on Shift.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Visiting from‌ Enigmatic‌ Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Cursed Soul Crystal</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sworn To‌ The Holy</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Dormant Blasphemy and‌ three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Holy Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in a Hellfire‌ Forge.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>85‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Life Force‌ cost‌ reduction on every </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Holy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> spell you‌ cast.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Holy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> spell power for‌ every‌ curse‌ enchantment on‌ your‌ gear.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Wearing this means‌ only Holy spells get‌ the‌ discount. Everything else pays‌ full price.
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Holy‌ spells, for a‌ fraction‌ of‌ the cost.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Blasphemy of the Light</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Graded On Suffering</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>45 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: 20 percent less damage taken, 15 percent more dealt, unique mob drops.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>75 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: 25 percent less damage taken, 20 percent more dealt, some cursed relics work again.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>99.5 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: +7 Looting and +7 Fortune, and the ring lasts longer.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Cursed Relics</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Most relics marked Cursed Ones Only stay locked for good, including the Burden of Desolation, the Blasphemies and the Non-Euclidean Cube. The exceptions:</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Any grade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Bulwark of Blazing Pride, Celestial Fruit, Promise of the Earth, Charm of Scorched Sun, Scroll of Thunder Embrace, The Bless and Pact of Dark Night.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>75 percent and up</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Emblem of Bloodstained Valor, Enchanter's Pearl, Twisted Mirror, and tainting Twisted Hearts to craft new cursed relics.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All seven curses are gone. What stays depends on how much of your playtime you had spent in the cursed ring when you died. That grade is locked into the ring for good, so the percentage dropping afterwards does not matter.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Using cursed relics wears the ring down. The tooltip counts the damage, and after five it breaks.
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>There is also a hardcore only ritual hidden in the Holy Stone's tooltip. Good luck.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each step includes everything below it.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>Under 10 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: 5 percent less damage taken. That is all.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: 10 percent less damage taken, 5 percent more damage dealt, Regeneration up to 90 percent health. Regeneration gets faster at every step after this.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>25 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: 15 percent less damage taken, 10 percent more dealt, +4 Looting and +4 Fortune.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>You have changed.</grad>
&dRing of Redemption
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Ring of Redemption</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A‌ Test‌ With‌ Two Answers</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drink‌ it while‌ wearing the ring‌ and having‌ eaten The Forbidden Fruit, and it‌ treats you‌ very well.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drink it‌ as‌ anyone else‌ and‌ you get Wither and‌ Poison‌ for your trouble.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The‌ item's‌ own‌ tooltip actively‌ discourages‌ you from using‌ it. That is the hint.

<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>There‌ is‌ no recipe. It shows‌ up in‌ Overworld dungeon‌ chests, and‌ it‌ is the‌ rarest‌ thing in those tables‌ by a‌ wide‌ margin.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>You'd better‌ not be‌ drinking‌ from‌ it.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Unholy Grail</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A‌ Frying Pan. Obviously.</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each new‌ species you‌ kill‌ with‌ it grants a‌ permanent </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+0.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage‌ and </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+0.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour, up to </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> species.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holding‌ it‌ builds </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Growing‌ Bloodlust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for the‌ cursed, which drains your‌ health but‌ hands back‌ strength‌ and‌ lifesteal. It cannot‌ kill you.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>This‌ pack rewrote the‌ recipe around‌ The Infinitum, a Frying Pan, Abyss Essence‌ and the‌ Curse of Violence.</grad></shadow></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>35</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack Damage, at a‌ very slow‌ swing.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Armor‌ while held.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cooks‌ the meat‌ of‌ anything‌ you kill‌ with it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Doubles as a‌ shield, and‌ eats projectiles while‌ blocking.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Raw‌ and‌ primal hunger‌ given‌ form.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>The Voracious Pan</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Destroying‌ The Ring</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Die‌ in‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Nether</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, in‌ the middle‌ of a big‌ enough lava‌ lake, with this‌ stone‌ in‌ your inventory. The‌ ring is‌ permanently destroyed, and it‌ takes one‌ of your Soul Crystals with‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] This cannot‌ be undone. The ring‌ is‌ gone, the blasphemy‌ slot‌ closes and every relic‌ that‌ needed the ring‌ becomes‌ dead‌ weight.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Covenant of‌ the‌ Seven rewrites the‌ recipe as Nefarious Essence, a‌ Nefarious‌ Ingot and a‌ Twisted Heart.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>The‌ nuclear option.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Unholy Stone</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Blasphemy‌ Slot</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Then‌ Pick An Element</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Dormant‌ Blasphemy‌ plus three matching </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in a‌ Hellfire Forge, drawing </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4,096</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Will, gives‌ you‌ the‌ Blasphemy for‌ that‌ school.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Swearing to one element‌ forsakes the‌ others. You‌ get one‌ slot, so this‌ is‌ a‌ real choice.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wearing the‌ Ring of the‌ Seven Curses‌ opens a‌ slot‌ nobody‌ else has. This‌ is what‌ goes in it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Making‌ One</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop a </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Heart‌ of the Abyss</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into a tier </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Blood‌ Altar and‌ feed it </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Life Points.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] That‌ number‌ is not‌ a‌ typo. You will need a‌ serious‌ Blood Magic setup‌ with‌ capacity‌ runes before‌ this‌ is even possible.
[gap=5]
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Ten‌ million Life Points. Start saving.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Dormant Blasphemy</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Wither Farming</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Kill‌ a Wither‌ while‌ wearing the‌ ring and‌ it‌ drops </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ to 4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ these. There is no other‌ source.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Almost‌ every late cursed‌ recipe wants‌ it, so build‌ a‌ Wither‌ arena somewhere safe‌ and‌ get comfortable.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Torn‌ out‌ of‌ a Wither.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Nefarious Essence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Keep Going</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Dormant Blasphemy‌ eats one. The Burden‌ of Desolation‌ eats one. The Arrogance of Chaos‌ eats one. The‌ Curse of Violence‌ eats‌ one.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You need‌ all‌ five before the Warden‌ will‌ give you anything, so‌ respawn‌ the‌ dragon and‌ go‌ again.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Three dragons in, and‌ counting.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Heart of the Abyss, Again</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sworn‌ To‌ The Fire</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Dormant‌ Blasphemy and‌ three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Fire Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a‌ Hellfire Forge.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>85 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Life‌ Force‌ cost reduction‌ on‌ every </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> spell‌ you cast.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> spell power for‌ every curse‌ enchantment on‌ your‌ gear.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Wearing‌ this means‌ only Fire‌ spells get the‌ discount. Everything else‌ pays full price.
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Fire spells, for a‌ fraction of‌ the cost.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Blasphemy of the Flame</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sworn‌ To‌ The Aqua</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Dormant‌ Blasphemy and three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Aqua Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ a Hellfire Forge.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>85‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Life Force‌ cost reduction‌ on‌ every </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Aqua</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> spell‌ you cast.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Aqua</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> spell‌ power for every curse‌ enchantment on‌ your‌ gear.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Wearing this‌ means only‌ Aqua‌ spells‌ get the‌ discount. Everything else pays full‌ price.
<typewriter><grad from=#E03131 to=#E03131>Aqua‌ spells, for a fraction‌ of the‌ cost.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Blasphemy of the Ocean</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Item‌ Vacuum</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pulls dropped‌ items toward‌ you from </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks away.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holding‌ Shift switches‌ it off, which matters more than‌ it sounds. Sorting‌ a chest room‌ with‌ this on‌ is‌ genuinely painful.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Stop walking over‌ your‌ own drops.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Magnetic Ring</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Trading‌ Ring</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This pack‌ rewrote the recipe. Tau Oil, a‌ Totem‌ of Undying, Fortune books, an‌ Exquisite Ring, Nefarious‌ Essence and‌ a‌ Greed‌ charm.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Villagers never raise‌ prices‌ and never‌ run‌ out‌ of stock.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Merchants‌ stop targeting you, Piglins‌ excluded.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your damage‌ goes up‌ based‌ on‌ how many‌ gems you‌ are carrying.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Raiders now‌ pick you‌ first, and dying deletes every emerald‌ related item‌ you were carrying. Bank‌ your‌ emeralds before‌ a‌ raid.
<typewriter><grad from=#FFD97A to=#FFD97A>Villagers love you. Raiders noticed.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFD97A to=#FFF3CF f=0.6>Ring of Ultimate Luxury</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Armour‌ And Magic Resistance</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Exquisite Ring, a‌ Ghast‌ Tear, lapis and quartz. It‌ gives </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2‌ Armor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>30‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> magic resistance.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic‌ resistance‌ is rare and‌ this pack throws a‌ lot‌ of spells at‌ you, so this‌ stays useful‌ much‌ longer‌ than the‌ price‌ suggests.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It also feeds the‌ Forger's Gem‌ over‌ in the‌ charms chapter.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Quiet, cheap, actually‌ good.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Magic Quartz Ring</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Gold‌ Plated</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An Iron Ring‌ wrapped in‌ gold. While worn, Piglins‌ treat‌ you‌ as neutral‌ even‌ with your helmet off.</grad></shadow>

[!warn] The‌ Ring of‌ the‌ Seven Curses‌ cancels this‌ outright. Its‌ second‌ curse makes‌ neutral mobs hostile no‌ matter‌ what jewellery you‌ own, and the‌ tooltip literally‌ crosses‌ the‌ line out.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ also‌ the base‌ of‌ two‌ much better‌ rings further down‌ this branch.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Piglins‌ decide you‌ are‌ fine, actually.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Exquisite Ring</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Drink‌ The Gods</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same‌ deal‌ as‌ the fruit, but‌ for‌ charms. Drink it and the‌ slot is‌ yours‌ permanently.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It drops‌ out of‌ village‌ temple‌ chests and‌ out of desert pyramid‌ and‌ jungle temple chests. There‌ is no‌ recipe.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The game‌ tracks‌ whether‌ you have ever‌ looted‌ one. Once you‌ have, it‌ stops‌ appearing in‌ chests for you, so‌ exactly one‌ per player.
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Plus‌ one‌ charm‌ slot, forever.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC4E8 to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Bottle of Ichor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>There‌ Is No‌ Etherium Vein</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ will‌ never‌ mine this. It exists‌ in‌ exactly one‌ place, </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>End‌ City‌ treasure chests</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ to 2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per chest.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Smelt‌ or blast‌ it into‌ an‌ Etherium‌ Ingot. That is‌ the whole‌ loop, and it is‌ why full‌ Etherium gear is a serious‌ End City‌ grind.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Does not generate. Anywhere.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B9E4FF to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Etherium Ore</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Room For‌ A Second‌ Scroll</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Use it and‌ you get‌ another arcane scroll slot. Given how‌ strong scrolls‌ are in this‌ mod, that‌ is a‌ big‌ deal.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This pack replaced the‌ recipe‌ with eight </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Blank Voids</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> around‌ a‌ copy‌ of The‌ Acknowledgment.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Two‌ more scroll slots‌ exist later, hidden behind the‌ very‌ end of both‌ paths.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Plus one‌ arcane scroll‌ slot.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC4E8 to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Tome of Void</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Three‌ Piles Of‌ Stuff</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This chapter is‌ the plumbing. Nothing‌ here is flashy, and skipping it‌ means half‌ the later chapters‌ look‌ like nonsense.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On‌ the‌ left, the ring family. Every one‌ of‌ them grows out‌ of‌ a‌ plain Iron‌ Ring.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In‌ the middle, the raw‌ materials. Astral Dust and Etherium‌ show‌ up in most‌ of the‌ good recipes.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On‌ the‌ right, the‌ three items‌ that‌ permanently give you another‌ slot.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Rings are‌ the‌ only slot‌ you get‌ two‌ of‌ for free. Choose‌ what lives in them‌ carefully, because‌ swapping mid fight‌ is not‌ a thing.
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Boring‌ on‌ purpose. Everything‌ else stands on‌ it.</grad>
Start here
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Foundations</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What‌ It‌ Builds</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Etherium is‌ the‌ material behind the invisible‌ armour‌ set, the area mining‌ tools‌ and‌ the Dimensional‌ Anchor.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nine‌ nuggets make an‌ ingot and nine ingots‌ make‌ a block, both of‌ which uncraft, so‌ nothing is‌ ever‌ wasted.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ whole gear‌ tree‌ lives in its own‌ chapter, </grad></shadow>
Etherium and Arms
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>The best‌ metal‌ in the‌ mod.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B9E4FF to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Etherium Ingot</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Handle</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Blaze‌ Rod, an‌ Ender Pearl‌ and Astral Dust. It is‌ not‌ a weapon or‌ a tool, it‌ is the‌ stick‌ that‌ every Etherium tool‌ is‌ built on.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ turns‌ up in‌ the Astral Spear, the‌ Dragon Breath‌ Bow, the Curse‌ Carver‌ and‌ the Etherium‌ Core, so make‌ several.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Every Etherium tool‌ needs two.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B9E4FF to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Ender Rod</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Portable Storage</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Opens‌ your Ender‌ Chest from‌ anywhere, either‌ through‌ the accessory screen‌ or‌ a keybind.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron‌ Ring, an‌ Ender‌ Chest, an Ender‌ Pearl and some‌ gold.</grad></shadow>
[!info] If you‌ end up‌ wearing‌ the‌ Ring of‌ the Seven‌ Curses, it does this‌ for free‌ and you can put the‌ ring slot‌ to better use.
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Your‌ Ender‌ Chest, in your‌ pocket.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Ring of Ender</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Cheapest Thing‌ In‌ The‌ Mod</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron ingots‌ and iron nuggets. That‌ is it. It‌ gives you </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1‌ Armor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and, far‌ more‌ importantly, it is‌ the middle‌ ingredient of almost‌ every ring‌ that follows.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They also show up‌ in Overworld‌ dungeon chests, so you‌ may‌ already have‌ one‌ rattling around.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>If you ever‌ regret‌ it, blasting an Iron‌ Ring‌ in‌ a furnace‌ gives‌ the ingot back.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>The‌ seed of every other‌ ring.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Iron Ring</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Eat‌ It, Keep The Slot</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Consuming this‌ permanently‌ gives you a‌ third ring‌ slot. It does‌ not‌ sit‌ in an accessory‌ slot, it‌ just changes‌ you.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The‌ base‌ game only‌ hands this out‌ once, from the‌ first End‌ City‌ treasure‌ chest you‌ ever open, and‌ only if you‌ are wearing‌ the Ring of the Seven‌ Curses at‌ the time.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This pack‌ adds‌ a Bio‌ Forge‌ recipe for a </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Slice of‌ Celestial‌ Fruit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out of Astral‌ Dust, Hearts‌ of‌ the Cosmos‌ and‌ a Forbidden Fruit, so‌ the virtuous are not‌ locked‌ out completely.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Plus one‌ ring slot, forever.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC4E8 to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Celestial Fruit</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Respawn‌ Where You Like</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Respawn Anchor, End‌ Stone, Eyes of‌ Ender, an Etherium Ingot‌ and‌ an Eye‌ of‌ the Nebula. It works in‌ every‌ dimension, not just the‌ Nether.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ runs‌ on Ender‌ Pearls‌ instead of Glowstone, and‌ has a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>35 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance to‌ not‌ spend a charge‌ when you‌ actually respawn.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Setting‌ this‌ up‌ in the‌ End‌ before a long Etherium‌ run saves‌ a‌ lot of‌ walking.
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>A respawn‌ anchor‌ that‌ works everywhere.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B9E4FF to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Dimensional Anchor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A‌ Panic‌ Button You Wear</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ softens the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>First Curse</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> by </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>25 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ is the‌ single‌ best thing‌ a cursed‌ player‌ can‌ put in‌ a ring slot early‌ on.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The‌ recipe wants a‌ Purified Heart, a‌ Heart of‌ the‌ Cosmos, a‌ Twisted Heart and‌ two‌ kinds of‌ golden‌ apple, so‌ this is‌ not an early‌ game ring.</grad></shadow></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any‌ single‌ hit‌ worth </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>80 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ your‌ health or more‌ gets blocked outright. Then it‌ goes‌ on a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50 second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Armor</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Armor‌ Toughness</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Mining‌ Speed</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>25 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage‌ resistance‌ across‌ the board</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#B6EE86>Eats‌ one big‌ hit, then‌ sulks‌ for 50‌ seconds.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#EAFFD6 f=0.6>Promise of the Earth</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Upgrade Of‌ The‌ Magnetic‌ Ring</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Instead of‌ dragging‌ items toward you, this‌ one puts them straight‌ into‌ your inventory the‌ moment they‌ exist, anywhere within </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Made‌ from‌ the‌ Magnetic Ring‌ plus‌ an Eye of Ender, gold‌ and lapis.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Shift‌ still‌ disables it. Keep‌ the habit, because‌ this‌ range‌ covers most‌ of a mining branch.
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Not‌ a‌ vacuum. A teleport.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Dislocation Ring</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Primal Catalyst</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Astral‌ Dust only comes‌ out of </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>End‌ City treasure chests</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the ones the‌ shulker guards‌ at the top‌ of‌ the tower. It‌ is‌ very common in them, usually </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ to‌ 4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at a time.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nine‌ of‌ them‌ compress into‌ a‌ Sack of Astral‌ Dust, and it uncrafts again, so‌ storage‌ is not a‌ problem.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Wearing the‌ Ring of‌ the‌ Seven‌ Curses adds‌ a‌ 20 percent Astral Dust‌ drop to‌ every‌ Shulker you‌ kill yourself. That‌ is‌ the‌ only farmable‌ source in the game.
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>End‌ City‌ treasure, and nowhere else.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B9E4FF to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Astral Dust</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Foundations</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.enigmatic_legacy.quest: ## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ In Game Manual</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Book‌ and‌ a Lantern‌ in‌ the crafting grid. That‌ is the entire recipe.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ fills‌ in as you‌ play. Every item‌ you touch‌ adds‌ its‌ page, so early‌ on‌ it looks almost empty‌ and by‌ the‌ end it‌ is enormous.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] This‌ questline‌ and‌ the book‌ are meant to be‌ read‌ together. The book knows‌ every recipe, the‌ questline knows‌ why‌ you‌ would want any‌ of‌ it.
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It also‌ shows‌ up‌ later as‌ a crafting ingredient‌ in a‌ few very‌ rude‌ weapons.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>One‌ book and‌ one lantern!</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>The Acknowledgment</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Magenta Amulet</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You spawn‌ into the‌ world already‌ holding‌ one‌ of these, and the‌ colour‌ you get‌ is‌ random. It‌ sits in‌ the necklace slot‌ and gives </grad><grad from=#FFA5E8 to=#FFFFFF f=0.8>minus‌ 25 percent‌ Gravity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There‌ are‌ seven colours. Trading‌ with other‌ players is the‌ only sane‌ way to collect the rest, and‌ yes, people do‌ actually do this.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The‌ amulet‌ has no‌ recipe. Ever.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FFA5E8 to=#FFA5E8>Collect‌ all seven, obviously.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFA5E8 to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>Enigmatic Amulet: Magenta</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What‌ Is This‌ Mod?</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enigmatic Legacy bolts‌ four brand‌ new accessory slots onto your‌ inventory and‌ then spends the‌ rest‌ of its‌ life‌ filling them. </grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Start‌ Here</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Grab the guide‌ book, learn‌ what the‌ four‌ slots‌ are, then go‌ find a </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Heart of‌ the Earth</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Almost‌ everything in‌ this‌ mod‌ is downstream‌ of that‌ one item.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>After that‌ you get‌ to make a choice you‌ cannot take‌ back. Take your time‌ with‌ it!!</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Rings, charms, arcane scrolls and‌ spellstones. Every‌ single one of‌ them‌ does‌ something loud, and‌ almost‌ none of them‌ are subtle about it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ addons‌ ride along with‌ it here. </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Enigmatic‌ Addons</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds more‌ of‌ everything, and </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Covenant‌ of the‌ Seven</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds‌ the mirror image of‌ the mod's‌ most‌ famous decision.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Whole Questline</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight‌ chapters‌ hang‌ under this‌ one. Click any of them, or‌ use‌ the little icons‌ at the‌ bottom of‌ this‌ page.</grad></shadow>
Foundations
Arcane Scrolls
Spellstones
Charms
Etherium and Arms
Oddities
The Seven Curses
The Seven Virtues
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Four extra‌ slots‌ and one very bad‌ idea.</grad>
woa
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Enigmatic Legacy</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Other‌ Bad‌ Idea</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Monsters drop‌ whatever‌ they were doing‌ and‌ come‌ for you, which‌ is‌ lovely for everyone‌ standing behind you.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You deal </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4‌ percent</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> less‌ damage per point‌ of armour, and‌ zero damage‌ without‌ a‌ full set.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ cannot‌ harm innocent animals. At all.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Once‌ you are‌ chilled, you‌ stay frozen. There‌ is no‌ thawing.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In‌ total‌ darkness you‌ simply stop moving.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Brass Ingots around‌ a </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Divine‌ Pact</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, with a‌ Soul‌ Emerald‌ underneath. This pack‌ wrote that recipe, the‌ mod ships‌ without one.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You cast‌ out‌ of the world's </grad></shadow><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Natural‌ Energy</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of‌ mana, and draining‌ it‌ makes‌ the world settle‌ up‌ with you.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Seven‌ Virtues</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Luck.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Block‌ Reach.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Loot‌ chests roll‌ their contents </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>twice</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of‌ once, and </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>four times</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> if‌ you also‌ wear‌ the‌ Grace of‌ the Creator.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Also‌ permanent. Also‌ has‌ exactly one‌ escape hatch, and‌ that one takes‌ patience instead‌ of a Soul Crystal.
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ good potion effect‌ stacks its‌ duration forever.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Unique drops for the‌ divine relics.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Divine‌ Recall, a free teleport‌ to‌ your spawn‌ point‌ whenever you want it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>60‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ any spell damage‌ you‌ take‌ gets redirected‌ into‌ the world instead.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also opens the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Sacrament</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> slot, the mirror‌ of‌ the Blasphemy slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Seven Burdens</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Weapons‌ and tools‌ fight you in‌ melee. Swinging‌ one properly‌ is‌ off the table.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>The‌ same trap, wearing‌ better clothes.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Ring of the Seven Virtues</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Two Rings, One‌ World</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Seven Virtues</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Discipline.</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> You cannot‌ swing a weapon properly, every‌ monster‌ targets you first, you‌ deal less‌ damage the‌ more‌ armour‌ you wear‌ and‌ standing in the dark‌ freezes you‌ in‌ place. In exchange‌ you get‌ huge‌ Luck, huge‌ reach, chests that‌ roll twice and permanent‌ potion‌ effects.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your magic runs‌ on the‌ world's </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Natural Energy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead‌ of‌ mana. Run‌ it dry and‌ the‌ world takes‌ it‌ out‌ on you.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This is‌ the‌ fork the‌ whole mod‌ is‌ built‌ around. Both rings‌ can never be removed‌ once‌ worn, both change how‌ the entire‌ game treats‌ you, and‌ both‌ unlock a shelf‌ of‌ relics nobody‌ else‌ can‌ even hold.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Never‌ wear both. Read the‌ quest between‌ the two‌ rings‌ before‌ you get‌ clever.
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Seven Curses</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Suffering.</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> You take‌ double damage, neutral‌ mobs hate‌ you, your‌ armour‌ barely works‌ and you‌ burn forever. In exchange‌ you get‌ absurd Looting, absurd Fortune, custom drops off‌ almost every‌ vanilla mob and‌ access‌ to relics‌ built‌ out of them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your magic‌ runs‌ on </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Life Force</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of‌ mana. Run‌ out‌ and you‌ die.</grad></shadow>
Open The Seven Curses
Open The Seven Virtues
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Read both‌ before you touch‌ either.</grad>
I understand the choice
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>Which Path Do You Choose?</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Violet Amulet</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You spawn into‌ the‌ world already holding‌ one‌ of‌ these, and the‌ colour‌ you get is‌ random. It sits in the‌ necklace‌ slot and gives </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#FFFFFF f=0.8>plus‌ 15 percent‌ Deflect Chance</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They also‌ turn up in‌ Overworld‌ dungeon chests, one‌ or‌ two at a time, as‌ long‌ as the chest‌ is‌ not‌ underwater.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight fragments‌ in‌ a crafting grid‌ make one Heart of‌ the‌ Earth. Slow, but it never‌ stops working, and‌ a mob‌ farm‌ below‌ zero prints‌ them.</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#B06BE8 to=#E3C4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Getting‌ More‌ Room</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Celestial Fruit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> permanently‌ adds a‌ ring‌ slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Bottle‌ of Ichor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> permanently‌ adds a charm slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Tome‌ of‌ Void</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> permanently adds an‌ arcane scroll‌ slot.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The accessory‌ screen gains‌ four new slot types from‌ this mod. They‌ do not share‌ space‌ with anything‌ else, so‌ nothing you already wear‌ is‌ at risk.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Enchanter's Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Potioneer's‌ Pearl</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> each‌ add‌ a charm slot‌ while‌ worn.</grad></shadow>

[gap=5]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There‌ are two more, and‌ they only‌ ever open‌ for‌ one‌ of the‌ two rings‌ at the bottom‌ of this‌ page. Wearing that ring is the‌ key, nothing else‌ opens them.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Ring</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> starts with </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> slots.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Charm</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> starts‌ with </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Arcane‌ Scroll</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> starts‌ at </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>0</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Spellstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> starts at </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>0</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B06BE8 to=#B06BE8>Where all‌ of‌ this actually‌ goes.</grad>
I read the slot list
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C77DFF to=#F0DAFF f=0.6>The Four Slots</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Seriously, Do‌ Not</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>If‌ both‌ rings are‌ ever‌ on your body at‌ the same‌ time, the‌ game starts‌ a countdown‌ and‌ narrates‌ it at‌ you in the action‌ bar.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Lightning‌ lands on you‌ immediately, and again‌ every two‌ seconds. You‌ start‌ drifting upward and‌ the‌ block above‌ your‌ head‌ keeps getting‌ broken so you‌ cannot hide‌ from it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then‌ the‌ effects‌ arrive, one every‌ two seconds, and‌ none of them‌ ever wear‌ off. Glowing, Bad Omen, Mining Fatigue, Weakness, Blindness, Darkness, Nausea.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>After </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16 seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> both rings‌ are destroyed, every‌ bound relic you‌ own‌ is stripped‌ away‌ and you die. Not a‌ normal‌ death. Health set below‌ zero, the‌ whole‌ thing.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] There is‌ no‌ saving throw here‌ and nothing gives the‌ relics‌ back. It is a‌ joke ending‌ the mod‌ put‌ in‌ on purpose, and‌ it‌ works exactly once.
# <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Unless..</shadow></grad>
[!warn] If you‌ are running‌ Chaos‌ difficulty. You can‌ equip them‌ at‌ the‌ same time.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Sixteen‌ seconds. That is all you‌ get.</grad>
I will not do that
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Do Not Wear Both</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Bad‌ Idea</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Neutral creatures‌ turn‌ hostile within </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>24</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks, and‌ can find‌ you‌ through‌ walls within </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ armour is </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>65 percent</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> less effective.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Monsters‌ take‌ less damage from‌ you. This pack‌ sets that‌ penalty‌ to </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>0‌ percent</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so it does‌ nothing‌ here.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>When you‌ catch‌ fire, you‌ burn forever.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ death tears your‌ soul apart.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There is no recipe for‌ this in‌ the base mod, so‌ this‌ pack added‌ one. Dark‌ Metal Ingots around a </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Maledictus‌ Pact</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, with‌ an Orb of‌ the‌ Summoner‌ underneath.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Incurable‌ insomnia. Phantoms are‌ now‌ a‌ lifestyle.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Seven Blessings</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Looting.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Fortune.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+200‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> experience from‌ mobs.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Putting it‌ on‌ is permanent. There are‌ exactly two ways back‌ out‌ later, and both of‌ them are‌ inside the‌ chapter. Neither‌ is‌ cheap.
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+24</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Enchanting Power at‌ an enchanting‌ table.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Unique drops from most vanilla‌ mobs. The next‌ quest lists all‌ of‌ them.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your Ender‌ Chest‌ is always in reach, exactly‌ like‌ the Ring of‌ Ender.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ can‌ hold and‌ use‌ the relics nobody‌ else can.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Two Things The‌ Covenant‌ Changes</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You cast spells‌ out of </grad></shadow><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Life‌ Force</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of‌ mana. Empty‌ the‌ bar and‌ you‌ die on the spot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Spell‌ cooldowns and‌ cast‌ times drop‌ through the‌ floor.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ opens the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Blasphemy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> slot, which‌ is where the elemental‌ relics‌ live.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Seven Curses</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ take </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>200‌ percent</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage from any source, and </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>200‌ percent</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> knockback.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Once worn, it becomes‌ a part‌ of you.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Ring of the Seven Curses</grad></shadow>
