ftbquests.chapter.enigmatic_oddities.que: # <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Useful Junk‌ Drawer</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>None of this‌ goes in‌ an accessory slot. It is the‌ tools, the tomes, the‌ potions and the‌ handful‌ of items‌ that‌ quietly solve a problem‌ you‌ have been ignoring.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enchantment‌ tools‌ that‌ move, strip and‌ upgrade‌ enchantments.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A trash can, a‌ loot box, and a way‌ to‌ write custom lore‌ on anything.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pet‌ books, snacks and‌ a‌ couple‌ of items‌ that‌ exist purely as jokes.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The‌ Mending Mixture‌ and‌ the two‌ transposer tomes‌ are‌ the‌ three most‌ useful things in this‌ chapter. Everything‌ else is optional.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Everything‌ that does‌ not fit‌ in‌ a‌ slot.</grad>
Browsing the junk drawer
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Oddities</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Upgrade‌ Everything At‌ Once</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Combine‌ it‌ with any‌ enchanted item and‌ every enchantment‌ on that‌ item‌ goes‌ up a‌ level. It is‌ allowed to push‌ past the‌ normal maximum.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] It is one use‌ and it‌ wants an Ichor‌ Droplet‌ and a‌ Purified‌ Heart, so it is not‌ something‌ you spam.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Breaks the‌ enchantment‌ level‌ cap.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Tome of Divination</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Nothing Resists‌ Anything</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>While it‌ sits‌ in‌ your inventory, all‌ damage you take and‌ all‌ damage you deal‌ is converted‌ into raw‌ damage‌ that‌ ignores armour, resistance and‌ everything‌ else.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Its recipe‌ is‌ disabled‌ in this‌ pack, on purpose. It broke‌ too much. The‌ quest is‌ optional‌ and‌ here only‌ so you‌ know why you‌ cannot craft‌ it.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Switched off in this pack.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Deceptive Justice</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Write‌ Your Own‌ Item‌ Text</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click to‌ open its screen, drop a‌ Lore‌ Fragment in, and type. Colour‌ and formatting‌ codes both‌ work‌ in‌ the name field.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Start‌ a‌ line with‌ an‌ exclamation‌ mark to‌ add it as‌ a lore‌ line.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Add a‌ number‌ after‌ it to‌ replace a‌ specific line.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A minus‌ in front‌ removes a line instead.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>End City‌ treasure chests‌ carry these, and Astral‌ Dust, ink, a‌ feather, a bottle‌ and‌ Blaze Powder make one.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Custom‌ names‌ and lore on‌ anything.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>The Architect's Inkwell</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Send‌ Something‌ Somewhere</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift‌ and right‌ click while standing where‌ you‌ want the destination‌ to be. The‌ coordinates go‌ on‌ the‌ tooltip.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then left click‌ any‌ living creature‌ and‌ it‌ is teleported‌ there, as long as‌ it is‌ in the‌ same‌ dimension. The‌ eye vanishes‌ afterwards.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Moving a‌ villager, a horse or‌ a stubborn‌ axolotl across your base is‌ exactly what‌ this is for.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>One‌ use‌ mob delivery.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Extradimensional Eye</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>It‌ Does‌ Nothing</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The tooltip says‌ Useless‌ Stone and‌ the‌ tooltip‌ is telling‌ the truth. It has‌ no abilities‌ and no‌ use‌ in‌ any recipe.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ addon gives‌ it Epic rarity‌ and a‌ fireproof flag anyway, which is somehow‌ the funniest‌ part.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Useless Stone...</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Primeval Cube</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Nether‌ Star Money</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Astral‌ Dust, Blaze Powder, an Eye‌ of‌ Ender, a Heart‌ of‌ the Sea and a‌ Nether‌ Star.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It does nothing‌ by‌ itself. It‌ is an‌ ingredient‌ in the Eternal‌ Cake, the Burden of Desolation, The‌ Infinitum, the‌ Arrogance of Chaos, the‌ Holy Stone, the‌ Promise of‌ the‌ Earth‌ and the‌ Curse‌ of Violence.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Make more than‌ one. Every single‌ thing‌ that wants‌ it is‌ worth‌ having.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>A‌ crafting material‌ with a big shopping‌ list.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Heart of the Cosmos</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>It Is A‌ Potato</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A baked‌ potato, Astral Dust and‌ a‌ gold nugget. It‌ restores </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> hunger‌ with </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1.4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> saturation, it never burns, and the‌ game‌ insists it is‌ Epic‌ rarity.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The‌ name promises‌ a‌ lot more than‌ the item delivers, and that‌ is‌ the joke.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Behold, the infinite‌ delicacy of‌ the stars.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Teleportato</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Infinite‌ Recalls</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gaze‌ into it‌ and you‌ go‌ home. Same‌ destination rules‌ as the potion, but it‌ never‌ runs out.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Potion‌ of Recall, a‌ Twisted Heart, a‌ glass‌ pane‌ and iron.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] It only‌ works‌ if you‌ are‌ wearing‌ the Ring‌ of the Seven‌ Curses, and only‌ in the‌ three‌ vanilla‌ dimensions.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>The Potion‌ of Recall, reusable.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Twisted Mirror</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Beetroot, But Divine</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An‌ Ichor‌ Droplet, a‌ beetroot and a‌ Ghast‌ Tear. It carries‌ a‌ small‌ amount of‌ purifying power, which mostly‌ matters to‌ the virtuous‌ side‌ of‌ the mod.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Slightly‌ purifying beetroot.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Ichoroot</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Emergency‌ Exit</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drink‌ it and you are‌ back‌ at your bed‌ or‌ Respawn‌ Anchor. If you‌ have‌ neither, you land at‌ the centre of the‌ Overworld, which‌ is rarely what‌ you wanted.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is brewed, and‌ it‌ also‌ turns up‌ in‌ End City treasure chests.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Go‌ home. Right now.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Potion of Recall</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Blank‌ Page</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Write on‌ it‌ with the Inkwell, then‌ combine it with any‌ item‌ in an anvil‌ and the‌ writing sticks‌ to‌ that‌ item permanently.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Rename‌ your‌ netherite pickaxe something stupid. This‌ is the‌ correct‌ use.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Paper and‌ a stick, again.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Lore Fragment</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Roll‌ Any Loot Table</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click cycles‌ forward through every loot table‌ in the‌ game, Shift and right‌ click‌ cycles back. The‌ current‌ one shows on the‌ tooltip.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift‌ and right click‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>top</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> face‌ of‌ a chest‌ to‌ fill it with‌ loot from the selected‌ table.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Clicking‌ any </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>other face</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> destroys everything‌ inside that‌ chest.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Read that‌ second‌ line‌ again. There is‌ no‌ confirmation and no undo.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>A‌ chest filler, and‌ a‌ chest deleter.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>The One Box</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A Slot Machine‌ You‌ Plant</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It rolls a‌ random attribute‌ and a‌ random‌ potion‌ effect, and spending‌ lapis‌ rerolls them. Attribute rolls can‌ reach </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and effect‌ rolls‌ can reach </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Almost‌ nobody uses‌ this. It‌ is‌ here because‌ it exists and because‌ it‌ is fun once.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Feed‌ it lapis, get‌ a random‌ buff.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Magic Quartz Flower</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Animal‌ Protection</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>While it‌ is‌ in‌ your inventory‌ your attacks do nothing‌ to‌ animals, and Hoglins stop‌ being hostile.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also softens‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Second‌ Curse</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so‌ that tamable animals‌ stay‌ neutral toward‌ you‌ instead‌ of joining‌ the mob.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A book, an‌ apple, a dandelion‌ and gold‌ nuggets. One‌ of‌ the cheapest‌ recipes in‌ the mod.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>You physically‌ cannot hit‌ a cow.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Guide to Animal Companionship</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Curse‌ Removal</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Identical‌ to the other‌ tome, except it only takes‌ curse‌ enchantments. Your item keeps‌ everything good‌ and loses‌ the‌ Binding‌ and Vanishing.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Cursed‌ players‌ should think twice. Curses are‌ worth stats‌ to‌ you, and the‌ Scroll of‌ a‌ Thousand‌ Curses counts‌ every single one.
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A Tome‌ of‌ Hungering Knowledge plus‌ Nefarious Essence, a‌ Ghast Tear, a‌ Phantom‌ Membrane‌ and redstone.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Same trick, curses‌ only.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Tome of Devoured Malignancy</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Star‌ Flavoured</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Effects‌ last </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1.6‌ times</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> as long‌ as‌ normal, on a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2 minute</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown between‌ drinks.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The item's‌ own‌ tooltip warns‌ you not‌ to‌ overdo‌ it, which from‌ this addon is not‌ necessarily‌ a joke.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Do not‌ drink too‌ much.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Potion of Cosmic</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Best Item‌ Nobody Makes</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put‌ it‌ in‌ a crafting‌ grid with any tool, weapon‌ or‌ armour piece and‌ that item‌ comes out‌ at‌ full‌ durability. No experience, no anvil, no‌ rising‌ cost.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blaze Powder, Dragon's‌ Breath, a‌ Ghast‌ Tear, a Glistering‌ Melon Slice, a Phantom‌ Membrane and‌ Prismarine Crystals.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] End‌ City‌ treasure‌ chests are‌ full of‌ these. Loot enough towers‌ and repairing‌ gear stops being a thing‌ you think‌ about.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Full repair, no anvil, no‌ cost.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Mending Mixture</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Not Our‌ Mod</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ one belongs to‌ Enigmatic Delicacy and has‌ its‌ own chapter. It sits‌ next to‌ the tomes‌ because‌ that‌ is where‌ anyone‌ would look for it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Visiting‌ from Enigmatic‌ Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Enchantment Duplicator</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Wider Protection</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your attacks cannot‌ hurt animals, and‌ most‌ animals around‌ you go‌ passive.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Neutral‌ animals‌ will not‌ start fights, even through the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Second‌ Curse</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hit‌ a specific kind‌ of animal‌ with the‌ book‌ itself‌ and that species‌ loses‌ its protection.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Use‌ it‌ to‌ calm everything‌ down again, on a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>60‌ second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The Guide‌ to Animal‌ Companionship, a‌ Heart‌ of the‌ Earth, a Golden‌ Apple and a‌ Bottle o' Enchanting.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>The‌ animal book, upgraded.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Ode to Living Beings</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Enchantment Recovery</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put it‌ in‌ a crafting‌ grid‌ with‌ any enchanted‌ item. Every enchantment jumps‌ off the‌ item and‌ onto‌ the‌ tome, which turns‌ into an‌ Enchanted Book.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The item‌ comes back‌ clean, so this is how you‌ rescue a‌ good enchantment from‌ a‌ bad tool.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A‌ book, lapis, gold, redstone, blaze‌ powder and prismarine crystals. Cheap‌ enough‌ to keep several‌ around.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Pull‌ enchantments‌ off anything.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Tome of Hungering Knowledge</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Book‌ Storage That Counts</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Works‌ like a‌ shared Ender Chest, but only for‌ books. Anything stored‌ inside is treated‌ as‌ if it‌ were‌ in your inventory.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] That last‌ part‌ is the whole‌ point. Guidebooks, handbooks‌ and‌ tomes that‌ work‌ from the inventory‌ keep working while they‌ sit‌ in the bag.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ still functions‌ while the‌ bag‌ itself‌ is inside‌ an‌ Ender Chest, which is quietly‌ ridiculous.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>An Ender‌ Chest‌ for books.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Antique Book Bag</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Damage Redirection</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every point of‌ damage your‌ pets take within </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>24</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ is‌ redirected onto‌ you‌ instead.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Carry the Guide to‌ Animal‌ Companionship as well‌ and‌ that‌ redirected damage‌ is‌ cut by </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Without‌ the other book this‌ is‌ a very effective‌ way to‌ die for‌ a‌ wolf.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Your‌ pets stop‌ dying. You‌ start.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Guide to Feral Hunt</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Farm‌ The Nether Sky</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ Ghast you‌ kill rolls twice for one, at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>6‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and then </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Needed for the‌ Purified‌ Heart, the Tome‌ of‌ Divination, the Scepter of Extradimension, the‌ Ichor‌ Spear and the‌ Scroll‌ of‌ Thunder Embrace. Kill‌ a‌ lot of Ghasts.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Ghasts, and‌ only Ghasts.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Ichor Droplet</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Automatic‌ Deletion</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Craft it‌ together‌ with any item and‌ that‌ item joins its‌ list. From‌ then‌ on it‌ deletes‌ them out of‌ your inventory on its‌ own.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Total‌ Absorption</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> deletes every listed‌ item, always.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Last Stack</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> always‌ leaves one‌ stack‌ of‌ each and‌ deletes‌ the rest.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Excess Absorption</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> only deletes‌ when your‌ inventory‌ is full.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click while‌ holding‌ it‌ to switch‌ modes, Shift and right click‌ to‌ turn it off. Craft‌ it with‌ nothing to‌ wipe‌ the‌ list.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Right clicking it‌ in‌ your inventory‌ while‌ dragging‌ a stack‌ destroys that stack‌ instantly. Careful where‌ you click.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>A‌ trash‌ can‌ that walks‌ with you.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Keystone of The Oblivion</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Infinite Bone‌ Meal</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Works‌ forever, and unlike‌ normal‌ Bone Meal it works‌ on‌ Cactus, Chorus Plants, Nether Wart, Sugar‌ Cane‌ and‌ Vines.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Heart‌ of‌ the Earth surrounded‌ by plants. Covenant of the‌ Seven‌ adds a light‌ aligned version‌ built from‌ Nature's‌ Aura‌ growths instead.</grad></shadow>
[!info] It‌ does‌ not work on absolutely‌ everything in‌ this‌ pack, so do‌ not throw‌ your‌ Bone‌ Meal away‌ just yet.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Bone Meal that‌ never‌ runs out.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Essence of Raging Life</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Pets Get Your Stats</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>While‌ it is‌ in your inventory‌ your‌ pets deal </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+25‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>If‌ you are also wearing‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Emblem‌ of Bloodstained Valor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or‌ the </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#E03131 f=0.8>Scroll‌ of‌ a Thousand‌ Curses</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, your‌ pets receive the‌ same bonuses those give‌ you.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] A‌ pack of wolves‌ inheriting a‌ cursed player's‌ damage‌ multipliers‌ is genuinely‌ absurd. This‌ is a real strategy.
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>Your‌ wolves inherit‌ your‌ build.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>Sanguinary Hunting Handbook</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Infinite‌ Cake</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Much more filling‌ than a‌ normal cake, and‌ it‌ slowly‌ restores its own‌ slices‌ over time. Place‌ it‌ once‌ and never‌ think about food‌ again.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A cake, a‌ Heart of‌ the‌ Cosmos, Astral‌ Dust, Blaze Powder, a‌ Chorus Fruit‌ and a Ghast‌ Tear.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A34A to=#E0A34A>It grows‌ its slices back.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A34A to=#FFE3B8 f=0.6>The Eternal Cake</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.enigmatic_scrolls.ques: ## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Experience‌ As A‌ Stat Stick</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Works like‌ the Scroll‌ of Ageless‌ Wisdom, except‌ your‌ experience level‌ directly feeds‌ your stats, up to‌ level </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Damage bonus‌ caps at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Healing bonus caps at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Knockback‌ resistance caps‌ at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>160</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Orbs give you‌ less‌ experience than‌ normal, and‌ death wipes every level‌ you‌ had. All of it.
[!danger] This‌ one‌ refuses‌ to go‌ in‌ the slot unless‌ you are wearing the‌ Ring‌ of the Seven‌ Curses.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Levels are‌ power. Dying is‌ not.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Scroll of Ignorance Curse</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Death Insurance</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>When you‌ die, your entire‌ inventory is sent to your‌ bed or‌ Respawn Anchor. No bed‌ means‌ the centre‌ of‌ the Overworld.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The scroll itself‌ stays‌ behind at the‌ spot‌ where‌ you died. If‌ that‌ spot was lava, you‌ are buying another one.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blank‌ Scroll, a‌ Potion of Recall, an‌ Eye of‌ the Nebula‌ and‌ a‌ Phantom Membrane.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Your‌ stuff‌ goes home. The scroll does‌ not.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Scroll of Postmortal Recall</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Store‌ Every‌ Level You‌ Own</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ holds an unlimited amount‌ of experience‌ and‌ shows the‌ total on‌ the‌ tooltip.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift‌ and right‌ click toggles it on‌ and‌ off.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click swaps‌ between </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Absorption</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Extraction</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>While active‌ it hoovers‌ up‌ orbs‌ from </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks away.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Absorption drains‌ your‌ bar into‌ the‌ scroll. Extraction‌ pours it‌ back. Dying with it‌ equipped means‌ you keep‌ everything‌ inside.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>An‌ experience bank‌ with no‌ ceiling.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Scroll of Ageless Wisdom</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Full Damage‌ Sweeps</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ sweep attack deals </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>100 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage‌ instead‌ of the usual‌ pathetic‌ fraction, so‌ wide swords‌ finally‌ do something.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Extra damage‌ against armoured targets.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hit the‌ same‌ target enough times‌ and lightning‌ falls on‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Lightning‌ damage‌ against you‌ is‌ halved, and it ignores nearly‌ everything else.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Wants‌ an‌ Ichor Droplet, a‌ Purified Heart, a‌ Darkest‌ Scroll‌ and a‌ Will of the Ocean, so‌ it‌ is a mid‌ to late‌ build.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Sweep attacks‌ stop‌ being‌ a joke.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Scroll of Thunder Embrace</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Not‌ Really Our‌ Chapter</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ one‌ belongs to‌ Enigmatic Delicacy, which‌ has its own‌ chapter. It sits‌ here because it is a‌ scroll and‌ it would be‌ strange‌ to hide‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold‌ Shift on the item‌ itself‌ for what it‌ actually‌ does.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>A‌ guest from‌ Enigmatic‌ Delicacy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Fading Scroll</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Money</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ pack rewrote‌ it as Tau‌ Oil, a Totem‌ of Undying, enchanted golden apples, a Darkest‌ Scroll, Nefarious Essence‌ and a Greed‌ charm.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Fortune.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Piglins go‌ neutral‌ again, even‌ through the‌ second curse, and bartering pays‌ about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>100‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> better.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>15 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance of‌ an emerald‌ from any‌ mob‌ you‌ kill.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Villager trades cost </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>35‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> less.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] This‌ one refuses‌ to‌ go‌ in the‌ slot unless you‌ are wearing‌ the Ring‌ of‌ the‌ Seven Curses.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>The‌ trader's scroll.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Pact of Infinite Avarice</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Hidden Slot</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ do not have‌ an arcane‌ scroll slot right now. It stays‌ at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>0</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> until the‌ first time you‌ hold‌ any scroll, and‌ then‌ it appears and never‌ goes‌ away.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You get exactly‌ one‌ to‌ start. A </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Tome of‌ Void</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds‌ a second, and the‌ very end of both‌ paths‌ adds a third.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Why‌ They Matter</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Scrolls‌ are where‌ flight, infinite‌ experience‌ storage and‌ the‌ damage multipliers live. Most of‌ them are‌ worth‌ more than‌ the armour‌ you‌ are‌ wearing.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] A few‌ scrolls only work for‌ one‌ of the two‌ paths. Those are‌ marked in‌ red‌ further‌ down, so you know‌ before‌ you spend‌ the‌ materials.
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>The‌ strongest slot‌ in the mod, and‌ it starts‌ at zero.</grad>
Read the slot rules
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Arcane Scrolls</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#FFD97A to=#FFFFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Developer's‌ Mark</shadow></grad>
[!info] It is‌ in this‌ questline‌ for‌ completeness. Nobody expects you‌ to‌ have one, and‌ the‌ quest‌ is optional.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There‌ is no‌ recipe‌ and no loot table. It‌ is‌ handed out by‌ the‌ mod‌ author to‌ people‌ who make a‌ pilgrimage to his domain, and‌ that‌ is the entire‌ acquisition method.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Luck‌ and </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Arcane Scroll‌ Slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Etherium‌ armour‌ raises its‌ shield‌ at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>80 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> health instead of </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>40‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Most spellstone‌ cooldowns‌ drop hard, and‌ Etherium tools‌ mine‌ a‌ wider area.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Lethal‌ damage restores you to </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> health‌ with buffs, on a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>60‌ second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FFD97A to=#FFD97A>You‌ cannot craft this‌ one. At all.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFD97A to=#FFFFFF f=0.6>The Architect's Favor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Other‌ Half</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This one has no‌ starting‌ recipe. It only generates‌ in </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Bastion treasure‌ chests</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the ones‌ locked‌ behind‌ the gold‌ blocks, and‌ every single one of‌ those has‌ exactly‌ one.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Once you‌ have one, it‌ copies‌ itself. One‌ Darkest Scroll‌ plus a Blank Scroll, black‌ dye‌ and a Wither‌ Rose gives‌ you two‌ back.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Duplicate‌ a‌ few before you‌ start. The‌ heavy scrolls‌ all‌ want‌ one, and losing‌ your only copy‌ hurts.
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Loot one, then‌ print the‌ rest.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Darkest Scroll</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Flight, Inside A‌ Circle</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ can fly‌ anywhere inside‌ the‌ range‌ of an‌ active </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Beacon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and it slowly eats‌ your‌ experience while you‌ do.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also‌ cancels the‌ mining‌ speed‌ penalty you normally‌ get‌ while flying, which‌ is‌ the‌ whole reason‌ people build beacon‌ platforms.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Covenant of‌ the Seven‌ adds‌ a‌ light aligned‌ recipe using‌ a Brightest Scroll‌ and Sanctified‌ Essence, so the virtuous get one‌ too.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Creative flight‌ with a leash.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Gift of the Heaven</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Bright Places‌ Heal‌ You</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Slowly‌ regenerates health whenever‌ the‌ light level‌ around‌ you‌ is high.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Below </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>40‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> health it also‌ hands you‌ mining speed‌ and‌ lets‌ you eat‌ much faster, which‌ is a strangely‌ practical panic‌ button.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Blank Scroll, a Campfire, leather, gold and wheat.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Rewards‌ standing in‌ the light.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Scroll of Survivor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Underwater, Of‌ All‌ Places</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ocean Ruins, big‌ or small, at </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>40‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per chest, </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1 to‌ 3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at a‌ time.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It does nothing on its‌ own. It is‌ the base of‌ the‌ Scroll of‌ a‌ Thousand Virtues, Mnestia's Raiment and‌ the‌ light aligned Gift‌ of‌ the‌ Heaven.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Unlike the‌ Darkest‌ Scroll it does‌ not duplicate itself, so the‌ ocean‌ is the only‌ supply.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>The Darkest‌ Scroll after‌ therapy.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Brightest Scroll</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Absorb Every‌ Curse‌ You Find</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click‌ other‌ items in‌ your inventory and‌ it swallows‌ their curse‌ enchantments. Each‌ unique‌ curse absorbed‌ makes it‌ stronger, up to </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> absorptions.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hitting the‌ same target‌ repeatedly adds </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>300 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of the previous‌ hit on‌ top.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Attacking during invulnerability‌ frames‌ deals </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>100 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more‌ and‌ heals you for </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ hits stamp weakened‌ versions‌ of‌ the first‌ four‌ curses onto the‌ target.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This pack rewrote the‌ recipe. Heart‌ of the Cosmos, Heart‌ of the‌ Abyss, Nefarious Essence, a‌ Darkest‌ Scroll, a‌ Twisted Heart‌ and‌ a Tome of Devoured‌ Malignancy.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>It eats‌ curses‌ off your‌ gear.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>The Curse of Violence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>A‌ Kill Counter‌ That‌ Pays</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Damage‌ resistance that‌ grows‌ with the number and‌ variety of‌ monsters‌ you have‌ killed while‌ wearing‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ starts at‌ almost nothing, so this is‌ a‌ scroll you commit‌ to early‌ and cash‌ in‌ much‌ later.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Gets tougher the‌ more‌ you kill.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Scroll of Hunter</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Where‌ Half‌ The‌ Scrolls Start</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Paper‌ around a‌ stick. Make a stack‌ of them, because‌ six different scrolls use one‌ as their‌ base.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Holding one also‌ unlocks‌ your arcane‌ scroll‌ slot, so this is the‌ cheapest‌ way to get‌ the‌ slot‌ open early.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Paper‌ and‌ a stick. Genuinely.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Blank Scroll</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Loot Radar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Use‌ it‌ and nearby‌ chests‌ light up for a‌ moment. Range‌ is </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks, cooldown is </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16 seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ gives‌ sneaking speed‌ and‌ softens fall distance, so‌ it is quietly good‌ for‌ exploring ruins.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>Highlights treasure‌ through walls.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Scroll of Explorer</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Actual‌ Free‌ Flight</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Loot‌ chests roll </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>four‌ times</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead‌ of‌ twice. This is‌ the single biggest loot‌ multiplier‌ in the pack.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fly anywhere‌ you‌ like. It burns experience quickly, unless‌ you‌ happen to be‌ inside‌ beacon‌ range, where it‌ costs‌ nothing at all.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Made‌ from the Gift of‌ the‌ Heaven plus Astral‌ Dust, an Etherium‌ Ingot, an Elytra‌ and‌ Dragon's‌ Breath.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>If You‌ Walk‌ With The Virtues</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Extra movement‌ speed and‌ extra‌ swim speed.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#7FA6E8>The‌ leash comes‌ off.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6>Grace of the Creator</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Mirror‌ Of The‌ Cursed‌ Scroll</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Third Burden makes‌ armour cost‌ you‌ damage. This scroll‌ hands it‌ straight‌ back.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack‌ per point‌ of Armor.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack per point‌ of‌ Armor Toughness.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The damage‌ reduction penalty‌ cap drops‌ by </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>20‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Built‌ from a Brightest‌ Scroll‌ surrounded by‌ Nature's‌ Aura‌ tokens, a Clock‌ Hand, a Birth Spirit‌ and a‌ Break Prevention‌ charm.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] This‌ one‌ refuses to‌ go in‌ the slot unless‌ you are‌ wearing the Ring of the‌ Seven Virtues.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Armour‌ becomes damage.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Scroll of a Thousand Virtues</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Curses‌ Become‌ Stats</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Count every curse enchantment‌ on‌ everything you are‌ wearing. That‌ number‌ multiplies all‌ three‌ of these.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack Damage‌ per curse.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Mining Speed per‌ curse.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Health‌ Regeneration per curse.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Binding‌ Curse and‌ Vanishing Curse‌ both‌ count, and‌ the Ring‌ of‌ the Seven Curses is‌ very happy‌ to‌ hand you‌ more of‌ them‌ from‌ an enchanting‌ table.
[!danger] This one refuses to‌ go‌ in the slot‌ unless you‌ are wearing‌ the‌ Ring‌ of the Seven‌ Curses.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF8A8A>Wear‌ bad enchantments‌ on‌ purpose.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E03131 to=#FFAFAF f=0.6>Scroll of a Thousand Curses</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FA6E8 to=#D6E4FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Insomnia‌ Insurance</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Phantoms‌ spawn‌ much less‌ often near you, which‌ is the‌ reason most‌ cursed‌ players‌ carry one.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+20‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Attack Damage</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+16‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Damage Resistance</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+8 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Lifesteal</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wearing‌ it‌ gives </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4 Armor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Wearing‌ it with every armour‌ slot‌ empty gives </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+16 Armor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+4‌ Toughness</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>40 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> explosion‌ resistance instead.</grad></shadow>

[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ocean ruins, shipwreck‌ treasure and‌ buried‌ treasure‌ give the </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Will‌ of the Ocean</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nether fortresses, bastions‌ and‌ ruined portals give‌ the </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Blazing Core</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+12‌ Armor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+10 Toughness</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>35 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance to‌ deflect‌ any attack‌ or‌ projectile.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Anything that‌ touches‌ you starts‌ freezing.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Frozen targets‌ take‌ more‌ damage and‌ can barely move.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>30 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> projectile‌ and‌ sonic damage resistance.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#3FC5D8 to=#3FC5D8>Freeze the room.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FC5D8 to=#C6F6FD f=0.6>Forgotten Ice Crystal</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FC5D8 to=#C6F6FD f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Mobility</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Press‌ jump in mid‌ air‌ and you‌ get‌ launched wherever you are‌ looking, on‌ a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2 second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No fall‌ damage‌ and‌ no collision‌ damage, ever.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>50‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance to deflect‌ incoming projectiles.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your own arrows‌ fly‌ much faster.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] You become‌ vulnerable to‌ Withering and‌ to‌ Void‌ damage. Falling out‌ of‌ the world is now‌ a real‌ way‌ to die.
<typewriter><grad from=#3FC5D8 to=#3FC5D8>Double‌ jump, forever.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FC5D8 to=#C6F6FD f=0.6>Angel's Blessing</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FC5D8 to=#C6F6FD f=0.6>Spellstones</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.enigmatic_virtues.ques: ## <grad from=#B6EE86 to=#EAFFD6 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Build This‌ First</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything on‌ this‌ side‌ runs through‌ Nature's Aura. You need an‌ altar, an‌ aura field to‌ draw from, and‌ eventually a </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Conversion‌ Catalyst</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> underneath‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Nature's‌ Aura has its‌ own‌ chapter and‌ its‌ own‌ in game‌ book. Read that first‌ if any‌ of this‌ looks‌ unfamiliar.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop‌ an item‌ on the‌ altar, feed it aura, wait. That‌ is the‌ entire interface.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#B6EE86>Where the whole path‌ starts.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#EAFFD6 f=0.6>Nature Altar</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Attack‌ To‌ Restore</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Restores‌ its hunger‌ and‌ clears its aggression.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ and it‌ fires‌ a projectile‌ that lights‌ up‌ wherever‌ it lands.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Read‌ that list again with‌ a‌ teammate in mind. In‌ multiplayer this‌ is a‌ healing‌ weapon, and‌ it is very‌ good‌ at it.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hitting a target with‌ this‌ does all of‌ the‌ following‌ to that‌ target.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Restores‌ its health completely.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Restores‌ its armour durability completely.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Clears‌ its‌ fire and frozen‌ timers.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Removes every‌ harmful effect‌ it‌ has.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>A‌ weapon‌ that‌ heals whatever‌ you hit.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>The Just</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Hunger As‌ Armour</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>At noon you gain‌ hunger‌ and saturation very‌ quickly.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Armor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> scales with‌ your hunger‌ level.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Armor‌ Toughness</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> scales‌ with your‌ saturation‌ level.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Third Burden's damage‌ reduction cap‌ drops‌ by </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Made‌ on a‌ Nature‌ Altar‌ from a‌ Golden Carrot with a‌ Conversion‌ Catalyst, using </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>676,767</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura. Somebody had fun‌ choosing that‌ number.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Eat well, be‌ armoured.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Feast of Serendipity</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Protect‌ Someone Else</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It releases you‌ from the‌ freezing cold, which‌ cancels‌ the‌ Fifth Burden.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>First Burden</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. While you‌ are near‌ your protected entity you may‌ use swords‌ normally again.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] That last‌ line‌ is the‌ real‌ prize. This is the only‌ way‌ a virtuous player‌ gets‌ to‌ swing a‌ sword.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift‌ and right‌ click‌ any‌ entity to‌ mark‌ it as protected. While you‌ are within </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ of‌ it, every point‌ of damage‌ it‌ takes‌ is redirected‌ onto you.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blocks instantly and‌ from‌ every direction.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cannot be‌ disabled by‌ axes.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Freezes anything‌ that‌ hits‌ you in melee.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blocked‌ projectiles‌ fly back‌ toward‌ wherever‌ you are‌ looking.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>A‌ bodyguard shield.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Bastion of Frozen Restraint</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Second‌ Thoughts, Holy Edition</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drink‌ it‌ and the grace the‌ Ambrosial‌ Arbor gave you‌ is‌ purged. The‌ permanent effects‌ go, and‌ so does the‌ Golden Food restriction.</grad></shadow>
[!info] It is‌ the‌ exact mirror of‌ the Potion‌ of Redemption‌ on‌ the‌ cursed side.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Undo‌ the‌ Arbor.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Potion of Damnation</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Virtuous‌ Forbidden Fruit</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Buried‌ treasure‌ chests, </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>20‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of the‌ time. There‌ is no recipe, so bring‌ a lot‌ of‌ treasure maps.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What‌ Eating It‌ Does</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ bite‌ hands you‌ another stack of permanent‌ beneficial‌ effects, and they get‌ stronger the‌ more you‌ eat.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Once‌ you‌ have exhausted its‌ power‌ you can‌ only‌ ever‌ eat Golden‌ Food again. Normal bread‌ stops working‌ for you, forever.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Seventh Virtue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so‌ that any‌ damage type at‌ all can‌ be redirected into the world, not‌ just spell‌ damage.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Eat it. Eat it. EAT‌ IT!</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>The Ambrosial Arbor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Vertical Escape</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gaze‌ into‌ it and you‌ appear on‌ the highest‌ safe‌ block‌ with open sky‌ directly‌ above you.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] This‌ is‌ the‌ answer to‌ being lost in‌ a cave‌ at Y‌ minus‌ 50‌ with the‌ Sixth Burden‌ about to freeze‌ you in‌ place.
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A Purified Heart, an Aura Bottle, a‌ glass pane‌ and gold.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Straight up, out‌ of‌ the hole.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Righteous Mirror</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Vowed‌ To The‌ Lightning</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ritual‌ of‌ the Forest, Dormant‌ Sacrament, three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Lightning Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and four Spirits‌ of Infinity.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ instance of damage you take‌ that is‌ not </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Lightning</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is converted into </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Lightning</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then, when‌ you‌ take </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Lightning</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, it is‌ negated‌ and reflected back at‌ the‌ attacker.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic resistance and‌ damage‌ reflection‌ both scale‌ with‌ the </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Aura</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the area. Reflection‌ goes up about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura‌ nearby.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Negative‌ aura flips both‌ of those‌ numbers into‌ penalties. Do‌ not‌ stand in‌ a‌ drained field wearing this.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Seventh‌ Virtue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so reflected‌ damage mends‌ the‌ world‌ instead of‌ taking from it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Everything becomes‌ Lightning‌ damage.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sacrament of the Storm</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Vowed To‌ The‌ Fire</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ritual of the‌ Forest, Dormant Sacrament, three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Fire‌ Upgrade Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ four‌ Spirits‌ of Infinity.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ instance‌ of damage you take‌ that is‌ not </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is‌ converted into </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then, when‌ you take </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, it‌ is‌ negated‌ and reflected‌ back at the attacker.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic‌ resistance‌ and damage reflection‌ both scale‌ with the </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Aura</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the‌ area. Reflection‌ goes up about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura‌ nearby.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Negative aura‌ flips‌ both‌ of those‌ numbers into penalties. Do‌ not stand‌ in a‌ drained‌ field‌ wearing this.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Seventh Virtue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so reflected‌ damage mends‌ the world instead of taking‌ from it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Everything‌ becomes Fire damage.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sacrament of the Flame</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Offering‌ Table</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put an </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Aura Trove</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> holding‌ exactly </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,200,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura‌ on an‌ Offering‌ Table and start it‌ with‌ a </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Birth Spirit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The trove‌ has‌ to‌ actually contain‌ that‌ much. A partly filled‌ one will not be‌ accepted.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ Sacrament wants four‌ of these, and‌ several of‌ the‌ divine‌ relics want‌ two‌ more, so build the aura‌ infrastructure properly.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>An‌ offering, not‌ a craft.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Spirit of Infinity</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Vowed‌ To‌ The Eldritch</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ritual of‌ the Forest, Dormant‌ Sacrament, three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Eldritch Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ four‌ Spirits of‌ Infinity.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ instance of damage you‌ take that‌ is‌ not </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Eldritch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is converted‌ into </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Eldritch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then, when you‌ take </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Eldritch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, it‌ is‌ negated and‌ reflected back at the‌ attacker.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic‌ resistance and damage‌ reflection both‌ scale with‌ the </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Aura</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ the‌ area. Reflection goes up‌ about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura nearby.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Negative‌ aura‌ flips‌ both of‌ those numbers into‌ penalties. Do not‌ stand in‌ a‌ drained‌ field wearing‌ this.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also‌ alters the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Seventh Virtue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so‌ reflected damage‌ mends the world instead of‌ taking from‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Everything becomes Eldritch‌ damage.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sacrament of the Anomaly</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Summoner‌ Support</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+75</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Summon‌ Damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every summon you‌ own‌ receives your‌ bonuses‌ from‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Scroll of‌ a Thousand Virtues</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Insignia of‌ Lightforged Benediction</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With‌ the‌ Potioneer's‌ Pearl, beneficial effects‌ up to‌ amplifier </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> become infinite.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Ritual‌ of the‌ Forest on a Jungle Sapling‌ with a‌ bow, string, Conjurer's Talismans and‌ Gold‌ Leaf. It takes‌ about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>35‌ minutes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Summons do not care‌ that‌ you cannot swing‌ a‌ weapon. For‌ a virtuous‌ player‌ this is the‌ obvious way to fight.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Your‌ summons‌ inherit everything.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Melodious Harmony</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Vowed‌ To The‌ Nature</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ritual‌ of‌ the Forest, Dormant‌ Sacrament, three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Nature Upgrade Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ four Spirits‌ of Infinity.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ instance‌ of‌ damage you‌ take that‌ is not </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Nature</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is converted‌ into </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Nature</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then, when you‌ take </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Nature</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, it is negated and reflected‌ back at‌ the attacker.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic resistance‌ and‌ damage reflection‌ both‌ scale with the </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Aura</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ area. Reflection‌ goes up about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura‌ nearby.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Negative‌ aura flips‌ both‌ of those numbers‌ into penalties. Do not stand‌ in‌ a drained field‌ wearing this.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Seventh‌ Virtue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so‌ reflected damage‌ mends‌ the world instead of‌ taking from‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Everything‌ becomes Nature‌ damage.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sacrament of the Wilds</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Wither‌ Farming, Again</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Kill a‌ Wither‌ while‌ wearing the‌ Ring of the Seven‌ Virtues‌ and it drops </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ to 4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ these.</grad></shadow>

[!warn] Remember the‌ burdens. You‌ cannot‌ swing a weapon‌ properly‌ and you‌ deal‌ less‌ damage the‌ more armour you‌ wear, so plan‌ the fight‌ around‌ spells, summons‌ or a‌ relic that‌ does not care.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Purified‌ out of‌ a Wither's soul.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sanctified Essence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Automatic Revival</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Curio Slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ revive‌ immediately when‌ you‌ die, then it goes on‌ a </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>40‌ second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cooldown.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every instance of damage you‌ take that‌ is not </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Wind</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is converted‌ into </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Wind</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then, when‌ you take </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Wind</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, it‌ is‌ negated and reflected back‌ at‌ the attacker.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic resistance‌ and‌ damage‌ reflection both‌ scale‌ with the </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Aura</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ area. Reflection goes up about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura‌ nearby.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Negative aura flips‌ both of‌ those numbers‌ into‌ penalties. Do‌ not stand‌ in‌ a drained field wearing‌ this.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also‌ alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Seventh Virtue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so‌ reflected damage‌ mends‌ the‌ world instead‌ of taking from it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Everything‌ becomes‌ Wind damage.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sacrament of the Skies</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Sacrament‌ Slot</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Then Pick‌ An Element</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Ritual‌ of the‌ Forest on an </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Ancient Sapling</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with the‌ Dormant Sacrament, three‌ matching </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Upgrade Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and four </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Spirits‌ of‌ Infinity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The ritual‌ runs‌ for about 2 hours‌ and‌ 20 minutes of‌ real‌ time. Start‌ it and‌ go‌ do something else.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wearing‌ the Ring‌ of‌ the Seven Virtues opens‌ a slot‌ nobody‌ else has. This‌ is what‌ goes‌ in‌ it.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Making One</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Heart‌ of the Seraphim</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on a‌ Nature‌ Altar with a </grad><grad from=#B6EE86 to=#5FBF3A f=0.8>Conversion‌ Catalyst</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> beneath it, fed </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1,200,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura, over‌ about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10 seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] That‌ is‌ more‌ aura than a‌ fresh‌ field holds. You‌ need‌ a‌ proper Nature's‌ Aura setup and‌ probably a‌ trove or‌ two‌ before‌ this is‌ realistic.
[gap=5]
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>1.2‌ million aura. Build accordingly.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Dormant Sacrament</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Reward‌ For‌ Everything</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What It‌ Does</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It remembers‌ the‌ damage‌ type of the‌ last‌ hit you‌ took.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Incoming‌ damage‌ of that‌ same type is‌ nullified completely.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Incoming‌ damage of‌ any‌ other‌ type is‌ greatly amplified.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each‌ nullification strips </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>10 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ the attacker's‌ current health.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Kill a </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Warden</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> while‌ every‌ one of these‌ is true.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each amplification heals the‌ attacker for </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>20‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of their maximum‌ health.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Arcane‌ Scroll Slot.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Against‌ one‌ enemy type this makes‌ you‌ unkillable. Against a mixed‌ fight‌ it‌ is a‌ death‌ sentence. That tension is‌ the whole design.
[!info] It drops‌ only‌ once per player, ever.
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You are wearing‌ the‌ Ring of the‌ Seven Virtues.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ are wearing‌ the‌ Blessing‌ of Exaltation.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ virtuous‌ time is at least </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>99.5‌ percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
4. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You have‌ gained‌ all </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Hearts of‌ the Seraphim.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ medallion‌ spawns‌ floating where‌ the Warden died, and only‌ you‌ can pick it‌ up.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Forged‌ from a‌ fallen Matriarch.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Grace of Consecration</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Vowed‌ To The‌ Geo</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ritual‌ of the Forest, Dormant Sacrament, three </grad><grad from=#8FD6FF to=#4FA8E8 f=0.8>Geo‌ Upgrade‌ Orbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and four Spirits‌ of‌ Infinity.</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>On The Nature‌ Altar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#D9A5FF to=#B06BE8 f=0.8>Heart of‌ the Earth</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on a‌ Nature‌ Altar with </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>25,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> aura, over‌ about </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4‌ seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It goes into the‌ Holy‌ Stone, the Blessing of‌ Exaltation, the‌ Insignia‌ of Lightforged‌ Benediction, The‌ Just, the Righteous Mirror, the‌ Bastion of Frozen Restraint‌ and‌ Hallowed Steps.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Make a‌ lot. This is‌ the single‌ most‌ reused‌ item on‌ the‌ virtuous side.
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>The mirror of‌ the Twisted‌ Heart.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Purified Heart</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ instance‌ of damage‌ you‌ take that is‌ not </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Ice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is converted into </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Ice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Sacrament of the Frost</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Shared‌ Pain</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any damage you would‌ take, measured‌ before any of‌ your resistances‌ apply, is also‌ dealt‌ to‌ your target.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Combine this‌ with‌ a build‌ that‌ reduces‌ incoming damage‌ heavily. You take almost‌ nothing, and they‌ take the‌ full‌ unreduced‌ number.
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A Priest‌ Helmet on‌ the altar with‌ a Crushing‌ Catalyst, 400,000 aura, over two minutes.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>They feel‌ what you‌ feel.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Broken Mask of Glorious Past</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Move In‌ The‌ Dark</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It alters the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Sixth‌ Burden</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so you can move‌ regardless‌ of light level, but‌ only during‌ the day.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wear‌ it‌ with </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Mnestia's‌ Raiment</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and the‌ time‌ of day stops mattering‌ too, which finally‌ solves‌ the burden‌ completely.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Paired with‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Albarest‌ of‌ Deliverance</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the continuous‌ arrow damage turns into‌ continuous‌ healing instead.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A Nature's‌ Aura Eye‌ on the‌ altar‌ with‌ a Conversion Catalyst, 250,000‌ aura.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Fixes‌ the darkness‌ problem. Half‌ of‌ it.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>The All-Seeing Eye</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Bare Fists‌ Become Real</shadow></grad>
[!tip] The‌ First‌ Burden‌ only blocks‌ weapons and tools. Your‌ fists were‌ never covered‌ by‌ it.
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Punching‌ deals damage‌ based‌ on‌ your </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Armor Toughness</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ hits‌ knock back based on‌ your </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Knockback Resistance</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ alters‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Third Burden</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so‌ your punches‌ always‌ deal‌ full damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Mnestia's‌ Raiment</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, every punch calls down‌ Divine‌ Retribution, scaling with your‌ Luck.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An Offering‌ Table craft. A‌ Bone‌ Block‌ offered with a‌ Spirit‌ of Infinity.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Punch‌ things. Properly.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Annointed Handward</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Permanent‌ Potions</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Charm Slot, and every‌ beneficial‌ effect you‌ receive‌ at its base tier‌ lasts‌ forever.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wear it with </grad><grad from=#FFE9A8 to=#F5C542 f=0.8>Melodious‌ Harmony</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ that‌ extends to‌ effects‌ up to amplifier </grad><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!info] A‌ short list of effects‌ is‌ excluded, mostly the flight‌ ones and‌ Health Boost, because‌ the‌ combination‌ would be‌ silly‌ even by this mod's‌ standards.
<shadow a=0.3><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Sanctified Essence, a‌ Calling‌ Spirit, a Heart‌ of the‌ Sea, feathers‌ and‌ glowstone.</grad></shadow></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F5C542 to=#F5C542>Base tier‌ buffs never expire.</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F5C542 to=#FFF4CF f=0.6>Potioneer's Pearl</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest141BFAE95: Hexalia‌ is a‌ mod rooted in‌ natural magic, just‌ like hexerei!
This mod aims to‌ have rustic‌ application of magic‌ through‌ natural resources.
Verdant‌ Grimiore‌ works as a in-game‌ wiki, allowing‌ you to see‌ possible‌ rituals‌ with everything!
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest199346B76: Can be‌ used‌ to‌ heat small‌ cauldron!
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest2382E4B2A: Can‌ be found at‌ the‌ bottom of‌ oceans.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest3173F4452: Can‌ be found in old‌ growth‌ taiga or mushroom‌ fields biomes.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest362E36A27: Can‌ get resin from‌ dark oak trees.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest4238A3748: Salt‌ ores can be found‌ mostly in‌ caves‌ at altitudes‌ from Y80‌ to‌ Y-80.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest49BFC9959: Putting the‌ brews in‌ this‌ bottle.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest514415BA5: The‌ ritual block must‌ be placed‌ down, along with‌ placing‌ salt‌ on each‌ side. (with one‌ block  distance)
The item to‌ transmute must‌ be placed on the ritual‌ table and‌ the ingredients on‌ the‌ salt.
&82- Put‌ spirit‌ bloom, snowball, wooden‌ sword, resin on‌ salts.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest59BB4F2BF: Wild‌ Mandrakes can‌ be‌ found‌ in forest‌ biomes, they‌ can be broken for‌ seeds.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest63386E390: Turns‌ the plants we've found‌ in‌ nature to pastes.
With‌ these‌ resources, let's‌ get to‌ brewing!
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest63E88501B: Requires a‌ heat‌ source from below‌ to brew‌ potions.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest66F939BEB: Can‌ be‌ found in swamp‌ biomes.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest6B8EFF039: Can be‌ found‌ in taiga‌ biomes, when eaten‌ grans‌ you‌ fire resistance.
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest710675BA3: Removes‌ any effect from‌ player, can‌ cure rotten‌ meat‌ to‌ leather aswell!
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest710783806: A rare seed found‌ in‌ jungle pyramids or‌ dug up‌ by sniffers.
Can‌ be‌ transmuted‌ into kelpwave‌ blade!
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.quest75C72C9A7: Can be found in‌ savanna, be‌ careful it can‌ burn you!
ftbquests.chapter.hexalia.questB1B373D26: If‌ you bonemeal any‌ magical source‌ planted on‌ this‌ block, it‌ will duplicate!
Additionally, if‌ you right-click‌ with a hoe‌ it can‌ turn into a infused farmland.
The‌ infused farmland‌ doesnt require water‌ and‌ cant be‌ trampled!
