<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>How Every Machine Works</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Where You Ended‌ Up</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sixteen‌ generators make‌ one reactor, and the‌ reactor makes </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>Artifact‌ tier gear</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The‌ Ore‌ Laser‌ Base and‌ the ore‌ chain together mean‌ you never‌ have to mine again. The Infinity‌ Backpack means‌ you never have‌ to‌ sort again. Go‌ build‌ something ridiculous.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You started by tapping‌ a‌ tree with a‌ pump. You are‌ now standing‌ next‌ to‌ a reactor‌ that‌ runs on sixteen simultaneous‌ joke generators‌ and‌ puts out‌ twenty five‌ million‌ a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Trees make </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>latex</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, latex‌ makes </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>plastic</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, plastic makes everything.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cows make </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>pink‌ slime</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, pink‌ slime makes </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>Advanced frames</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ wither makes </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>ether‌ gas</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, ether gas‌ makes </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>Supreme‌ frames</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ore‌ plus meat plus‌ time‌ makes </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>five times‌ the‌ ore</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E8A33D to=#E8A33D>You turned cows‌ into‌ nether stars</grad>
Worth it
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6>Foregoing..</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Collecting</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, three‌ buckets, two‌ iron gears, redstone‌ and‌ a Pity frame.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Picks up‌ any fluid‌ source‌ block in‌ its area‌ into‌ a </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>16,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> tank. Point‌ it at‌ an infinite water pool, or‌ at‌ a lava lake‌ if you‌ enjoy long‌ trips.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#AFC3D8>Scoops‌ up‌ source blocks</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6>Fluid Collector</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier‌ Two</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In the‌ Dissolution Chamber: two plastic, a </grad><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.8>Simple frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.8>two netherite‌ scrap</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, two gold‌ ingots and a </grad><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.8>diamond‌ gear</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, sitting‌ in </grad><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.8>500 pink‌ slime</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That‌ last ingredient is the‌ wall. Pink‌ slime is not‌ craftable‌ and‌ not findable. It‌ comes‌ out of the </grad><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.8>Mob‌ Slaughter Factory</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so the entire‌ second‌ half of this‌ mod is‌ gated behind‌ killing‌ things‌ at scale.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Advanced‌ frames‌ unlock the mob crusher, the‌ duplicator, every enchantment‌ machine, the‌ ore lasers‌ and the‌ whole‌ ore‌ multiplication chain.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Half‌ a bucket of pink‌ slime‌ per frame. You are‌ going to‌ need a‌ lot‌ of‌ frames.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#9B6BFF>Netherite scrap, and pink‌ goo</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9B6BFF to=#D9C8FF f=0.6>Advanced Machine Frame</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#FF6EC7 to=#FFC6E8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Goo</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pink Slime‌ is‌ the‌ second fluid‌ out‌ of the Slaughter Factory‌ and the‌ gate‌ on the‌ Advanced tier.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ behaves‌ like‌ a fluid‌ in every normal way, except‌ that‌ leaving it sitting‌ in the‌ world spawns </grad><grad from=#FF6EC7 to=#FFC6E8 f=0.8>Pink‌ Slime‌ mobs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ are hostile and‌ which‌ drop more‌ pink‌ slime‌ when killed.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Keep‌ it in tanks. A‌ pool of‌ pink slime‌ in‌ your‌ base is‌ a slime‌ farm you did‌ not agree‌ to.
<typewriter><grad from=#FF6EC7 to=#FF6EC7>It also spawns things, unfortunately</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FF6EC7 to=#FFC6E8 f=0.6>Pink Slime, The Fluid</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Water Without‌ Pumping</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, a‌ water bucket, two pistons, two‌ iron gears, redstone and a‌ Pity‌ frame.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Surround it with‌ water source‌ blocks. It needs‌ at‌ least </grad><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.8>two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> touching‌ it and‌ it‌ makes </grad><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.8>100 water per source</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> every‌ five seconds. Six‌ sources‌ is 600‌ a cycle.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cut‌ its‌ power‌ and it‌ keeps going at half‌ rate‌ and a fifth‌ of the‌ speed, so it‌ never‌ fully‌ stops.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The Latex Processing‌ Unit, the‌ Bioreactor and‌ the‌ hydroponic‌ beds all‌ drink water constantly. Build‌ one of‌ these early.
<typewriter><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#5DBE5D>Two‌ water‌ blocks‌ become a‌ water supply</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.6>Water Condensator</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sorting</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, an‌ ender pearl, a‌ book, an enchanted‌ book, a‌ diamond‌ gear and‌ an </grad><grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.8>Advanced frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One input, two outputs. Anything‌ with‌ an enchantment on‌ it goes‌ out one‌ side, everything‌ else‌ goes out the‌ other.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Point‌ a Mob‌ Crusher's‌ output‌ at this‌ and you never‌ dig enchanted‌ mob drops‌ out‌ of‌ a pile‌ of rotten‌ flesh again.
<typewriter><grad from=#8FE33F to=#8FE33F>Enchanted left, plain‌ right</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.6>Enchantment Sorter</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Breaking</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, an‌ iron pickaxe, an‌ iron‌ shovel, a‌ gold gear, two‌ iron‌ gears, redstone and a Pity‌ frame.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It mines‌ every‌ block in‌ its area‌ and‌ puts‌ the drops‌ in its own inventory. It‌ swings‌ a </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>diamond pickaxe</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so anything‌ up to‌ obsidian comes‌ out‌ fine.</grad></shadow>
[!info] It‌ respects protection and‌ unbreakable‌ blocks, so it‌ will‌ not‌ chew through‌ bedrock or someone‌ else's claim.
<typewriter><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#AFC3D8>A‌ diamond pickaxe‌ in‌ a‌ box</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6>Block Breaker</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>All Sixteen, Same‌ Shape</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every Mycelial‌ generator is‌ the‌ same‌ crafting recipe: eight‌ of a‌ theme item around‌ a machine‌ frame, with redstone in the bottom‌ corners. Only the‌ theme item and‌ the‌ frame tier‌ change.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four‌ of them use a </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Simple‌ frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, nine‌ use an </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Advanced frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ three‌ use‌ a </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Supreme frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. That‌ is‌ the whole tier‌ system here.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They also talk‌ to‌ each other. Generators of‌ different types‌ placed near‌ one‌ another‌ feed the‌ same‌ shared network, which is what‌ the </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Mycelial Reactor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at‌ the‌ bottom of‌ this chapter‌ reads.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] The‌ Reactor‌ needs all‌ sixteen types running at‌ once. Not‌ fifteen. Build every one‌ of them.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Power‌ figures below‌ are‌ per‌ tick while burning, and‌ burn‌ times are‌ in‌ ticks. Twenty‌ ticks is‌ one second.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#4FD9CE>Sixteen boxes‌ that burn‌ sixteen silly‌ things</grad>
Sixteen? Really?
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.6>The Mycelial Generators</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Rolling The‌ Dice</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, a‌ book, two‌ diamonds, three obsidian‌ and an </grad><grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.8>Advanced‌ frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed it </grad><grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.8>28,200 essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ one item, and‌ it rolls a </grad><grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.8>level 50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> enchantment on‌ it. Not level‌ 30, which is the‌ enchanting‌ table's ceiling. Fifty.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>28,200‌ essence‌ is 1,410 experience points, so‌ it‌ is not cheap, but‌ a‌ Mob‌ Crusher on‌ a‌ Mechanical Dirt pays‌ for itself in minutes.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Roll‌ books, feed‌ the good ones‌ to the‌ Applicator, extract the‌ bad‌ ones‌ back into‌ essence. That‌ loop is the whole‌ endgame of‌ enchanting‌ in this‌ mod.
<typewriter><grad from=#8FE33F to=#8FE33F>Level 50‌ rolls, on‌ tap</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8FE33F to=#D8FFA8 f=0.6>Enchantment Factory</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Biofuel Per‌ Cycle</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>9 plants</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give‌ 2,135.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nine slots of‌ one crop‌ would give 855 if it‌ were even‌ allowed. Nine different crops‌ give </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>2,135</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Same‌ item count, two‌ and‌ a half times the‌ fuel.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, melon, pumpkin, cactus, sugar‌ cane and any‌ flower. Nine‌ is‌ easy to‌ reach, so‌ never run this‌ thing half loaded.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It eats‌ the‌ same amount of‌ water as‌ the biofuel‌ it‌ makes, so‌ plumb a‌ water‌ source in before you‌ walk away.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ output‌ curve is not‌ linear. Each‌ filled slot‌ makes‌ every‌ other slot‌ worth more.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>1 plant</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives‌ 95 per‌ cycle.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>3 plants</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give‌ 389.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>5‌ plants</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give‌ 827.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>7 plants</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give‌ 1,409.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>The‌ numbers‌ behind the‌ nine slots</grad>
Fine, nine crops it is
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Why Variety Wins</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Copy And‌ Paste For‌ Blocks</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Paper, plastic‌ and‌ redstone. Shift right‌ click a machine you‌ have‌ set up nicely, then‌ right click‌ every other‌ copy‌ of‌ that machine.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It carries‌ side‌ configuration and‌ redstone‌ settings‌ across, which is‌ the difference between‌ a ten‌ minute build‌ and‌ an‌ hour of‌ clicking.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Configure one‌ machine, not thirty</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Machine Settings Copier</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Two Tanks</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, a bucket, two‌ bricks, an‌ iron gear and‌ a‌ Pity‌ frame. It works‌ on‌ the area </grad><grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.8>above</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> it, so bury‌ it under the pen‌ floor.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ animal standing on‌ it gives </grad><grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.8>50‌ sewage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> every five‌ seconds.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any </grad><grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.8>experience‌ orb</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> that‌ lands in‌ the‌ area becomes </grad><grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.8>20 essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per point.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any </grad><grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.8>player</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> standing‌ in the‌ area‌ gets their‌ experience quietly‌ drained‌ into‌ the essence‌ tank.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] That last one is‌ not‌ a joke. Do not‌ stand on‌ your own‌ sewer‌ while‌ you are saving‌ up‌ levels.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It charges‌ 10‌ energy‌ per animal‌ per cycle, so a‌ hundred cows‌ is a‌ hundred‌ times‌ the bill.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#D2503C to=#D2503C>Yes, that‌ is what‌ it collects</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#D2503C to=#F5A99B f=0.6>Sewer</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Burns‌ Ice</shadow></grad>
[!warn] Feeding‌ it snowballs is‌ a waste of a‌ machine. Blue‌ ice is thirty‌ times better‌ per item.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight‌ snowballs around‌ an ice‌ block, on a </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Simple frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Blue‌ ice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> burns 3,600‌ ticks at 40. Worth 144,000 all‌ by itself.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Ice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>packed‌ ice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> burn 400 ticks‌ at‌ 40.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Snow blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> burn‌ 400‌ ticks at 20.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Snowballs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> burn 400‌ ticks‌ at 5, and snow‌ layers‌ 500‌ ticks at‌ 2.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#4FD9CE>Blue‌ ice‌ is‌ the good‌ one</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.6>Frosty Generator</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE6A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Biofuel‌ Loop</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Industrial Foregoing's‌ own‌ power‌ answer is‌ to‌ grow plants, mash them into‌ fuel and‌ burn‌ the fuel. Two‌ machines, and it‌ scales‌ as‌ far as‌ your farm does.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE6A8 f=0.8>Bioreactor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> turns plant‌ matter‌ and water into‌ biofuel. The </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE6A8 f=0.8>Biofuel Generator</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> burns‌ biofuel into‌ energy. That‌ is‌ the loop.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The Bioreactor‌ rewards‌ variety, not volume. The‌ next‌ quest‌ explains why, and‌ it is worth‌ reading before‌ you build‌ the‌ farm.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Any‌ other mod's‌ power works‌ fine too. Nothing here‌ cares where‌ the energy came from.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>Plants in, energy‌ out</grad>
Show me the plant fuel
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE6A8 f=0.6>Powering All Of This</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Three‌ Machines‌ Facing A Field</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Industrial‌ Foregoing's farm‌ is not‌ one‌ block. It‌ is a </grad><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.8>Sower</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, a </grad><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.8>Gatherer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ optionally‌ a </grad><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.8>Fertilizer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, all pointed at the‌ same patch‌ of‌ dirt with‌ their working‌ areas‌ overlapping.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Sower plants, the‌ Fertilizer speeds the growth, the‌ Gatherer‌ cuts. Nothing else is‌ needed and‌ it never‌ stops.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Set‌ all‌ three to the‌ same‌ range addon‌ and‌ stand‌ where you‌ can see all‌ three coloured‌ boxes at‌ once. If‌ the‌ boxes do‌ not match, the‌ farm has holes‌ in it.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The‌ Gatherer also fills a tank‌ with sludge‌ as a byproduct, which‌ turns‌ out to‌ be‌ worth something.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#5DBE5D>Plant it, feed it, cut‌ it, repeat</grad>
Let's grow something
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#5DBE5D to=#BCEDBC f=0.6>The Plant Farm</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#B4C43A to=#E7F3A0 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Nine Slots</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, a‌ diamond gear, slimeballs, sugar, a brick‌ and‌ a Pity‌ frame.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ has nine input slots‌ and‌ it will not‌ let‌ you‌ put the‌ same‌ plant in two‌ of them. Every five seconds‌ it‌ eats one item‌ from each‌ filled slot‌ and‌ the‌ same amount‌ of‌ water it produces in‌ biofuel.</grad></shadow>
[!danger] Filling one‌ slot‌ is nearly‌ pointless. Filling all‌ nine‌ is‌ worth more‌ than nine times as‌ much. See‌ the next quest.
<typewriter><grad from=#B4C43A to=#B4C43A>Nine‌ slots, nine different‌ plants</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B4C43A to=#E7F3A0 f=0.6>Bioreactor</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#FFCE3D to=#FFEEB0 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Throwing‌ Things</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two diamond blocks, a‌ real trident, a‌ diamond hoe, the‌ biggest‌ range‌ addon and three‌ gold‌ gears, in 2,000‌ pink‌ slime.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Its‌ screen lets‌ you set </grad><grad from=#FFCE3D to=#FFEEB0 f=0.8>loyalty</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFCE3D to=#FFEEB0 f=0.8>riptide</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFCE3D to=#FFEEB0 f=0.8>channeling</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> yourself rather‌ than praying‌ to an‌ enchanting‌ table, and‌ each one‌ costs charge‌ while it is‌ on.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] You have‌ to find an actual trident‌ first. The recipe‌ does not fake‌ that‌ part.
<typewriter><grad from=#FFCE3D to=#FFCE3D>Loyalty, channeling and‌ riptide, on‌ sliders</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFCE3D to=#FFEEB0 f=0.6>Infinity Trident</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Colour‌ Maths</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, four‌ dyes, a gold gear‌ and a Pity frame.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ has‌ three input slots, one‌ for </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>red</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, one for </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>green</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ one for </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>blue</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Each‌ dye‌ you‌ feed in‌ adds </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>three‌ charge</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to its channel. Then you‌ pick an‌ output‌ colour and‌ it spends‌ charge‌ from‌ whichever channels‌ that colour needs.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pure colours‌ cost‌ one charge from‌ one channel, so‌ one red‌ dye‌ in‌ gives you </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>three red‌ dyes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> back. Mixed‌ colours cost‌ from‌ two‌ or three‌ channels.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Grow one flower‌ type, triple it, and‌ never mine‌ lapis‌ for‌ blue dye‌ again.
<typewriter><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#AFC3D8>One dye‌ in, three dyes out</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6>Dye Mixer</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Making‌ Fluids</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plastic, a diamond‌ pickaxe, a diamond‌ gear, a‌ bucket, redstone‌ and an </grad><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.8>Advanced‌ frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Same‌ drills, different base.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With an </grad><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.8>orange lens</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, in‌ any nether‌ biome‌ between Y‌ 5 and‌ 20, it‌ makes </grad><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.8>100‌ lava</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per fill.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With‌ a </grad><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.8>purple lens</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, anywhere at all, it‌ makes </grad><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.8>10‌ ether gas</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per fill. And‌ it needs‌ a wither‌ standing‌ on‌ it.</grad></shadow>

[!danger] Read that again. Ether‌ gas‌ requires a‌ living‌ Wither‌ inside the‌ three block cube‌ around the‌ base. Each fill‌ hits‌ it‌ for 5‌ damage, and it‌ stops if the‌ wither drops‌ below 5 health.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Its bar only‌ needs </grad><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.8>20 drill‌ ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of 100, so‌ fluid‌ output is‌ five‌ times faster per drill‌ than‌ ore output.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FF5A3C>Lava, and something‌ much‌ stranger</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FF5A3C to=#FFB9A8 f=0.6>Fluid Laser Base</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Processing</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ redstone, two glass‌ panes, two gears, </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>a‌ furnace‌ and‌ a crafting‌ table</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, in 1000 latex.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gold gears‌ give </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>2x‌ output per cycle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Diamond‌ gears give </grad><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.8>3x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Processing‌ is usually‌ better‌ than‌ speed. Doing three times‌ the‌ work in‌ one‌ cycle‌ beats doing‌ one cycle three‌ times as‌ often, because the‌ fixed‌ costs‌ only get‌ paid once.
<typewriter><grad from=#E8A33D to=#E8A33D>A‌ furnace and a‌ crafting table‌ walk into a bath</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E8A33D to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6>Processing Addons</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Burns‌ Pink Dye</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight pink dye‌ around pink‌ wool, on‌ a </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>Simple frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One‌ pink dye‌ burns‌ for‌ exactly </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>69 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at </grad><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.8>135‌ a tick</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Somebody chose those‌ numbers‌ on purpose.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The Dye‌ Mixer triples‌ dye, so this‌ is‌ a‌ genuinely sustainable generator‌ and‌ not just‌ a‌ joke.
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#4FD9CE>69‌ ticks, 135 a‌ tick</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD9CE to=#BFF5F0 f=0.6>Pink Generator</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Clip‌ Them To The‌ Side</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Dropping</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> tips‌ items off‌ the‌ belt onto‌ the floor.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Bouncing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> launches‌ whatever‌ is‌ on the‌ belt into the air.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Blinking</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> teleports‌ items‌ across a gap‌ in the‌ belt line.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Extraction</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> pulls‌ items‌ out of‌ the‌ block it touches‌ onto the belt.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Insertion</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shoves items‌ off‌ the belt into‌ the block‌ it touches.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Splitting</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sends‌ items‌ alternately‌ down two‌ paths.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E6EFF8 f=0.8>Detection</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> emits‌ redstone when something passes.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#AFC3D8>Seven‌ clip-ons, no GUI‌ needed</grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Oak, birch, spruce and‌ jungle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give‌ 2.</grad></shadow>
