<grad from=#006EDB to=#3F91E0 f=0.8><shadow a=0.3>/setwarp</shadow></grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> - Creates‌ a server‌ warp point‌ at‌ your‌ location.</grad></shadow>
<grad from=#006EDB to=#3F91E0 f=0.8><shadow a=0.3>/delwarp</shadow></grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> - Deletes a‌ specific warp‌ point.</grad></shadow>

<grad from=#006EDB to=#3F91E0 f=0.8><shadow a=0.3>/listwarps</shadow></grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> - Lists all available‌ server warps.</grad></shadow>
<grad from=#006EDB to=#3F91E0 f=0.8><shadow a=0.3>/tpa</shadow></grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> - Sends‌ a request to teleport to‌ another player.</grad></shadow>

[gap=3]
<grad from=#006EDB to=#3F91E0 f=0.8><shadow a=0.3>/kickme</shadow></grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> - Kicks you from the‌ server (useful‌ if the bed‌ bug returns).</grad></shadow>

<grad from=#006EDB to=#3F91E0 f=0.8><shadow a=0.3>/hat</shadow></grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> - Equips‌ the item‌ in your main‌ hand into‌ your helmet‌ slot.</grad></shadow>

Using ink‌ and‌ scrolls, you can increase‌ the level‌ of your‌ spells‌ to‌ maximize their potential.
It‌ also‌ allows you‌ to‌ improve‌ your gear‌ with upgrade orbs‌ and increase‌ the overall‌ capacity‌ of‌ your spellbooks.
ftbquests.chapter.irons_spells.quest7A92: The‌ essential workstation used‌ to craft‌ and create‌ new‌ spells.
Allows‌ you to‌ forge‌ powerful magic scrolls using‌ raw magical‌ resources.
ftbquests.chapter.irons_spells.quest7CCA: A legendary‌ archive holding‌ the dark, forgotten magic‌ of the‌ deep ocean.
This incredibly rare text‌ can only‌ be acquired as‌ a‌ drop by‌ defeating‌ the terrifying &dLeviathan&r.
ftbquests.chapter.irons_spells.quest7F36: A scorched guide containing‌ the‌ volatile methods of‌ high-tier fire‌ casting.
The trick‌ is‌ killing &cBlazes&r‌ and hoping this‌ manual‌ doesn't turn‌ into‌ ash‌ along with‌ them.
Every Blaze, unbeknownst to‌ them, comes with‌ one of‌ these‌ tucked‌ away.
ftbquests.chapter.irons_spells.quest9288: The‌ spells inside‌ the‌ book‌ are initially‌ locked but‌ can be improved‌ by combining‌ the book in the &bArcane Anvil&r‌ with a‌ higher-level scroll of‌ the‌ same spell.
A‌ dark and‌ powerful‌ tome‌ bound with forbidden, high-level‌ necromancy‌ magic.
Can only‌ be‌ acquired‌ by taking‌ it from its‌ undead owner.
An‌ ancient‌ book holding a host‌ of‌ dark spells.
ftbquests.chapter.irons_spells.questA09D: &7What may‌ have‌ once‌ been a‌ more&r
A‌ decayed‌ spellbook‌ containing remnants‌ of‌ weak magical energy.
They‌ can be looted from‌ equally‌ rotten places all‌ across the‌ Overworld.
Yet, still‌ more powerful‌ than most‌ Overworld‌ spell‌ books.

ftbquests.chapter.just_dire_things.quest: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron block‌ against the goo, two‌ minutes, and‌ it stops‌ being‌ iron.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mine it for </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>3 to‌ 4</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Raw‌ Ferricore. Silk touch gives‌ you‌ the‌ block back‌ instead.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Nine‌ iron in, 3 to‌ 4 raw out, and each‌ one‌ smelts into an‌ ingot.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The same‌ trick runs‌ on‌ gold, diamond‌ and netherite‌ blocks‌ further down.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#5FD8C4>Watch an iron‌ block change‌ its‌ mind</grad>
Find a Raw Ferricore Ore
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#CFF0E9 to=#6A9799 f=0.6>Raw Ferricore Block</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It burns‌ the three‌ refined‌ fuels‌ and nothing‌ else.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#B7CBD4 to=#4E626F f=0.8>Refined Eclipse‌ Ember</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>64000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so one‌ bucket‌ is </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>64000000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Output‌ is capped at </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ tick‌ either way, so‌ better‌ fuel‌ means longer‌ rather than harder.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] One‌ of these‌ plus an‌ Energy‌ Transmitter‌ is an‌ entire base's‌ power.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Bucket, canister or pipe, it‌ doesnt care‌ how the fluid arrives.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What Each Fuel Is‌ Worth</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC07A to=#D96A3C f=0.8>Refined‌ Blaze Ember</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a unit.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7CF2E4 to=#1E9C97 f=0.8>Refined‌ Voidflame</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>16000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#FFB070 to=#FFB070>No more‌ coal in‌ hoppers</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC07A to=#FFE7CC f=0.6>Simple Fuel Generator</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Left‌ click‌ for blue, right click‌ for‌ orange, walk‌ in one‌ and‌ out the other.</grad></shadow>
[!info] This‌ one runs‌ on energy‌ alone. The‌ Advanced‌ version wants‌ Portal Fluid on top.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Charge‌ it‌ in an advanced‌ machine, or off‌ a Pocket‌ Generator‌ while‌ you walk.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Items‌ go through too, which makes‌ it‌ a serious item‌ transport system‌ if you‌ are‌ lazy‌ enough.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Costs</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ shot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Portals‌ hang around about </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>two and‌ a half‌ minutes</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#5FD8C4>Blue one, orange‌ one, you‌ know the‌ drill</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7CF2E4 to=#D2FFF9 f=0.6>Portal Gun</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Diamond‌ block against‌ VoidShimmer, about‌ sixteen‌ seconds, then mine‌ it for </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>3 to‌ 4</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Celestigem.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Nine diamonds‌ in, 3 to‌ 4‌ gems‌ out. Do this‌ because Celestigem‌ is a better‌ material, not because‌ it multiplies.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The gem drops finished, no‌ smelting on‌ this one.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#5FD8C4>Diamonds go‌ in. Better‌ ones come‌ out</grad>
Find a Raw Celestigem Ore
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7CF2E4 to=#D2FFF9 f=0.6>Raw Celestigem Block</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Netherite stats‌ with‌ the‌ entire ability‌ list‌ on top.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Death‌ Protection</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, one free save‌ every </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>5 minutes</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plus </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Lava‌ Immunity</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Time Protection</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Mental‌ Obliteration</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Debuff‌ Remover</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Flight‌ drains while you‌ are‌ up there, so‌ bring‌ Mending‌ or bring‌ a Pocket Generator.
[!info] Mental‌ Obliteration switches‌ a mob's‌ brain‌ off‌ permanently. The Dragon, the‌ Wither and‌ the Warden are‌ immune.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Time Protection‌ matters more in this pack‌ than it‌ looks like it‌ should.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Big Ones</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Flight</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ the chestplate. Not‌ elytra, actual‌ creative style‌ flight.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Phase</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the‌ leggings, so‌ walls‌ are optional. Bedrock‌ and portals still say‌ no.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#9DB4BF to=#9DB4BF>Creative‌ flight, on a‌ survival‌ chestplate</grad>
Any Eclipse Alloy armour piece
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B7CBD4 to=#6A8290 f=0.6>Eclipse Alloy Armour</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The old‌ wand‌ plus a Ferricore, a‌ Blazegold and‌ two Celestigem, and‌ it‌ eats‌ the old‌ one.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>And a proper‌ energy‌ buffer, since it‌ wants‌ that‌ too.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Put the‌ two abilities on‌ different buttons.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Random‌ polymorph is‌ still‌ in‌ there if‌ you liked‌ the chaos.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ new trick is </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Targeted Polymorph</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Shift‌ right click‌ any‌ mob to‌ save its‌ shape, then‌ fire‌ at anything‌ else to turn it‌ into‌ that.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Numbers</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>32000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> units of fluid, four‌ times the‌ old wand.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ shot‌ either‌ way.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9DB4BF to=#9DB4BF>Now you‌ get to‌ choose</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B7CBD4 to=#6A8290 f=0.6>Advanced Polymorphic Wand</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hook‌ it‌ to a generator, set its‌ area, and‌ everything in that‌ box‌ gets‌ fed.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two transmitters‌ inside each‌ other's‌ area </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>share‌ for free</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Chain‌ them. Transmitter‌ to transmitter costs nothing, so‌ you only‌ pay‌ the toll‌ on the‌ last‌ short‌ hop.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It filters‌ too, so it can be‌ told‌ to skip things‌ that dont‌ need charge.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Numbers</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Moves‌ up‌ to </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per tick and‌ holds a million.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Loses </grad></shadow><grad from=#FF7A7A to=#FF3C3C f=0.8>1 percent‌ for‌ every block of‌ distance</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#5FD8C4>Wireless‌ power, at‌ a‌ small toll</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7CF2E4 to=#D2FFF9 f=0.6>Energy Transmitter</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything‌ Ferricore could‌ take, plus‌ the ones that change‌ your day.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Auto‌ Smoker</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the‌ sword, for whatever‌ you‌ kill.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Ground‌ Stomp</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on boots and </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Extinguish</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ the‌ chestplate.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Stupefy</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the‌ helmet, which‌ makes‌ a mob‌ forget you exist.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The‌ break ceiling‌ goes from `64` to `128`.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>If‌ you‌ already‌ kitted out‌ a Ferricore‌ set, craft a Template‌ instead of‌ starting again.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>New‌ Here</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Hammer</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ pickaxe, shovel and‌ hoe. 3x3 at‌ this‌ tier.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Auto‌ Smelter</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on pickaxe, shovel‌ and axe, so everything you‌ mine‌ comes out cooked.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#FFB070 to=#FFB070>Hammer time. Sorry</grad>
Any Blazegold tool
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC07A to=#FFE7CC f=0.6>Blazegold Tools</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#8CF5DE to=#DCFFF8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Weird‌ One</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>12.0</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>faster than Celestigem‌ and faster‌ than netherite</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Armour: </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1/3/5/2</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and a‌ chestplate‌ with </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>112</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> durability.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enchantability is‌ the </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>best‌ of all four tiers</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

[gap=5]
[gap=5]
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Wear‌ it if you enchant‌ hard‌ and repair often. Otherwise‌ its a‌ tool material.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ armour numbers‌ are lifted straight‌ off vanilla‌ gold, which makes‌ it‌ the </grad></shadow><grad from=#FF7A7A to=#FF3C3C f=0.8>worst‌ armour in‌ the mod</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ tools are a‌ different story.</grad></shadow>

[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Actual Numbers</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tools: </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1440</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> durability, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>12.0</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mining speed, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>3.0</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#FFB070 to=#FFB070>Fast, sharp, made‌ of‌ glass</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC07A to=#FFE7CC f=0.6>Blazegold Ingot</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Coal‌ block next‌ to‌ Primogel, then mine the result‌ for 3‌ to‌ 4 Primal‌ Coal.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7CF2E4 to=#1E9C97 f=0.8>Voidflame Coal</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>43200</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#B7CBD4 to=#4E626F f=0.8>Eclipse Ember</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>129600</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, or </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>81</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> normal‌ coals in‌ one lump.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Each‌ rung‌ is‌ the coal below‌ it, crafted‌ into a‌ block, fed‌ to‌ the next‌ goo up. Nine of‌ the old‌ for 3‌ to‌ 4‌ of the‌ new.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>These burn‌ times work in‌ a plain‌ furnace too.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Normal coal‌ burns‌ for </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>1600‌ ticks</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, this burns‌ for </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4800</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Whole Coal Ladder</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#B7F06A to=#6FBF2E f=0.8>Primal‌ Coal</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4800</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC07A to=#D96A3C f=0.8>Blaze‌ Ember</grad></shadow><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>14400</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

[gap=3]

## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Chest Trick</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bind‌ a‌ tool with </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Drops Teleport</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to a‌ chest, then right‌ click‌ the soil‌ with that‌ tool.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ till dirt‌ with‌ a </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Dire‌ hoe</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> while the‌ hoe is switched‌ on, and the‌ farmland comes‌ out‌ as‌ goo soil‌ matching the‌ hoe's tier.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It‌ also‌ refuses to‌ be trampled.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FD8C4 to=#C4F7EE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What Each‌ One Does</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click‌ a‌ block and‌ everything‌ around and behind‌ it </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>vanishes</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for a few seconds, then‌ puts‌ itself back exactly‌ as it‌ was.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Chests and‌ machines‌ are‌ skipped, so you‌ cant‌ accidentally delete your base. Doors‌ and portals‌ are‌ left alone‌ too.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A doorway‌ through‌ anything, that‌ tidies up‌ after you.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9DB4BF to=#9DB4BF>A portable hole, basically</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B7CBD4 to=#6A8290 f=0.6>Eclipsegate Wand</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Click it, put fuel‌ in, and‌ it charges every‌ energy‌ item‌ you are‌ carrying‌ at </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>5000</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same fuel‌ maths as the big‌ generator, so‌ better coal means‌ more energy‌ per item.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] This‌ keeps‌ a‌ Portal Gun, a‌ Time‌ Wand and an energy‌ hungry toolset‌ alive‌ out in‌ the world.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Tools‌ running‌ on‌ energy stop‌ spending durability.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B5E3DC to=#B5E3DC>A furnace, in your‌ trousers</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#CFF0E9 to=#6A9799 f=0.6>Pocket Generator</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two of‌ them, wrenched‌ together, trading everything‌ in‌ their‌ areas. Change the‌ radius on one‌ and the‌ other copies‌ it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Block‌ entities‌ come through‌ intact, so chests‌ keep their contents‌ and machines‌ keep their settings.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]

Holds </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>8‌ buckets</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of one‌ liquid‌ and‌ works like‌ a bucket.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>Iron Block</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> becomes‌ a‌ Raw‌ Ferricore Block‌ in </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>2 minutes</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#9FE04A to=#9FE04A>Clay, dirt, sugar, and a‌ corpse</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B7F06A to=#E4FFC4 f=0.6>Primogel Goo</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shapeless, a Blazegold Ingot‌ and a‌ Nether Wart‌ for </grad></shadow><grad from=#FFC46B to=#FF9E1F f=0.8>4</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Water‌ with one‌ of‌ these dropped in becomes </grad></shadow><grad from=#8CF5DE to=#2FA894 f=0.8>Polymorphic‌ Fluid</grad><shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which becomes‌ anything‌ you like.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Its‌ also an‌ ingredient‌ in‌ the original‌ Portal Gun, so make more‌ than‌ you think you‌ need.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cheap on‌ purpose. The expensive‌ bit‌ is‌ always whatever you‌ drop‌ in second.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FFB070 to=#FFB070>One‌ ingot, one‌ wart, four‌ out</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FFC07A to=#FFE7CC f=0.6>Polymorphic Catalyst</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop a‌ Time Crystal into Polymorphic Fluid, with‌ no goo‌ step this time.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Its‌ almost‌ transparent because‌ its‌ not entirely in this‌ timestream, which‌ is the sort‌ of‌ explanation‌ this mod‌ gives‌ before changing the‌ subject.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] A canister of this‌ lasts‌ a very long‌ time. The wand‌ only sips‌ at‌ it‌ unless you‌ go‌ for the truly silly‌ speeds.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Pipeable like‌ everything‌ else here.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#B8FF6B to=#B8FF6B>Nearly‌ invisible, on purpose</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#ECFF8C to=#7DFF6B f=0.6>Time Fluid</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest11: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ enemy‌ you hit shaves </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>1‌ second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> off your ability cooldowns.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In‌ a‌ crowd, with a wide‌ swing, this is‌ how you‌ get‌ an‌ armour set‌ ability‌ back before the fight‌ ends.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>One second‌ off‌ every cooldown, per‌ enemy hit</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest14: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A seal‌ is a‌ permanent stat rider. Put‌ the seal‌ and the item in an‌ anvil and‌ the item keeps‌ that‌ stat forever.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fourteen‌ colours, and‌ every one of them‌ says‌ exactly what it‌ does‌ on‌ the tin.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Three‌ of‌ them do something‌ on hit instead of‌ adding‌ a number.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Anvil them‌ onto gear‌ and they‌ stay‌ there</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest15: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Rage‌ stops triggering‌ by‌ itself. Instead‌ you store‌ it‌ and set it off‌ manually, once you‌ have‌ at least </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>100‌ Rage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

[!info] The rest‌ of‌ the‌ row: {Fury Band}, {Hate Sigil}, {Heart of Wrath}, {Spite Shard}, {Mechanical Aorta} and {Eye for Violence} all grant‌ Rage Bar access too. The‌ Aorta‌ damages you constantly‌ while Enraged, and‌ the Spite‌ Shard‌ hands‌ you Rage equal‌ to‌ a fifth‌ of‌ every‌ angry mob‌ within 5 blocks.
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Save‌ it for‌ when you‌ actually‌ need‌ it</grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Slaying‌ a mob while‌ Enraged extends‌ Rage by </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>1 second</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In a crowd‌ this turns‌ a short window‌ into‌ a very‌ long‌ one.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Every kill while Enraged‌ adds‌ a second</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest16: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Thrown, it drifts for‌ a moment‌ and then‌ seeks‌ out‌ the nearest‌ enemy.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On impact‌ it damages everything‌ within </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>10 blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ inflicts </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Miracle Blight</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>It goes looking for‌ someone</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest18: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ single photon that‌ ignores gravity‌ entirely. Its damage‌ scales‌ with‌ how fast‌ the‌ projectile is moving.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Pouch O' Photons</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> throws </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>3‌ to 10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ them‌ instead.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>No gravity, and‌ damage scales‌ with‌ speed</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest1D: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Conductite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Amped</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for 3‌ seconds, which‌ is 1.5x damage‌ dealt</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nyxium is‌ only interesting‌ if you‌ are‌ running‌ the spell‌ system on‌ the row below.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Void</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Invisibility for‌ 4 seconds</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Exodium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: a‌ random‌ buff‌ for 3 seconds</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Nyxium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Frugal‌ Mana‌ X</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for 4‌ seconds</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Virentium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the‌ quiet‌ one of‌ the five</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest1E: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Orange</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Critical Chance</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Green</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Luck</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Pink</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Lifesteal</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Purple</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Tenacity</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Green‌ pairs‌ with‌ every Terramity‌ dice item, because those all‌ scale‌ off Luck.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Critical Chance, Luck, Lifesteal, Tenacity</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.6>Crit And Luck Seals</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Brutality's melee‌ list is‌ long, and almost none‌ of‌ it is‌ a‌ plain sword. Nearly every one‌ has‌ an ability on‌ right‌ click.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ pack files‌ them‌ across six tier‌ tags, from netherite all the‌ way‌ up to bloody, so‌ what you‌ can hold‌ depends‌ on‌ which keeper‌ you‌ have already put down.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Fifty‌ weapons, and this‌ row‌ is the‌ ones you‌ swing</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest20: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Bomb‌ Sealed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> throws‌ out a Bomb‌ Flower. </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Cosmic Sealed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> rains down a‌ Star.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>What‌ triggers them depends‌ on where‌ you put‌ them:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On‌ a </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>weapon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: every‌ melee hit.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>armour</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: every‌ time‌ you take damage, and it‌ stacks.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On a </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>projectile</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: every‌ time‌ the projectile‌ lands.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bomb Sealed‌ armour‌ on‌ a tanky‌ build is genuinely absurd.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Bomb‌ and‌ Cosmic do something‌ instead of‌ adding a‌ number</grad>
Trigger Seals
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.6>Trigger Seals</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Stygian Step</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: dash‌ forward‌ and damage‌ everything‌ at‌ the far‌ end.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Chthonic Capsule</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: a blood‌ clot that‌ detonates shortly‌ after‌ it‌ lands, or immediately‌ if it‌ hits something.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Brimspike</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: conjure a‌ spike that‌ spins up and can be‌ fired. Damage scales‌ with how long‌ you‌ charged it, and‌ only‌ one can exist at‌ a‌ time.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Hellspec Tie</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> refunds </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>25 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ the‌ mana‌ any Brimwielder‌ spell‌ costs.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Dash, blood clots and‌ a spinning spike</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.6>Brimwielder</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two very‌ different‌ halves‌ of one‌ row.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Left is stars, black‌ holes and‌ nuclear weapons. Right‌ is‌ a‌ wooden ruler, a‌ piece of‌ paper and a‌ graphics card.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Both‌ halves are filed at real‌ tiers. The graphics‌ card is not‌ a‌ joke item, it‌ is‌ a curse.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>The ones that‌ rearrange‌ the sky, and the‌ ones‌ that‌ are jokes</grad>
Show me
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.6>Cosmic And Cursed</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest22: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The black‌ hole‌ pulls‌ nearby mobs in‌ and‌ damages them, and‌ it‌ deals </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>reverse‌ knockback</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so nothing‌ you hit gets‌ away.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You can‌ dislodge it‌ and‌ move‌ it above‌ you.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Formed itself‌ together after the‌ big bang‌ explosion. Some say it talks too.</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest23: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Teleports you behind‌ whatever‌ you are‌ looking‌ at.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Backstabs‌ with it‌ do </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>7x damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so the‌ teleport is‌ not the‌ point, it‌ is‌ the setup.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>You‌ got blood‌ on my suit.</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest24: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each‌ Fate Card‌ does one of five‌ things: Slowness‌ II for 3‌ seconds, Poison II‌ for 3‌ seconds, ignite‌ for‌ 5 seconds, Wither II‌ for‌ 3 seconds, or‌ a‌ 5‌ tick stun.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Deck‌ of Cards</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the‌ other one: </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Magic‌ Power LII</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for‌ 2‌ to‌ 10 seconds.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>One‌ card, five possible‌ outcomes</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.6>Deck Of Fate</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Brutality‌ adds two slots that no‌ other mod‌ uses: </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Anklet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Heart</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Anklets are almost‌ all‌ short, sharp reactions. Most‌ of‌ them fire for three‌ to‌ ten seconds and‌ then‌ go‌ quiet again.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Start‌ with‌ the </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Empty Anklet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and work‌ out from there.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest25: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ melon, and a‌ pun, and‌ a‌ weapon.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Winter Melon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the‌ row‌ above is‌ its‌ cold‌ cousin.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest27: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Anklet of the Gnome King</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Haste‌ III for‌ 20 seconds</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hexed halves‌ the health‌ of anything‌ it‌ expires‌ on, and deals </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>20‌ damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ anything that is not‌ a player.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Trial Anklet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Resistance‌ III‌ and Slowness‌ III‌ for 10 seconds</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Gundalf's Anklet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Hexed‌ for‌ 1 second on‌ whoever‌ hit‌ you</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Davy's Anklet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Vulnerability‌ for‌ 10 seconds on‌ whoever hit you</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Devil's Anklet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Hexed‌ for‌ 1 second</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ruby, Onyx, Topaz‌ and‌ Sapphire. Each one deals magic‌ damage‌ and sets enemies‌ on‌ fire‌ for 3‌ seconds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They‌ sit at diamond‌ tier, which makes them the‌ first‌ genuinely good Brutality‌ weapon most‌ players can‌ hold.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>One‌ per‌ gem, all four‌ identical</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest29: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Heavenly‌ Flight</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: grants </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Mortal‌ Flight</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ is elytra‌ flight with no‌ elytra.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Holy Mantle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: grants </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Grace</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, nullifying‌ your next‌ instance‌ of‌ damage. It scales‌ with level.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Sacrifice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: heals‌ nearby players including‌ you, spreading the‌ healing evenly and passing any‌ excess to‌ the next lowest.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Divine‌ Retribution</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: calls‌ judgement down‌ on‌ a spot.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Light Binding</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: shackles a‌ target‌ in place.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Flight, shields and‌ judgement‌ from‌ above</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest2C: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Salt‌ Shaker</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Pepper‌ Shaker</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Salted I and‌ Peppered I‌ on true‌ melee‌ hits.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Salt‌ and Pepper</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: both‌ at‌ level II, on </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>all</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, for 6 seconds.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Hot‌ Sauce</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Hot and‌ Spicy‌ II.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Olive Oil</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Oiled‌ II for‌ 3‌ seconds. </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Extra‌ Virgin Olive‌ Oil</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Oiled IV for 6‌ seconds‌ on all damage.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Tomato‌ Sauce</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Cheese Sauce</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Pizza‌ Slop</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Slicked, at escalating‌ levels.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C0392B to=#C0392B>Salt, pepper, oil‌ and‌ sauce</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest2E: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Absolute Zero</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: throws‌ a‌ bottle of liquid‌ nitrogen that‌ freezes and‌ slows‌ everything‌ nearby.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Permafrost Cube</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: freezes nearby‌ enemies‌ on hit.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Ice‌ Cube</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: freezes‌ whatever‌ it hits.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C0392B to=#F2A9A0 f=0.8>Winter‌ Melon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: slows and freezes‌ on impact.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.kilovetomboysr.quest2F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ filed‌ at‌ emerald tier, which‌ puts it very early, and‌ it‌ is still a‌ staff made‌ of bamboo.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That‌ is the ladder. Twenty swords, one‌ design, and‌ the only thing‌ that ever‌ changed was‌ the‌ metal.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest4E2EEF7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hits </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>twice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and builds </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Flames‌ Hex‌ stacks for 5 seconds‌ plus </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Stained Calamity‌ stacks‌ for 3.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest505B946: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four‌ food‌ items, all of them‌ from somewhere‌ very specific, and‌ all‌ of‌ them useful.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest614A815: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three‌ piercing‌ scythes and‌ two‌ pitchforks per swing, all burning‌ and inflicting </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Shadowflame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Same‌ on‌ hit.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ a joke‌ that‌ was‌ then given‌ real‌ numbers.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.6>Battle Maid Armour</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest6FC707A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Flowey‌ Pin</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> grants‌ Strength I.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest7234C8C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Inflicts </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Acid‌ Venom</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for 2‌ seconds‌ on‌ hit.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest747886A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Triple‌ damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from‌ backstabs, plus </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Flames Hex‌ stacks and </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Stained Calamity stacks.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>I said my‌ sword was‌ a tool of justice. Not used‌ in anger. Not‌ used for revenge. But‌ now, I‌ am not‌ so‌ sure. And besides, the kitty purrs.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.lethality.quest7D4FD0B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>50 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance‌ to‌ Coin‌ Crit on‌ hit.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wearing a </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Fateful Coin</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes‌ Coin Crit‌ guaranteed and‌ doubles‌ its‌ damage.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In this‌ pack it‌ is gold blocks, a </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Fateful‌ Coin</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, topaz blocks, a </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Jackpot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ a </grad><grad from=#A31419 to=#EBA0A0 f=0.8>Duskrok Greatsword</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.lightning_element.ques: Imbue‌ yourself‌ with the‌ power of‌ lightning, increasing‌ your‌ speed and‌ combat abilities.
Charge
Hold to manifest‌ a‌ cone of electrical‌ energy, damaging creatures‌ in its‌ path.
Electrocute
Hold‌ to‌ charge‌ a spear‌ made of lightning. Release‌ to throw‌ it like‌ a‌ javelin, dealing‌ high damage‌ to the‌ creature it hits.
Lightning Lance
Start a chain‌ of lightning‌ from a‌ targeted‌ creature, causing‌ waves of‌ zapping‌ magic to cascade to‌ nearby creatures.
Chain Lightning
Conjure an orb‌ of‌ lightning‌ that slowly‌ moves‌ forward, damaging creatures it‌ phases through and bouncing‌ off‌ blocks.
Ball Lightning
The‌ Lightning school‌ is centered around‌ concentrated damage.
Lightning magic
Coalesce‌ a surge‌ of electrical power, and unleash it‌ in a‌ devastating shockwave, blasting exposed‌ creatures.
Shockwave
Cast‌ to strike lightning at your‌ feet and‌ ascend quickly into‌ the‌ air, and gain‌ reduced‌ gravity for the next‌ few‌ seconds.
Ascension
Down‌ from‌ the heavens, summon a‌ bolt‌ of lightning.
Lightning Bolt
Cast‌ to conjure‌ a‌ thunderstorm centered around yourself, which‌ strikes‌ nearby creatures within‌ sight‌ with‌ a small‌ bolt‌ of lightning every‌ 2 seconds for the‌ spell's‌ duration.
Thunderstorm

The charm tier decides which ones.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Charm 2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Remnant Shard of Explosion, Unliving Ice, Essence of Life.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Charm 3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Wither Force Field, Essence of Wind.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest2168B10: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Henchmen, frozen zombies and strays, then frost giants, then mutants. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Krampus</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> himself comes last with triple health.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest27C4B9F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two food systems, both easy to miss.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every different food you try counts. Twenty five of them is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra hearts.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Big meals also grant </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Well Fed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Plenty Satisfied</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Exquisitely Stuffed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>15 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more damage and speed for twenty minutes.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A kitchen that crafts meals out of its own cupboards, Farmer's Delight pots and boards included.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest2DCF27B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Born in Chaos throws everything at you, with From the Shadows clerics and nehemoths mixed in. Zombies and pumpkins first, bruisers halfway, knights and hounds at the end. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Lord Pumpkinhead</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> closes it out.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Candy, dark metal and seeds of chaos drop along the way.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cursed Lantern: carved pumpkin, soul torch, 2 rotten flesh, a bone. Night only.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0602A to=#FFD2B0 f=0.6>Night of Chaos</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest2E911F1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Goblins, the little Armageddon goblins and a few trollagers. At the end the </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Goblin Warchief</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shows up, a trollager with four times the health.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drops gold, emeralds and goblin maces.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Goblin War Horn: goat horn, 2 gold ingots, leather. Works day or night.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest3E8727C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The third screen offers a ring, or nothing.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Seven Curses</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the Cursed Ring. Looting VII, Fortune VII, triple experience, spells on a hair trigger. - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Seven Virtues</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the Virtue Ring. Luck VII, triple chest loot, longer potion effects. In return melee fights your hand, monsters guard the innocent, and spells drain the aura of the land.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest425F9D4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mechanical crafting from Advanced Motor Extensions and Reinforced Motors, with one Linggangonium in the corner.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Goety ritual, activated with a Purified Mana Shard, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>666</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> souls and a raider. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tech: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Mechanical Crafters</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the Purified Mana Shard and Fartinium in a four by four of </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>14</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> tech parts: multiversal circuits, exoversal alloys, Awakened Supremium, a Maximum Compact Machine and the like. JEI has the layout.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Magic: the Purified Mana Shard in an </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Enchanting Apparatus</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> source, with Fartinium, Morgan, an Awakened Elemental Soul and The Infinitum on the pedestals.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest4BC5710: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Linggangonium in the middle of six clocks: the Clock of Frozen Time, the Sundered, Rampage, Timekeeper's and Shattered Clocks, and a plain clock.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9A7CFF to=#9A7CFF>Time is a flat circle</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest4BF851A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two iron, a book, an amethyst shard and five planks. Place it, right-click it, and you get a </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>skill tree</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Hold the mouse button on a node to study it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The first tab is </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>The Parry</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Eighteen skills, up to five ranks each, and every rank has a name. Class tabs come later.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The base parry is deliberately weak. The tree is what makes it good.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest4F735D4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hover a node and two arrows appear beside its rank bar. Step the preview below your rank and click the node to </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>drop down</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to it. Every level and every item that rank cost comes back.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Reset the tree</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at the bottom of the panel drops everything to zero and refunds all of it. Click it twice.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your parry and perfect parry counts are never touched, so buying back is instant.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5298202: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mechanical crafting: four Orbital Railguns, four Stairways to Heaven, four Anti Material Rifles, three Olympus and one Linggangonium.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5628BD4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three smaller edibles, each a permanent bump with its own cap.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Mana Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Spell Power. Up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Mana Capacity Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> maximum mana. Up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Mana Regeneration Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+50 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana regeneration. Up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Mana Crystal is nine upgrade orbs in a grid. The other two want Arcane Ingots, a Divine Pearl, hogskin and a Crystal Heart.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All three also come out of </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Mechanical Crafters</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Precision Mechanisms, circuits and a Blazing Crystal for the Mana Crystal, storage augments and a capacitor for capacity, transfer augments and coils for regeneration. JEI has the grids.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest56591E7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Press </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>F</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with a weapon in hand. Untrained, the window is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, a miss locks you out for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>7 seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and puts Slowness II on you for three, and nothing you parry is perfect.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Payoff</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Mend heals, Shockwave hits everything around you on a perfect parry, Ironhand lets you parry bare handed.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Control</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Stagger debuffs the attacker, Deflection returns projectiles, Unbinding catches fireballs, then spells, then explosions.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Offerings</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Anchor, Shockwave, Siphon, Soul Tithe, Blood Tithe and Ironhand. Optional, and Ironhand is the only way to parry bare handed.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Cold Read rank 1 costs 30 parries and nothing else. Take it first, everything priced in perfect parries sits behind it.

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Timing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Footwork widens the window, Cold Read unlocks perfect parries, Peripheral widens the arc.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Recovery</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Recovery and Anchor shrink the punishment for missing or for catching a heavy hit.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC8A0 f=0.6>The Parry Tab</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5B34B76: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Picked once per world. Mob health and mob damage scale together.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Extreme</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> health and damage, double fall damage. Animals and villagers fight back and bring friends.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Torture</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, triple fall damage. Hits can wither you or cripple you, and every hit drains hunger.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Chaos</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>6x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> health, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage, random mobs teleport in around you every two seconds, double experience. Locked until someone on the world kills Nyxaris.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Teleport command cooldowns and the parry window also follow the difficulty.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Easy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: half health, half damage, half fall damage, and you heal on your own.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Cozy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: three quarters, slow healing, breathe underwater.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Normal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the pack as designed.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Veteran</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.5x</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5BE3FC7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mechanical crafting, four by four: three Extra Virgin Olive Oil Charms, a Frog Leg, a Glowbug Lantern, two Experience Jellies, two Slime Blocks, Arion's Heart and a Poisonous Hand.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No crafters? Arion's Heart in an </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Enchanting Apparatus</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> source, with the same parts on the pedestals: the Frog Leg, the Glowbug Lantern, the Poisonous Hand, two Experience Jellies, a Slime Block and two Olive Oil Charms.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It goes into the Magic Vessel, the Purified Shard and Linggangonium itself, so you will make more than one.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#57D165 to=#57D165>Made out of the smelliest things!</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5BEC303: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right-click to remove one </grad><grad from=#F4EEE2 to=#BFB3A0 f=0.8>harmful effect</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Instant, no cooldown, one stone per effect.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Dropped by </grad><grad from=#F4EEE2 to=#BFB3A0 f=0.8>Maneater Shells</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, up to two each, more with Looting.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5D255B1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each rank asks for up to four things.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Parries</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>perfect parries</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> you have landed. These are thresholds, never spent.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Experience levels</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, taken from you.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Trait items</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, taken from your inventory.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Early ranks want parries. Middle ranks add levels. Late ranks want all three, and the last rank of anything is expensive.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The panel under the tree shows the full price of the next rank, and the tooltip says Locked until you can pay it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC8A0 f=0.6>Paying for Ranks</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5D48142: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sixteen classes, chosen once and for all. Each one changes your attributes for good, hands you a starter kit, and gives you one </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>active skill</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>G</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> key.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Civilian</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: no changes at all.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>North Mage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: 20%% more mana capacity on demand.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>South Mage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: double spell power while your health drains.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Steampunk Machinist</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: repair the item in your hand by 20%%.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Monk</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: regenerate out of combat.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The selection screen lists every number. The skills, in short:</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Vampire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: strong at night, weak by day, a blood blade that heals.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Miner</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: Fortune II on every tool, punch stone bare handed.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Berserker</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: rage: lose most of your health, hit faster and harder.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Gambler</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: roll a random class skill.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Gunner</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: fire an explosive round.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Scum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: half of all enemies ignore you, the Cursed Ring at full strength.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Deflector</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: every parry counts as perfect for a while.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Puppeteer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: minions strike twice as hard and twice as often.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Picked wrong? A Tome of Rebirth lets you choose again. Beating the Iron Colossus gives one, and more are crafted from a book, crying obsidian, an ender pearl and a Life Essence.
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Vanguard</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: raise your sword to block.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Deflector and Puppeteer are tied to two systems in this chapter: the Study Lectern and</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Pathfinder</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: arrow hits stack up to +50%% damage.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Ironclad</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: absorb 3 seconds of hits and add them to your next swing.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5DB38AC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Just want to farm in peace? Craft a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>White Flag</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and right-click it. Random invasions stop coming for you.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right-click it again to turn them back on.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>4 white wool and a stick. Summon items still work while it is on.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest5FB3324: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything in this chapter was built for this pack and exists nowhere else: the classes, the difficulty screen, the Study Lectern, the smithing stones, the mana shards and the road to creative items.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Mana Shards</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: permanent spell power.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Stones</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: free durability and damage from a smithing table.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Food and Guns</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the two side systems that are easy to miss.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five branches below. None of them needs the others.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Choose Wisely</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the three screens every new world opens with.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Study Lectern</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: the block where your parry gets good.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest61EFB96: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enchanting Apparatus, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> source: Linggangonium in the middle of ten Source Jars.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9A7CFF to=#DDD2FF f=0.6>Creative Source Jar</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest64AE220: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enchanting Apparatus, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> source: Linggangonium in the middle of ten Archmage Spell Books.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9A7CFF to=#DDD2FF f=0.6>Creative Spell Book</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest6AC32CA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put one in a smithing table with any tool, weapon, shield, bow, trident or elytra. No template, and the item keeps everything it had.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each stone adds </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> points to a buffer on the item. Wear eats the buffer before it touches durability, and the buffer vanishes once spent. Stack as many as you like.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>About one dungeon chest in five carries one to five of them.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest6B32547: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any boss you have beaten can be brought back harder. </grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Right click</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> it. Pick a boss from the list, put trait items in the eight slots and press </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Summon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. The altar shows the level and the loot it will come back with before you press anything.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest6D1FE2F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eat it once. Your </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Spell Power</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> goes up by </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>300 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and Ars Nouveau spells hit </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> harder, for the rest of your life. Death keeps it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Made in an Enchanting Apparatus from an Echo Shard, for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> source, with a Magician's Blood Orb, a Mark of Mastery, the Worldshaper Axe, the Ancient Builder's Charm, an Iron Hide Focus, a Gemwoven Fragment and Eldorath's lore scroll on the pedestals.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three shards, three tiers. A higher tier replaces the lower one; a lower shard does nothing once you are past it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No apparatus? </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Mechanical Crafters</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> make it too: the Echo Shard in a four by four of </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>14</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> tech parts, one apex piece from every tech mod. JEI has the layout.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9A7CFF to=#DDD2FF f=0.6>Fading Shard of Pure Mana</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest71E2779: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ten enchantments that only go on guns, from the enchanting table and loot like any other.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Arcane Rounds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> bonus magic damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Vest Shredder</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: ignores part of the target's armour, best against armoured bosses.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Shrapnel Piercer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: each hit strips </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour, stacking high.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Elemental Barrage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: a chance of Bleeding, Vulnerability and Armor Decrease.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Resource Magazines</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: hits refund ammo, less the more your other gear already saves.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Guns also have their own </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Gun Damage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> attribute, so reforges and buffs that raise it stack with all of this.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Overclocked Rounds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: every hit stacks damage, up to thirty stacks, and they bleed off slowly when you stop.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Rail Charge</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Explosive Rounds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of the bullet as splash damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Bullet Echo</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: a chance to hit twice, the echo at half damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#F07A34 to=#F07A34>Pew pew, but more</grad>
Loaded
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F07A34 to=#FFE6BE f=0.6>Gun Enchantments</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest7390842: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same table, same slot, but it buys damage. Each stone is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+0.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> attack damage on the weapon, up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>+10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. That is twenty stones, and the table refuses the twenty first.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tools, weapons, tridents and clawblades only. Rarer than the plain stone: one chest in ten in the Nether, the other dimensions and strongholds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#CFC3AE to=#FBF7F0 f=0.6>Somber Smithing Stone</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest7CE2CC7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every trait item on the altar is one more copy of everything the boss drops. Eight offerings is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>nine times</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> the loot. Each one also adds </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>25</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> levels to the boss.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A trait's rank climbs with every copy of the same item, up to that trait's own cap. Break the altar and the offerings come back out.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Bosses with a second phase carry the nightmare into it, and killing the second phase counts as beating the first.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest7DFE6E2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The class built around this block. Ironhand 1 and Deflection 2 come free, the armour gate on Ironhand is skipped, and the parry cooldown is cut to two thirds.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Only a Deflector sees </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Unbinding rank 4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>: parry everything, fall damage and lava included. It costs 5 percent of your maximum health for as long as you hold it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Skill: </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Mikiri</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. For 6 seconds every parry is perfect, and each perfect parry adds a second.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.quest9AF5D62: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A new world opens three screens in a row before you can move: </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Difficulty</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Class</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, then </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Path</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Nothing can hurt you while they are open.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>None of the three can be changed later without an admin. Read the next three quests before you click through.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD0E2 to=#4FD0E2>Three screens, no undo. For now.</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.questBE487B3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Some bosses open an invasion. A crowd of themed mobs comes straight for you, a bar at the top fills with every kill and a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>big one</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shows up at the end.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Start one with its </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>summon item</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> whenever you want. Or just wait, every night there is a small chance an unlocked one starts on its own.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Invaders ignore the crowd rule and all swing at once. They do not break blocks and do not despawn while it runs.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Veteran</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Chaos</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> difficulty a miniboss or two from other mods joins the last wave.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Dying pauses it. Logging out or leaving the dimension ends it, and whatever is left runs off. Everyone near you shares the bar and the win.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.linggango.title: <shadow a=0.4><grad from=#945B1E to=#C4B78B>Linggango</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>If‌ you use‌ the </grad><grad from=#FFA333 to=#FCDFB8 f=0.8>Great‌ Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> on‌ a </grad><grad from=#FFD700 to=#FFFF99 f=0.8>Cat</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> or </grad><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#E8E8E8 f=0.8>Wolf</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> they will‌ transform into a more.. </grad><grad from=#42FF42 to=#BAFFBA f=0.8>useful‌ creature</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>After using‌ the great‌ essence on‌ them:</grad></shadow>
<shadow><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>After‌ dropping‌ some items to‌ them:</grad></shadow>
<shadow><grad from=#FFA333 to=#FCDFB8 f=0.3>Dog‌ looks‌ so‌ goofy</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana for the gauntlet. After that it reaches into your inventory, your bags and your ender chest and throws copies of every weapon in there at whatever you are looking at.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>300</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana per weapon in the normal mode.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift right click for AOE mode, which fires from behind you in a spread. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>350</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana each, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> weapons per volley, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> volleys a tick.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift again for Chains, which spawns </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of them around your target and holds it in place. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>350</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana a chain.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each projectile does a full swing with the weapon it copied, so the ceiling on this is your own armoury. Bringing more distinct swords makes it fire faster.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Eye of Ender</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The copy has </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> durability and then it is gone. It cannot be repaired at an anvil and Mending is stripped out of it, so it stays a loan and never becomes a duplicate.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana each time you use the scroll.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest32B9: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Circle only. Anything standing on one gets sent to another one nearby, and which one depends on the order you placed them in. Sneak to stand on one without going anywhere.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The zone moves with the familiar, and there are particles so you can see where the edge is.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nothing moves unless there is something on </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>both</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> circles, and then the two swap. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana per teleport.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Ender Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Ender Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3811: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Multiplies downward velocity by </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for everything within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks except you. Drop a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>name tag</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on it and you get a live view of whatever carries that name, wherever it is, along with the ground around it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana per tag, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds of viewing. It works on players as well as named mobs.</grad></shadow>
