ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3B88: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Strengthen a sword. Stand in the </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Ender Dragon's breath</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Right click.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Clarent keeps no damage value of its own. It hits for whatever its target is holding, so it is useless against unarmed mobs and dangerous against armed ones.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blocking with it stores half of what it blocked, up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>250</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and the next hit spends the lot.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stored damage bleeds away slowly while you keep blocking.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Its hits leave a wound that damages the target when they move, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> times, for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It is unbreakable. It was made to be used once, on one person.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3C7A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Weapons. Copying them, throwing them, sharpening them, and eventually pulling a holy sword out of a lake.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3D7B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The damage comes from the landing, so it does not care how much health the target had.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The scroll gives you a staff. Point it at something and hold to charge, and it goes flying in the direction you are looking. Longer charge, more speed.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana for the staff.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana per launch.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Aimed at a block instead, it drags everything within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks in first and then throws the lot, for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana a second.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Ender Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3E30: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drawn in the floor, it throws anything standing on it to the highest solid block above. As a scroll, it only takes you.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana a trip.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3E8A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana calls a small spirit that follows you around and tells you about interesting mobs, players and blocks it passes. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click it holding a block and it will only report </grad><grad from=#F4EEE2 to=#BFB3A0 f=0.8>that</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> block from then on. Right click with an empty hand to clear the filter.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#F4EEE2 to=#BFB3A0 f=0.8>Quartz</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#F4EEE2 to=#BFB3A0 f=0.8>Quartz</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#F4EEE2 to=#BFB3A0 f=0.8>Quartz</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest3FE7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana drops you into a world of your own, a plain of buried swords under a burnt sky. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With a passenger, one of you has to die before either of you leaves. Alone, taking a hit is enough to send you back.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest40F1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Swaps your health percentage with your target's. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The bill is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>120</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana for every point of health that moves, so the bigger the gap and the bigger the target, the more it costs. ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest432E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Trades. Durability for mana, time for mana, damage for mana, one block for another. This is the school that pays for the others.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest4A22: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It caps at the same </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>48</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> as Caliburn.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The change is one way. Caliburn does not come back.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Caliburn, corrupted. It is made by killing your own tamed wolf with the holy sword, and there is no other way to do it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It does not draw from a lake. It draws from villagers, and it draws more from the children. Each one raises its damage and heals whatever the sword has taken, for mana.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold right click to release a ball of evil that stabs and drags nearby enemies in.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The keybind grants Rage, a short burst of attack and movement speed.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Both share a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> second cooldown.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest4D27: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The loud school. Shields, launchers, borrowed divinity, and a staff that removes the landscape.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest509C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Fae drift around leylines and you cannot see them without Fay Sight. They sound like small bells. They also drop the only material in the mod that is not a rock.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Essence is not bound to you. Circles and scrolls made with it can be used by anyone, which is the whole reason it matters. It is also what a Mana Circuit is built out of.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They breed on any powdered catalyst, and they are drawn to magic performed on a leypoint.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Cast on a strong leypoint. Magic performed there is what draws them in.
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5102: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Hammer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is string, cobble and sticks, and it grinds one catalyst into one powder. A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Mortar and Pestle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> costs four diamonds and grinds one into </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Grindable: Iron Ingot, Gold Ingot, Diamond, Emerald, Nether Quartz, Ender Pearl, Eye of Ender.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Make the Mortar and Pestle. Every circle costs three powders, so the doubled yield pays back the four diamonds quickly.
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest513B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sight that does things. Six of these change what you can see, and what you see changes what happens to it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Base catalyst: Eye of Ender.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5154: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>320</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds. Look at anything and you get its inventory, its buffs, its debuffs and the rest of the sheet.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Works on chests and on players.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#B0F2CE to=#46C48A f=0.8>Eye of Ender</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#B0F2CE to=#46C48A f=0.8>Eye of Ender</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#B0F2CE to=#46C48A f=0.8>Ender Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD49A to=#CDFAE4 f=0.6>Mystic Eyes of Insight</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5388: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put worms in a chest under an active </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Scrying</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> circle and you can reach through it. Throw items on the circle and the thing being scryed gets the effect, wherever it is.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Blaze powder burns. A rabbit foot makes it hop. Splash potions apply. Glowstone marks it. Rotten flesh starves it. Ender pearl moves it. Nether wart confuses it. Another worm curses it.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Carrying a good worm yourself makes all of the above fail against you, and sometimes bounce back.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A mob farm that lets its residents fight each other is a worm farm.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Dirt, a carrot, a potato, a poisonous potato, rotten flesh and a nether wart. What comes out is a worm that feeds on conflict.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every time a monster kills something its kodoku value goes up by </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, plus whatever its victim had banked. Find something that has been winning for a while, right click it with a hungry worm, then kill it. The worm inherits the total.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#CC3B52 to=#FFB2B9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What A Fat Worm Is For</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Burn it near a Mana Circuit and it fills it. Closer to a leyline means more.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest55C3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Circle only. Once a day, around the time it was placed, it turns the blocks under it into other blocks of the same class. Dirt becomes sand, stone becomes ice, diamond ore becomes emerald ore.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It reaches </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks down and costs </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana a cycle while it works.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#9BEC86 to=#3FBF4F f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BEC86 to=#3FBF4F f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BEC86 to=#3FBF4F f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>No cloth. The circle stays where you drew it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Slow, random and unattended. Place it over blocks you do not need.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5859: [!tip] Geasa on creatures you never fight cost nothing to keep and still count toward the regeneration bonus, which caps quickly.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A geas is a promise you make to yourself and then cannot break. Use it on a sheep and you can never hurt a sheep again. Use it on a named sheep and it protects that one sheep. Use it on a player and you cannot harm them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana to place one, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to remove one, and burning the scroll clears the lot. Use it with no target to read back what you have sworn.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Point it at an item on the floor and you stop picking that item up.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every unrelated creature you swear off raises your mana regeneration, up to a ceiling.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF9AA2 to=#D6455C f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5A8B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A wall of petals in front of you for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds. Mobs bounce off it and projectiles are deleted on contact.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>300</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana. Sneaking into it bounces you as well, which makes it a step.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE1A0 to=#E8A22E f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5B18: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An invisible wall with a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> block radius. You walk through it. Mobs, arrows and everything else do not.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It will not overwrite solid blocks or water, only grass, so it fits around terrain that is already there. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana every </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#CFDDEE to=#7C9CC4 f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#CFDDEE to=#7C9CC4 f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#CFDDEE to=#7C9CC4 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>With cloth you get a scroll, without it the circle stays where you drew it.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5BBF: ## <grad from=#D95C24 to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Mystic Code, First Sorcery</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The same frame, but with </grad><grad from=#9BEC86 to=#3FBF4F f=0.8>Fae Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Powdered Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the middle. Scrolls inside it are not consumed when you cast them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It has </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> uses of its own instead. Every scroll it would have consumed in that time is kept.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The Boundary of Drain Life is blocked from this. Everything else is fair game.
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest5EEC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The dagger Probability Alter hands you. It has a Modulus, fixed when it was made, and a Dividend you raise by shift right clicking.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click yourself and every random whole number the game asks for on your behalf comes back as </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>dividend modulo modulus</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of a roll. Every random decimal comes back as </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>dividend divided by modulus</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Hit something with it and the same happens to them.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> uses, and the effect lasts </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana to set up, and a range of </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] A high modulus with a dividend of zero means nothing random ever favours the target again.
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest6103: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A block that holds </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana and hands it to you from up to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks away. Whoever right clicks it first owns it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Fae Essence version costs eight essence around a powdered emerald. The Magitech version is eight iron and two powdered emerald, and holds exactly the same.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Right click a circuit with Fae Essence to open it to other players. Shift right click toggles it off.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest6276: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You and the familiar swap positions for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana. Send it somewhere, then be there.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is the cheapest long range teleport in the mod, limited only by how far the familiar has already travelled.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest650F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One white wool cut with the dagger gives </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>four</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cloths. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It does not burn blocks. It burns things, as wither damage, and it leaves the burn on them for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>9</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds after they get out.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It burns out on its own. Five seconds of area denial, not a permanent fire.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest687A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pulls the familiar back to you for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana. The cheapest spell in the mod.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana for the staff, then three firing modes.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hold to charge, release for a single blast of radius </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>14</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift right click once for scattered smaller blasts, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>600</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana each.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift right click again for the beam. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>500</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana a tick, it eats blocks in front of it, and the damage climbs the longer you hold it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All three scale off your </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>maximum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana, not your current pool, so this staff gets better every time you cast anything else.</grad></shadow>

ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest6938: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A curse fired from your hand that costs </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent of your maximum mana per shot and deals </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent of what it cost, between </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also strips every negative effect off you as it leaves and dumps them at the point of impact, in a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>6</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> block cloud that lingers for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> seconds.</grad></shadow>

[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>At least </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Death Collection souls banked.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The bow has </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> durability. Shift right click it to make it use only projected weapons, which pairs with the page before this one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#A8ECF4 to=#3FC2D6 f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest7D26: 3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click the circle with </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>three powdered catalysts</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
4. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The three you chose decide which spell you get.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Lay a </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Spell Cloth</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> down first and draw the circle on top of it, and the spell rolls up into a scroll you can carry. Skip the cloth and the circle stays in the floor, running where you left it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything costs mana. You start with almost none, and every </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana you spend raises your ceiling by </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Casting is the only way to grow.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You are a magic user. Nobody taught you, there is no research tree, and there are no levels. There is a knife, some powder, and your own blood.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mana ticks back every </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>five seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and a full hunger bar is most of that.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sleeping restores </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>half</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> your maximum in one go.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The ceiling is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

[!info] Seven catalysts, seven schools. Iron is Boundaries, Ender Pearl is Displacement, Diamond is Projection, Emerald is Exchange, Gold is Mystic, Quartz is Intelligence, and the Eye of Ender is Mystic Eyes.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The eight hubs are the seven schools plus the Secrets. They can be done in any order.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E05050 to=#FFA8A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>How A Spell Is Made</shadow></grad>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Take damage. A </grad><grad from=#FFB3B3 to=#E04B4B f=0.8>Dagger</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> does it cleanly.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Press the circle keybind while wounded. A blood circle appears under you.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.quest7DA7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your body stays put and you go for a walk without it. Range is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks before you snap back, and it costs </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>300</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Ender Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Ender Pearl</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C7B8FF to=#7B5CE6 f=0.8>Quartz</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Cloth first, then the circle on top. You get a scroll.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.questA932: ## <grad from=#D95C24 to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Caliburn</shadow></grad>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#D95C24 to=#FFDCA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What It Does</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Undead and unholy things are afraid of it and run.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click pulls both you and them back together.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The keybind smites everything unholy within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks, splitting its damage between them. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>300</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> second cooldown.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Its swings sweep everything within </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The lake returns it carrying your sword's damage, up to its own limit. Nether stars raise that limit.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> durability, no repairs, no Mending.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is still a sword. Enchant it, throw it back in the lake, and the whole process runs again on the better version.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Anything named after something unholy counts, whether or not it is undead. Check what you are pointing this at.
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Out of the lake it caps at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>18</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> attack damage.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Throw </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>nether stars</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into the lake alongside it and the cap rises: </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>24</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>36</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>42</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>48</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at five.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They have to go in together. Two stars twice is not five stars once.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
<typewriter><grad from=#F07A34 to=#F07A34>Sword of the victorious</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F07A34 to=#FFE6BE f=0.6>Caliburn</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.questAD61: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Strengthen a plain stick and be struck by lightning while holding it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Emrys goes in your offhand. It feeds lightning into your melee weapon, some projectiles, and an empty right hand.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Focused lightning reaches </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>22</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks and does </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage a second for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The passive zap does </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] A thunderstorm, high ground, and a trident with Channeling.
ftbquests.chapter.mahou_tsukai.questE099: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Circle only. Placed on the floor it starts growing a lake of murky water, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana a cycle, out to a radius of </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>12</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It needs to reach at least </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>150</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks before it counts as a lake.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Then throw an </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>enchanted sword</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into it. For </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> mana the lake takes the sword and gives back Caliburn, carrying the sword's damage plus a share of what its enchantments were worth.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holier is better. The lake pays more for Smite than it does for Sharpness.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Catalysts: </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD08A to=#E0662E f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>No cloth. The circle stays where you drew it.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The lake will not hand anything over until the tasks in the book it gives you are done.

ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest135267E1: # <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Build A‌ Box</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any hollow rectangle‌ of Dynamic‌ Tank blocks‌ with‌ at‌ least one </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Dynamic‌ Valve</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ wall becomes one‌ enormous tank.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each‌ block of interior volume holds </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>350</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> buckets‌ of fluid.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Or </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>16,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ a chemical.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A modest‌ cube‌ holds more‌ than‌ you will ever need, and‌ structural‌ glass counts as‌ a‌ valid‌ wall so‌ you‌ can see the‌ level.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Valves are both the‌ input‌ and the output. One‌ in each‌ end is‌ the‌ usual‌ setup.
<typewriter><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#9AA6B0>Build a‌ box, fill‌ a box</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1427B2D2: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Adjustable‌ One</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Turns‌ energy‌ into heat‌ at </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent efficiency, and you set‌ the‌ draw yourself.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Less efficient‌ than burning‌ something, far easier‌ to‌ automate, and‌ you can dial‌ it‌ in exactly.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1497789D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>64</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> buckets and moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>4,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>

2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Steel Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out‌ of enriched‌ iron‌ and more‌ carbon.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Infused Alloy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out‌ of‌ iron‌ and redstone.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The‌ infusion buffer stays loaded‌ between‌ recipes, so a single‌ stack of‌ coal fuels‌ a‌ very‌ long run.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Left slot‌ takes an‌ infusion material, right slot takes the‌ item, and the‌ machine pushes one‌ into‌ the other.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Coal‌ or‌ charcoal becomes </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>carbon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Redstone becomes </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>redstone infusion</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Diamonds, refined‌ obsidian‌ and gold all‌ have‌ their‌ own.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything you‌ build‌ from here needs‌ something this machine made, so‌ put‌ it somewhere you‌ can reach‌ easily.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What You‌ Will‌ Make‌ First</shadow></grad>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Enriched Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out‌ of‌ iron and carbon.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest17395B48: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Energy‌ As‌ A‌ Beam</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A Laser‌ fires power in a‌ straight‌ line up to </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>64</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks. Whatever‌ it hits‌ either takes‌ damage‌ or‌ gets mined.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Laser Amplifier</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> stores‌ the‌ beam and‌ fires‌ it‌ back out‌ at a threshold‌ you set.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Laser‌ Tractor Beam</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> does‌ the‌ same, but‌ pulls every‌ dropped item‌ straight into its‌ own inventory.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Breaking‌ a block costs </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per point‌ of hardness, and‌ hitting a mob‌ costs </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>2,500</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ half heart.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The‌ fusion‌ reactor is ignited by‌ a‌ laser, so this is‌ not‌ just‌ a toy.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest17F0C3B9: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth‌ The Extra Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run‌ the plain dust through‌ an‌ Enrichment Chamber first‌ and the‌ enriched version‌ carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion‌ instead‌ of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same slot, same‌ machine, eight‌ times the material. There is‌ no reason‌ to‌ ever infuse‌ the plain‌ version‌ once‌ you have‌ the chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight for the‌ price‌ of one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest187BF7E0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>256,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ pulls </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>64,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Elite Pressurized Tube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest18D88932: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Hydrogen‌ And Oxygen</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pour water‌ in‌ and it‌ comes‌ apart into </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>hydrogen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on one side‌ and </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>oxygen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on‌ the other.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Oxygen drives‌ the‌ Purification‌ Chamber. Hydrogen fuels‌ your‌ jetpack, feeds the Gas-Burning‌ Generator and becomes hydrogen‌ chloride‌ later.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Both tanks fill‌ up. If one‌ side backs‌ up‌ the‌ machine stops, so‌ set‌ the unwanted gas to‌ dump or‌ pipe‌ it somewhere.
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Water, but‌ in two‌ pieces</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest19572928: ## <grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Making‌ The Refined‌ Metals</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Takes </grad><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>osmium‌ gas</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ presses it‌ into‌ another item.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Obsidian dust becomes </grad><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Refined‌ Obsidian Ingot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Glowstone‌ dust‌ becomes </grad><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Refined Glowstone‌ Ingot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Osmium gas‌ comes‌ from‌ a Chemical‌ Oxidizer eating osmium ingots, so‌ keep‌ a stack of‌ them handy.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1B6DDF50: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Second‌ Pass Through The‌ Infuser</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enriched iron‌ plus another </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>10‌ carbon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Steel‌ Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Smelt‌ that and‌ you‌ have a Steel Ingot.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Steel‌ goes into‌ casings, into‌ every transmitter, into‌ the reactor‌ and‌ into‌ the turbine. You‌ will be making it‌ for‌ the rest of‌ the mod.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Set‌ up a‌ small‌ infuser‌ loop that runs‌ iron‌ all the‌ way‌ to‌ steel dust‌ on its own. Doing‌ this by‌ hand gets‌ old‌ fast.
<typewriter><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#9AA6B0>Two‌ trips through‌ the infuser</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1C840312: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Carries </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>128,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Advanced Universal Cable</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1E3F545A: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth The‌ Extra Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run‌ the plain‌ dust‌ through‌ an Enrichment Chamber‌ first‌ and the‌ enriched‌ version‌ carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion instead‌ of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same slot, same machine, eight‌ times the‌ material. There is‌ no‌ reason‌ to ever‌ infuse the‌ plain version once‌ you have‌ the chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight for the price‌ of one</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Enriched Refined Obsidian</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1EB3368A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>9</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> parallel‌ jobs‌ in‌ one block, and‌ the last‌ factory tier Mekanism‌ ships on‌ its own.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Evolved Mekanism carries this‌ ladder four‌ tiers further, so this‌ is‌ nowhere near‌ the‌ real ceiling.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest1F031D0D: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Four Ingredients, One‌ Core</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gold, diamond, an ender‌ pearl‌ and‌ refined obsidian, held‌ together‌ with atomic alloy.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every teleporter, portable‌ teleporter, entangloporter and‌ QIO‌ block in‌ the mod‌ wants‌ one‌ of these.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest217AD52F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Reinforced Alloy infused‌ with </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>refined‌ obsidian</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The last alloy‌ the‌ base‌ mod makes, and‌ the‌ gate on every‌ Ultimate transmitter, tank and circuit.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Evolved‌ Mekanism‌ stacks four more‌ alloys on‌ top of‌ this‌ one, ending‌ somewhere absurd.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2196ED4A: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What An Advanced‌ Circuit‌ Unlocks</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The chemistry machines. Oxidizer, Infuser‌ and‌ Reaction‌ Chamber all‌ come‌ online here, and with‌ them the whole gas‌ side‌ of the mod.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest21F51D76: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth‌ The Extra Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run the‌ plain dust‌ through‌ an Enrichment‌ Chamber first‌ and‌ the‌ enriched version‌ carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion instead of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same slot, same‌ machine, eight‌ times the material. There‌ is no‌ reason to‌ ever‌ infuse‌ the plain version‌ once‌ you have‌ the‌ chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight‌ for the‌ price of one</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Enriched Iron Infusion</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest237D47BA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Insulation </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Heat‌ goes‌ in one‌ end and‌ comes out the‌ other.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Ultimate Thermodynamic Conductor</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest23E09241: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>64</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> items‌ per grab‌ and‌ travels ten times‌ faster than basic.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>A whole‌ stack‌ a grab</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Ultimate Logistical Transporter</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest23F165DE: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Carries </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>8,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Universal‌ cables speak‌ every power system in the‌ pack, so you‌ can wire a‌ Mekanism‌ machine to‌ almost‌ anything and it just‌ works.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Basic Universal Cable</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest24737776: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight‌ raw ore plus‌ a cobblestone‌ makes an </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>ore‌ block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> again.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That‌ sounds‌ pointless until‌ you‌ remember every step above‌ prefers ore‌ blocks‌ over raw‌ ore. Eight raw‌ becomes‌ one‌ block, and that‌ block becomes five ingots.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ turns gravel into‌ flint, if you‌ ever need‌ that.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest24CC389B: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Halfway To‌ Steel</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An‌ iron‌ ingot plus </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>10‌ carbon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the Metallurgic‌ Infuser.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On its‌ own it‌ does‌ almost‌ nothing. Push another </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>10‌ carbon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into it‌ and you get‌ steel dust, which‌ is where it starts to‌ matter.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest255BC3CD: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Frames‌ And‌ Frequencies</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Build the‌ frame, put the‌ teleporter‌ block‌ in it, set‌ a frequency, and any other‌ teleporter‌ on the same‌ frequency becomes‌ a destination.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ works‌ across‌ dimensions. The energy cost‌ scales‌ with distance, and‌ cross‌ dimension‌ trips are‌ expensive.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest259CE79A: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth‌ The Extra‌ Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run the‌ plain‌ dust‌ through an‌ Enrichment Chamber‌ first and the‌ enriched version‌ carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion instead of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same slot, same machine, eight‌ times the‌ material. There is no‌ reason‌ to ever‌ infuse‌ the plain version once‌ you‌ have the chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight‌ for‌ the‌ price of‌ one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest25B235E0: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Gas Plus‌ Gas</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Combines two‌ chemicals‌ into a‌ third.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hydrogen chloride, sulfur‌ trioxide, sulfuric‌ acid‌ and uranium‌ hexafluoride all come out‌ of‌ this one block.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest27084AE2: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Heating‌ It From‌ Outside</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Solar‌ panels are the free‌ option. A heat‌ source‌ piped in‌ through Thermodynamic‌ Conductors‌ is‌ the fast‌ one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The hotter the tower‌ runs, the‌ more output you‌ get per‌ tick, and the‌ ratio‌ is‌ a flat </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>0.4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of temperature.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Valves‌ are‌ how fluid‌ gets‌ in‌ and out. Blocks‌ alone will just‌ sit there‌ looking impressive.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest27456841: # <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Three Machine Loop</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ oxygen comes‌ from‌ the‌ Electrolytic Separator‌ splitting water, so the whole‌ loop‌ runs on water‌ and power.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Wire‌ the three‌ machines‌ together‌ with logistical transporters‌ once‌ and you‌ never‌ touch‌ it again.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An ore‌ block‌ plus </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1 oxygen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ Purification‌ Chamber‌ gives </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>3 clumps</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. From‌ there‌ it is a‌ fixed little assembly line.</grad></shadow>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Purification‌ Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> turns‌ the ore into‌ clumps.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Crusher</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> turns each‌ clump into‌ dirty‌ dust.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Enrichment‌ Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cleans dirty‌ dust‌ into real dust.</grad></shadow>
4. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A furnace‌ turns dust‌ into‌ an ingot.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest27DC39C4: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Where Chlorine‌ Comes From</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Boil‌ brine‌ in an‌ evaporation tower‌ and‌ you‌ get salt. Oxidise‌ salt and you get </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>sodium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Run‌ sodium‌ and hydrogen through‌ the Chemical‌ Infuser and‌ you‌ get </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>hydrogen‌ chloride</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That one gas‌ is‌ what unlocks‌ 4x‌ ore‌ processing, so this‌ humble white pile‌ matters more‌ than it‌ looks.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest28FC883B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ore plus‌ sulfuric acid gives‌ a‌ thousand slurry, and‌ fluorite‌ plus sulfuric acid gives‌ hydrofluoric‌ acid.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Chemical Dissolution Chamber</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest29286CB6: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>1,024,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and moves </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>128,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Elite Chemical Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest293AA05E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Carries </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>8,192,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick, which is enough for‌ anything‌ the base mod‌ can build.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Ultimate Universal Cable</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2997F9BE: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Cover It‌ Up</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A facade clips‌ onto any‌ cable, pipe or‌ tube‌ and‌ makes it‌ look like‌ whatever block you‌ crafted it‌ with.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your wiring still works exactly‌ the same. It‌ just stops looking‌ like‌ a wiring‌ diagram.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2B03D73E: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Stop‌ Placing‌ Ten‌ Of Them</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ Factory is‌ one machine running‌ several jobs‌ side by side. The Basic tier‌ handles </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at once.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Any‌ machine with a‌ factory‌ version can‌ be‌ converted using a </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Tier Installer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, or‌ you‌ can craft the‌ factory‌ outright.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Smelting, enriching, crushing, compressing, combining, purifying, injecting, infusing‌ and sawing‌ all‌ have one.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2DD61A3F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Osmium, glowstone‌ and‌ enriched‌ carbon. Each one‌ installed pushes‌ the machine closer‌ to </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> times its‌ base speed, and the power draw‌ climbs with‌ it.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2E274BEE: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Turning‌ Items‌ Into Chemicals</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Takes a solid‌ and‌ evaporates it into‌ its‌ gas‌ form.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Sulfur dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> becomes‌ sulfur‌ dioxide, the start of‌ sulfuric acid.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Salt</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> becomes sodium.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Yellow cake‌ uranium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> becomes </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>250</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> uranium‌ oxide, which is where‌ the reactor‌ fuel chain‌ begins.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2EF4DD5C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>2,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>250</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick out‌ of‌ whatever it is‌ attached to.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Basic Mechanical Pipe</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2F741DB9: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>128</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> buckets‌ and moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>16,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>A hundred‌ and‌ twenty‌ eight</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Elite Fluid Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2FB9EF03: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Solids‌ Into Gas</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sulfur‌ dust, salt‌ and yellow cake‌ uranium all become gases‌ here.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is the entry‌ point to‌ sulfuric acid, to‌ chlorine‌ and‌ eventually to‌ reactor‌ fuel.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2FCE7982: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>128,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>32,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>It is a‌ river now</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Ultimate Mechanical Pipe</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest2FF909E7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> items‌ per grab‌ and travels‌ twice‌ as‌ fast as‌ basic.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Advanced Logistical Transporter</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest31B73D16: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Obsidian‌ dust compressed with‌ osmium.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It goes‌ into steel casings, into teleporters, and into‌ an armour‌ set that trades‌ a‌ lot of‌ speed‌ for a lot of‌ survivability.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest31E48AA6: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Three‌ Machines, One‌ Rainbow</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Pigment‌ Extractor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> squeezes coloured‌ pigment out of flowers‌ and‌ dyes.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Pigment Mixer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blends two‌ pigments into‌ a third.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Painting‌ Machine</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sprays‌ that‌ pigment onto a‌ block‌ or an‌ item.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is‌ the cheapest‌ way to recolour‌ large amounts‌ of concrete, wool‌ and‌ terracotta, and‌ one flower‌ goes a‌ very long way.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The‌ Color Modulation‌ Unit for your MekaSuit needs‌ this line, so‌ it is not‌ purely‌ decorative.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Pigments And Paint</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest34E9C8F2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> parallel‌ jobs. At this‌ point‌ a‌ single factory chews‌ through‌ more ore‌ than‌ your‌ mining setup‌ can feed it.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest369FEF6D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>8,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Advanced Mechanical Pipe</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest36BAD955: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Upgrade In‌ Place</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Converts‌ a‌ machine to‌ its‌ Elite Factory form, </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> jobs‌ at a time.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Elite Tier Installer</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3881B34C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Counts as‌ a‌ valid wall for‌ the dynamic‌ tank, the boiler, the‌ induction‌ matrix, the‌ SPS and the‌ evaporation‌ tower.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ purely‌ so‌ you can‌ watch, and watching a‌ reactor is‌ genuinely useful.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest39997608: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> clean‌ slurry becomes‌ one crystal, so‌ a‌ single‌ dissolved ore‌ block yields </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of them.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ also‌ the machine that‌ turns antimatter‌ gas back‌ into‌ a‌ pellet, much later.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3AACA624: # <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ First‌ Multiplier</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed an </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>ore block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> straight into‌ the Enrichment‌ Chamber‌ and you‌ get </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>2 dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> back. Smelt‌ those‌ and‌ that is‌ two ingots from one‌ ore.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Feed‌ it raw ore‌ instead and‌ the rate‌ is‌ 3‌ raw for 4‌ dust. Ore‌ blocks are‌ simply‌ the‌ better input, which‌ is why silk‌ touch is‌ worth carrying.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ deeper‌ step‌ in this‌ chain starts‌ from the same‌ ore block, so‌ the habit to build right‌ now is‌ silk touching everything‌ you‌ mine.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3B1ED106: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One Block, Every‌ Recipe</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Practically every Mekanism‌ machine‌ has one‌ of‌ these sitting in the‌ middle‌ of its recipe, so‌ get‌ comfortable‌ making them‌ in‌ bulk.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>You will want‌ a very large pile‌ of‌ them later for‌ the reactor‌ and the‌ turbine.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3B43DB1A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Throw any plant into‌ the Crusher‌ and you get‌ bio‌ fuel out.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ burns‌ in the Bio-Generator, and it‌ is‌ the first ingredient‌ in‌ the‌ plastic chain‌ that‌ runs all the‌ way to your MekaSuit.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3DE6391D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>32</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> items‌ per grab‌ and moves four‌ times faster‌ than basic.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>Half a stack a‌ grab</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Elite Logistical Transporter</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3EC9D0DA: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Hydrogen‌ And‌ Ethylene</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Burns any‌ burnable gas, and holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>18,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hydrogen‌ works‌ and is nearly‌ free once‌ the Electrolytic‌ Separator‌ is‌ running. </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Ethylene</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the real‌ prize, burning‌ for </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks per‌ unit.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ethylene‌ is‌ made in‌ the Pressurized Reaction‌ Chamber out‌ of bio‌ fuel, hydrogen‌ and‌ water, which means‌ a big‌ enough farm becomes‌ a serious‌ power plant.</grad></shadow>
[!success] This is the generator‌ that carries‌ most players all‌ the‌ way to‌ the‌ fission reactor.
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>The one that‌ actually‌ scales</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3F58EF82: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five‌ water per unit‌ of dirty‌ slurry, one to one out.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest3F8D9787: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>256</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> buckets and moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>64,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>Two‌ hundred and‌ fifty‌ six</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Ultimate Fluid Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest407EFAF5: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Feeding‌ The Separator</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Electrolytic Separator‌ drinks water constantly, so‌ hand carrying‌ buckets stops being funny within‌ about a‌ minute.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Dig a small‌ pool, drop‌ an </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Electric Pump</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in‌ it, and‌ pipe the output where‌ you‌ need it. The pump‌ refills‌ the‌ source block‌ behind‌ it, so the pool‌ never empties.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>One pump can‌ reach </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060> blocks‌ out for fluid, which‌ is plenty‌ for any‌ base.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>The‌ hole‌ never runs‌ dry</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest41E2793C: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth The Extra‌ Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run the‌ plain‌ dust through‌ an Enrichment‌ Chamber‌ first‌ and the‌ enriched version carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion instead‌ of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same‌ slot, same machine, eight times‌ the material. There‌ is no‌ reason‌ to‌ ever infuse the‌ plain‌ version once‌ you‌ have‌ the chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight‌ for the price‌ of one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4236B9F0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One‌ button flips it between‌ condensentrating‌ and decondensentrating, which is‌ a long‌ way of‌ saying‌ it‌ converts a gas‌ into‌ its bucket‌ form‌ and‌ back.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You need‌ it whenever a‌ gas has‌ to travel‌ as‌ a‌ fluid, or whenever‌ a mod‌ hands you a‌ bucket of‌ something Mekanism wants as a‌ gas.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Water vapour‌ for sulfuric acid‌ comes‌ from here.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest42E25D54: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Infused‌ Alloy infused‌ with </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same deal one rung‌ up. Every‌ Elite transmitter and‌ tank sits‌ behind this.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest435691B7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Presses‌ osmium‌ gas‌ into obsidian and‌ glowstone‌ dust to‌ make‌ the‌ refined ingots.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4434D7B6: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>4,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and pulls </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>750</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gases, slurries, infusion‌ types and‌ pigments all‌ travel‌ down‌ these.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Basic Pressurized Tube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest46582374: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Shears, Sword</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mines anything, never‌ breaks, and switches‌ between speed modes‌ with a‌ keypress.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> bonus damage when it is‌ out of‌ power.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> bonus damage with‌ charge, at </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>2,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a swing.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>1,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ has‌ no vein mining mode, so‌ what‌ you swing at‌ is‌ what‌ you break.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It‌ is‌ also the base‌ of the Meka-Tool, so do‌ not‌ throw it away.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#3FA9C8>One‌ tool to‌ rule them</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest47106CE1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three pellets‌ in an‌ Enrichment Chamber.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sheets‌ are‌ the‌ base of‌ every MekaSuit‌ module, the modification station, the‌ jetpack and‌ a long list of other‌ things. Build the‌ line properly now‌ and‌ thank yourself‌ later.</grad></shadow>
[!success] If‌ you only automate one‌ chemistry‌ line in this‌ chapter, make‌ it‌ this one.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4869931E: # <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Five For One</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That is seven‌ machines in‌ a row‌ for‌ a‌ single ingot, and‌ it is‌ completely worth it‌ once the‌ line is automated.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Five ingots per‌ ore is‌ the ceiling in‌ Mekanism. Nothing‌ later in‌ the‌ mod beats it.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Sulfuric acid‌ needs‌ sulfur dioxide and‌ water‌ in‌ the Chemical‌ Infuser, and‌ sulfur dioxide is‌ oxidised sulfur dust.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One‌ ore block‌ plus </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1‌ sulfuric acid</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> dissolves‌ into </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> dirty slurry. Wash‌ it, crystallise‌ it‌ at </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> slurry each, and‌ you are holding </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>5 crystals</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Dissolution‌ Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> turns‌ ore into dirty‌ slurry.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Chemical Washer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> rinses‌ it clean‌ with‌ water.</grad></shadow>
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Chemical‌ Crystallizer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> freezes the slurry‌ into‌ crystals.</grad></shadow>
4. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Crystals run‌ through‌ injecting, purifying, crushing‌ and enriching, then‌ smelt.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest488DBE69: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>No More Coal</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Smelts‌ anything a‌ furnace can, using‌ energy‌ instead‌ of fuel.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ takes upgrades, it‌ takes a factory‌ conversion, and it‌ never asks you for charcoal‌ again.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4A281A2B: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Upgrade‌ In Place</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click‌ a‌ machine with‌ a Tier‌ Installer and it‌ becomes the‌ Basic Factory version of itself, running </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> jobs‌ at once.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Your‌ upgrades and contents‌ come‌ with it, so‌ there‌ is no reason to‌ break‌ the machine first.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Basic Tier Installer</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4AA7E2E5: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Upgrade In‌ Place</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Converts a‌ machine‌ straight‌ to its‌ Advanced‌ Factory form, </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> jobs at a‌ time.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Advanced Tier Installer</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4AFF81D3: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Dirty‌ To‌ Clean</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Runs </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>5 water</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> past every‌ unit of dirty slurry‌ and‌ hands back clean‌ slurry, one for‌ one.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Skipping this‌ step‌ is‌ not an‌ option. The‌ Crystallizer only accepts clean‌ slurry.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4E2D539E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Combines two gases‌ into‌ a third.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Hydrogen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>chlorine</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes hydrogen‌ chloride, which unlocks‌ 4x ore‌ processing.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Sulfur‌ dioxide</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>oxygen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes‌ sulfur trioxide.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Sulfur trioxide</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>water‌ vapour</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes‌ sulfuric acid, which‌ unlocks‌ 5x.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Later‌ on it‌ makes uranium hexafluoride‌ for the‌ reactor, so this‌ machine‌ never‌ really retires.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Gas‌ plus gas‌ equals gas</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4EDD96EB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Peaks‌ at </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>300</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick and‌ stores </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>200,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It‌ takes‌ up a three‌ block‌ tall footprint‌ and‌ needs‌ a clear‌ view of the‌ sky.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A wall‌ of these‌ is‌ a‌ genuinely workable‌ base power‌ source, and it is‌ still completely‌ maintenance free.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Advanced Solar Generator</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4F1C04C0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One ore‌ block‌ plus </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1‌ hydrogen chloride</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>4‌ shards</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also turns coal‌ into </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>refined coal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and obsidian dust‌ into </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>refined‌ obsidian dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, both of‌ which you‌ want anyway.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shards‌ are‌ not‌ the end‌ of‌ the line. They still have‌ to walk‌ back‌ through purifying, crushing‌ and enriching‌ before‌ they‌ become ingots.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Chemical Injection Chamber</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4F2C46E6: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An‌ advanced circuit‌ and‌ Reinforced Alloy.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Elite‌ circuits are‌ where‌ the‌ cost curve‌ starts to bite, and where‌ automating‌ the alloy chain‌ stops being‌ optional.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Elite Control Circuit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4F436770: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One ore block plus </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1‌ sulfuric‌ acid</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> dissolves into </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> dirty slurry.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Slurry‌ is‌ not‌ an item. It‌ flows‌ down pressurized tubes‌ like any other chemical, which‌ makes‌ the last stretch‌ of ore‌ processing surprisingly‌ tidy‌ to‌ pipe.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also‌ dissolves‌ fluorite into hydrofluoric acid, which‌ is the‌ first‌ step of‌ the entire‌ nuclear‌ chain.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Chemical Dissolution Chamber</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest4F5A20C9: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>64,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ a single‌ chemical and‌ moves </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Basic Chemical Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5047792C: ## <grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E9F1F8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Reaction‌ Chamber Time</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bio fuel, water‌ and hydrogen‌ in the‌ Pressurized‌ Reaction‌ Chamber.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Substrate on‌ its‌ own is useless. It exists‌ to become‌ polyethene, which‌ becomes every‌ module and‌ most‌ of‌ your late‌ game gear.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest51B17258: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Loud‌ And‌ Orange</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A redstone lamp‌ that spins, flashes and screams.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Wire‌ one‌ to a Fission‌ Reactor Logic‌ Adapter set‌ to‌ damaged, or‌ to a‌ waste‌ barrel about to overflow, and‌ you get‌ a‌ warning before‌ the interesting‌ part‌ happens.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest525C8B9E: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Chunk‌ Loading In A Slot</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop‌ one into‌ a‌ machine and‌ the chunk‌ it‌ sits‌ in stays‌ loaded while you are‌ somewhere‌ else.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Every anchored chunk‌ is a‌ chunk the‌ game‌ keeps‌ thinking about. Use them‌ where‌ they earn‌ their‌ keep, not‌ on every‌ machine you own.
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>It‌ works while‌ you sleep</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest531E3FF1: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Insulation </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ is not‌ much. Heat leaks‌ out‌ of‌ these along the‌ way.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fine‌ for a‌ short‌ run‌ from a‌ heater to an‌ evaporation tower. Not‌ fine for‌ anything‌ long.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Basic Thermodynamic Conductor</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5501A09A: # <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Moving‌ Things‌ Around</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Thermodynamic‌ Conductor</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> carries‌ heat.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Upgrading Without‌ Breaking Anything</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ any placed‌ transmitter with‌ the‌ alloy‌ for the‌ next tier‌ and it upgrades‌ in place, contents‌ and all.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>So there is no‌ reason to‌ hold off on‌ running‌ your first‌ network. Run‌ cheap cable now, walk down‌ it‌ with a handful‌ of‌ alloy‌ later.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Each ring‌ above‌ a station is‌ that tier's full set. Walk‌ right‌ along the row‌ to climb‌ from basic‌ all‌ the‌ way to‌ ultimate.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mekanism has five‌ kinds of‌ transmitter and‌ one‌ rule‌ that applies‌ to‌ all of them. They come‌ in four‌ tiers, and‌ each tier‌ is unlocked‌ by‌ an‌ alloy.</grad></shadow>
