- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Universal Cable</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> carries‌ energy, and speaks every power‌ system‌ in the pack.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Mechanical‌ Pipe</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> carries fluids.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Pressurized‌ Tube</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> carries gases, slurries, pigments‌ and‌ infusion‌ types.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Logistical Transporter</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> carries items, and‌ can‌ colour sort‌ them.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>Wires, pipes, tubes, rails</grad>
Any Basic Transmitter
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Transmitters</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5548A1D3: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Refuel‌ By Standing Still</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ pad‌ that‌ tops up‌ everything‌ you are wearing‌ and carrying the moment‌ you‌ step onto it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put‌ one at‌ your front‌ door. Once‌ you‌ own a‌ MekaSuit‌ you will use it‌ every single‌ time‌ you leave.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5703872B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ little‌ robot that‌ follows‌ you around carrying an‌ inventory, a crafting‌ grid, a‌ furnace and‌ a repair‌ bench.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ needs‌ a </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Chargepad</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to spawn‌ from and to recharge‌ at. Name‌ it, dye it, and it‌ will trundle‌ after you‌ forever.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It‌ also‌ picks up drops‌ and‌ fights back, badly.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest58248E85: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ hundred‌ clean‌ slurry per‌ crystal, which‌ is five crystals‌ from one ore block.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest58445E5B: ## <grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Shiny‌ One</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Glowstone‌ dust‌ compressed with‌ osmium.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Refined‌ glowstone gear leans‌ into luck and crit‌ rather‌ than raw armour, and‌ the blocks‌ make excellent‌ lighting.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest587A19FC: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Three‌ Inputs, Two Outputs</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ only‌ machine that‌ takes an‌ item, a‌ fluid‌ and a‌ gas together, and hands back‌ an‌ item and a‌ gas.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bio fuel, water‌ and hydrogen‌ make </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>substrate</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Substrate, water‌ and‌ ethene make </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>polyethene pellets</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Much‌ later‌ it turns‌ plutonium‌ and‌ polonium into‌ pellets.</grad></shadow>
[!info] It is also‌ where {ethylene} comes from, which‌ is the‌ best‌ fuel‌ the Gas-Burning‌ Generator will‌ take.
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Three inputs walk‌ into a‌ bar</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Pressurized Reaction Chamber</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest58B125BD: # <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Welcome‌ To‌ Mekanism</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Above</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> it‌ sits power‌ and‌ circuits.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Below</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> it sits chemistry, gases‌ and plastics.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Further down are‌ the </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>tier‌ ladders</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, the machine upgrades‌ and the‌ odd useful‌ blocks.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What‌ Comes‌ After</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four more‌ chapters‌ hang off this one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mekanism is the big‌ one. Ore processing, gas‌ chemistry, nuclear‌ fission, fusion, antimatter and‌ a powered‌ suit‌ of‌ armour that‌ flies. All of it built‌ out‌ of the same‌ handful of‌ machines you‌ are‌ about‌ to make.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Advanced</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> covers‌ fission, the turbine, the‌ induction‌ matrix, fusion and‌ antimatter.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Gear</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> covers the‌ MekaSuit, the‌ Meka-Tool‌ and every‌ module you can bolt‌ onto‌ them.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Storage</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> covers the quantum‌ item network‌ and hooking‌ your‌ gases‌ into an ME‌ system.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Evolved‌ Mekanism</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> takes every‌ tier‌ in‌ the mod‌ four steps past‌ where the‌ base mod‌ stops.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It looks‌ enormous‌ from here. It‌ is‌ not, really. There‌ is one‌ metal you need, one‌ machine that‌ starts everything, and‌ then‌ a‌ ladder you‌ climb one‌ rung at a‌ time.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Start‌ with‌ an Osmium‌ Ingot. Everything else‌ follows from it.
## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>How This‌ Chapter Is Laid Out</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>row you‌ are standing‌ on</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> runs left to‌ right‌ and takes‌ you‌ from your first ingot‌ up‌ to five ingots‌ per‌ ore.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5A427FA2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>256,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>256,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ is‌ also the buffer‌ size‌ of a‌ Quantum‌ Entangloporter‌ frequency, which is‌ not a coincidence.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>A‌ quarter of‌ a billion</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Ultimate Energy Cube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5B082B05: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same idea, </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> parallel‌ jobs‌ instead of three. Feed‌ it an‌ Advanced Tier‌ Installer‌ or‌ craft it‌ outright.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>A‌ factory shares one upgrade‌ set across‌ every‌ slot, which is‌ what makes‌ it‌ so‌ much better‌ than a row of‌ separate‌ machines.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5B681BC4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> item at a‌ time and‌ moves‌ it slowly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click one‌ with‌ a‌ Configurator to‌ see and colour sort‌ the‌ routes.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Basic Logistical Transporter</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5B724DF5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ore plus hydrogen‌ chloride gives‌ four shards, and‌ refined‌ coal‌ and refined‌ obsidian‌ dust come from here‌ too.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Chemical Injection Chamber</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5B7CCB52: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Where Sulfuric‌ Acid Starts</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Oxidise‌ sulfur‌ dust‌ and you‌ get </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>sulfur dioxide</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Add‌ oxygen for </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>sulfur trioxide</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Add‌ water vapour‌ for </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>sulfuric acid</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That acid is the‌ only way‌ into 5x ore‌ processing, so‌ this unremarkable‌ yellow‌ powder is the gate‌ on‌ the best ore‌ rate‌ in‌ the mod.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5C1CCBC9: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>16,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>16,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Advanced Energy Cube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5D353793: # <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Stop Building‌ Rows Of‌ Machines</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Muffling‌ Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shuts the machine up.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Anchor‌ Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> keeps the‌ chunk‌ loaded.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A fully‌ upgraded machine‌ runs‌ at </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> times‌ its base‌ rate, so one upgraded Enrichment‌ Chamber‌ replaces a whole‌ wall of‌ plain ones.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Speed‌ and‌ energy‌ upgrades together are‌ the‌ standard mix. Pure‌ speed‌ will‌ drain your‌ grid faster than‌ you expect.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Open any machine‌ and there‌ is an upgrade slot in‌ the corner. Most‌ machines take </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> upgrades total, split‌ however‌ you like.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Speed‌ Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes‌ it run faster and‌ eat‌ more power.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Energy Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes‌ it‌ store‌ more and‌ use‌ less.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Gas Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> stretches how‌ far each unit of‌ gas‌ goes.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Filter Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lets an‌ Electric Pump‌ pull heavy‌ water‌ out‌ of ordinary‌ water.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5F27BDC8: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>16,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ pulls </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>2,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Advanced Pressurized Tube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest5F3BB146: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Part‌ That Does The Work</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gold, iron, osmium, polyethene‌ and‌ enriched redstone arranged‌ around‌ a‌ bucket of‌ water.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ core lives inside‌ the Electrolytic Separator, and much‌ later‌ it becomes the </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Electrolytic‌ Breathing Unit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> that‌ keeps your‌ helmet‌ full‌ of air.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>The‌ bit‌ that does it</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest603877AB: # <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Building The‌ Tower</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each‌ layer of‌ height adds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> heat capacity, which means‌ a‌ taller tower is‌ slower to‌ warm up‌ and‌ steadier‌ once it is.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feeding‌ it‌ heat from‌ a </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Fuelwood‌ Heater</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or‌ a </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Resistive Heater</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> through‌ a conductor works‌ too, and works‌ at night.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Brine‌ is‌ how‌ you get‌ salt, sodium, chlorine and‌ eventually lithium. Every one‌ of those‌ is a bottleneck later, so build‌ the tower‌ bigger than you‌ think‌ you need.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A multiblock‌ made of Thermal Evaporation Blocks, at‌ least </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> layers tall‌ and up to </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>18</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, with‌ a‌ controller on‌ the‌ top edge and valves‌ wherever‌ you want to‌ plumb‌ it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Water‌ goes in‌ the‌ top. Brine comes out‌ the bottom. Run brine back‌ through‌ it and you‌ get </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>lithium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Making It‌ Actually Work</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ tower‌ only‌ produces while‌ it‌ is hot, and it loses </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>0.02</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> heat‌ every tick‌ on‌ its own.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Solar‌ Panel</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the‌ top‌ adds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>0.2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> heat.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Thermal Evaporation Tower</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest60EA1D85: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>8,192,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ moves </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>512,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You will‌ want‌ several of‌ these‌ parked next to the‌ reactor.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Park‌ it by the‌ reactor</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Ultimate Chemical Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6204FD44: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Your Most‌ Used Tool</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click a‌ machine‌ face to cycle‌ what that‌ side does. Shift‌ right‌ click‌ to rotate‌ a‌ block. Point it at a‌ cable to‌ see‌ the network.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also has‌ a‌ mode‌ for emptying‌ a machine's inventory and‌ one‌ for dismantling a‌ block into‌ its item‌ form.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Almost‌ every‌ Mekanism problem is‌ a‌ side set‌ to‌ the‌ wrong colour. This‌ is how you‌ fix it.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest62651391: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Set‌ a radius, tell‌ it what‌ to look for, and‌ it pulls‌ those blocks out of the‌ ground and‌ hands them to‌ you.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Reaches‌ up to </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>32</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ in‌ every direction.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Takes </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks per block‌ before‌ upgrades.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Silk touch mode‌ costs </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>12</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> times‌ the‌ energy.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Filters take‌ item‌ names, tags and mod‌ names, so mining every ore‌ in‌ a chunk is‌ one filter, not‌ twenty.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Speed upgrades‌ matter‌ enormously‌ here. An unupgraded‌ miner‌ is painfully slow.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest636C7BCB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Osmium infused with‌ redstone. It‌ is the‌ cheapest‌ circuit and it shows‌ up‌ in almost every‌ early‌ recipe.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Basic Control Circuit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest64AFD9DC: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One‌ Block, Any Distance</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two‌ of these‌ on‌ the‌ same frequency‌ share their‌ contents, no matter how‌ far apart‌ or which dimension they are‌ in.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It moves‌ items, fluids, chemicals, heat and energy. Energy‌ transfer‌ is capped‌ at </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>256,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ frequency, which is the same‌ as‌ an Ultimate Energy‌ Cube.</grad></shadow>
[!success] This‌ is‌ how you‌ power‌ a remote mining‌ outpost without running a‌ single‌ cable.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest650996C7: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Your‌ First‌ Power</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Burns fuel for </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a‌ tick, and gets‌ a‌ lot‌ better if‌ you give it‌ lava.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every side‌ touching lava‌ adds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sitting in‌ the Nether‌ adds another </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>160,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ on its‌ own.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Water logging it with lava‌ counts as‌ a seventh side, so‌ a‌ fully surrounded‌ generator‌ in the Nether is‌ a‌ genuinely respectable early‌ power‌ source.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Ten‌ lava is‌ one‌ burn's worth. Pipe lava‌ in and it runs‌ itself.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6AD5F0FF: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Chunk Loading, Properly</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Loads a‌ square of‌ chunks around‌ itself, and‌ you‌ pick which‌ ones‌ from a grid in‌ the interface.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cleaner‌ than‌ sticking an‌ anchor upgrade‌ in‌ every‌ machine, and much‌ easier to see what‌ is‌ actually loaded.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Loaded chunks‌ cost performance‌ whether anything‌ is‌ happening‌ in them or‌ not. Turn‌ off the‌ ones‌ you‌ are not‌ using.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6C25D42C: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Third‌ Ingot</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One‌ ore block and </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1 oxygen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives‌ you </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>3 clumps</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Shards‌ go‌ in here‌ too and‌ come‌ out‌ as one‌ clump each.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Oxygen comes from‌ the‌ Electrolytic Separator, which means‌ this machine‌ needs a‌ water‌ supply‌ behind it rather‌ than‌ just a‌ power‌ cable.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6CD1720B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Produces </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>350</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick and‌ holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>24</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> buckets of‌ bio‌ fuel.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bio‌ fuel comes‌ out‌ of the Crusher fed‌ with basically‌ any‌ plant matter, so‌ a farm‌ and‌ a‌ crusher together‌ give you power out‌ of‌ nothing.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6CF26D13: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An ore block‌ plus </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>1 hydrogen‌ chloride</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the‌ Chemical‌ Injection‌ Chamber gives </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>4‌ shards</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. The shard‌ then walks back‌ down the‌ chain you already built.</grad></shadow>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Injection Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes‌ shards.</grad></shadow>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Purification Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> turns‌ a shard into‌ a‌ clump.</grad></shadow>

3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Crusher</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, then </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>Enrichment Chamber</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, then‌ the‌ furnace.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Hydrogen chloride comes out‌ of‌ the Chemical Infuser, fed‌ hydrogen‌ from‌ the Electrolytic‌ Separator‌ and chlorine from‌ salt.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Four machines deep means‌ four‌ times the power‌ draw. Sort your‌ generators out‌ before‌ you‌ scale this‌ up.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6DABA16F: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What‌ An Ultimate‌ Circuit Unlocks</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ last‌ three‌ ore machines, which‌ together take you to‌ 5x, plus‌ the Dimensional Stabilizer.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything‌ past this‌ point belongs‌ to‌ the‌ nuclear chapter or‌ to‌ Evolved Mekanism.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6E1D53B1: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Save‌ A Recipe, Feed It Parts</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Write‌ a‌ recipe onto a </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Crafting‌ Formula</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, slot‌ the‌ formula in, and‌ the‌ machine crafts that‌ item forever as long‌ as‌ the ingredients keep‌ arriving.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ not a‌ full‌ autocrafting‌ system, but for‌ one‌ recipe you make constantly‌ it beats‌ standing‌ at a‌ bench.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6E2ECF7B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Insulation </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>8,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Long‌ runs‌ stop‌ being a‌ problem.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Elite Thermodynamic Conductor</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest6F62B551: ## <grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ First Metal</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Osmium ore spawns from‌ bedrock all‌ the way up‌ to‌ the surface, so‌ you‌ have already walked past‌ plenty‌ of it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Smelt raw‌ osmium‌ into‌ an ingot. That‌ is‌ the whole first‌ step.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Almost every machine casing, circuit‌ and‌ upgrade in this‌ mod wants‌ osmium in‌ it, so‌ mine‌ far more‌ than‌ feels reasonable.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest707A400F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>256,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and moves </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>16,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Advanced Chemical Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7120DD13: ## <grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E9F1F8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>More Planks Than‌ You‌ Deserve</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A log‌ gives </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E9F1F8 f=0.8>6‌ planks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead‌ of four, and‌ a plank gives </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E9F1F8 f=0.8>4‌ sticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of‌ two.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every cut‌ also‌ has‌ a chance‌ to drop </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E9F1F8 f=0.8>sawdust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which‌ compresses back into‌ planks. So the‌ sawmill quietly turns a tree‌ farm into‌ an endless wood‌ supply.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest718E57DE: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>1,024,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ pulls </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>256,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ fission reactor‌ needs‌ this‌ much throughput‌ on‌ its coolant loop, so build‌ them before‌ you‌ build the‌ reactor.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Ultimate Pressurized Tube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7402ABC3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A basic circuit‌ infused with </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> again, wrapped in Infused‌ Alloy.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ is the gate‌ on the‌ Advanced tier‌ of‌ every‌ machine, tank and‌ cable.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Advanced Control Circuit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest74200A48: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Peaks‌ at </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a tick and‌ stores </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>96,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ not‌ much. It also‌ never needs‌ feeding, never‌ runs‌ out and‌ never explodes, which counts for‌ something‌ while you are‌ still figuring‌ the mod‌ out.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest74C146F7: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth‌ The Extra‌ Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run‌ the‌ plain dust‌ through an‌ Enrichment Chamber first‌ and the‌ enriched version carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion instead of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same‌ slot, same machine, eight‌ times the material. There‌ is‌ no reason‌ to‌ ever infuse the plain‌ version‌ once you have‌ the‌ chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight‌ for the‌ price‌ of one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest74FD2956: ## <grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What Mekanism‌ Buries</shadow></grad>
[!tip] Mine‌ one of‌ each and the‌ quest ticks‌ off. You do‌ not‌ need‌ a stack.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five‌ ores get added‌ to‌ your‌ world, and you‌ have‌ almost certainly walked‌ past all of them‌ already.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Osmium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is‌ the one that‌ matters. It shows‌ up anywhere‌ from‌ bedrock‌ to the‌ surface‌ and it is the‌ base of‌ nearly‌ every machine‌ here.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Tin</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Lead</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are ordinary‌ metals‌ with‌ a lot‌ of uses once you‌ start‌ building.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Fluorite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sits deep, and you‌ will not‌ need it‌ until‌ you‌ go nuclear.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.8>Uranium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is exactly‌ as‌ friendly as‌ it‌ sounds.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#4C9BD6>Five‌ rocks you‌ walked past</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4C9BD6 to=#C2E2FF f=0.6>Five New Rocks</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7679CB42: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>32</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> buckets and moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ works‌ in your‌ hand‌ too, so it doubles‌ as a very large‌ bucket.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Basic Fluid Tank</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest76A38CCA: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Substrate, water‌ and </grad><grad from=#AFC3D8 to=#E9F1F8 f=0.8>ethene</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> back through the‌ Reaction Chamber.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ethene‌ is the‌ same‌ gas‌ the Gas-Burning Generator‌ loves, so‌ the two‌ lines‌ share‌ a supply.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7778937D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Output scales‌ with height, from </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick‌ at the‌ bottom‌ up to </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>480</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at the top.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nothing‌ happens‌ below Y </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>24</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Above that‌ it‌ climbs‌ steadily, so the‌ ugly‌ tower on your‌ roof is doing real‌ work.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Rain‌ and thunder push‌ it a‌ little higher‌ still.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest77AFA4E6: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The One‌ You‌ Always Want</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gold, osmium‌ and‌ enriched redstone. It raises the‌ machine's‌ internal buffer and‌ cuts‌ what‌ each operation‌ costs.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pair‌ these with speed‌ upgrades or your grid‌ will‌ brown out the‌ moment the‌ line gets‌ busy.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>The‌ one‌ you always‌ want</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest783D70FE: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Heat, Not Power</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Burns ordinary‌ furnace fuel and produces </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>400</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> heat‌ per‌ fuel tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Heat is‌ its own‌ thing in‌ Mekanism. It‌ travels‌ through Thermodynamic‌ Conductors‌ and feeds the evaporation‌ tower and‌ the‌ boiler.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7AE502ED: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Everything‌ Into‌ Dust</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Clumps become </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>dirty dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, ingots‌ become‌ dust, and cobblestone‌ becomes‌ gravel‌ becomes sand.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is the middle‌ of the‌ 3x chain, and‌ it‌ also‌ quietly solves‌ your sand‌ problem forever.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7EBD54FB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ore plus‌ oxygen gives‌ three‌ clumps, and‌ it is‌ what turns shards and‌ crystals‌ back into something‌ smeltable.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7EDB092B: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Insulation </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>400</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, up‌ from ten. Heat actually‌ arrives at‌ the other‌ end‌ now.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Advanced Thermodynamic Conductor</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7EE075AB: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Worth‌ The Extra Step</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Run‌ the‌ plain dust‌ through‌ an Enrichment Chamber first‌ and‌ the enriched version‌ carries </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> infusion‌ instead‌ of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same slot, same‌ machine, eight‌ times the material. There‌ is no reason to‌ ever‌ infuse the plain‌ version once‌ you have‌ the‌ chamber.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>Eight‌ for the‌ price‌ of one</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest7F019368: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Basic‌ Tier Machine</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One‌ of‌ the‌ first machines a‌ Basic‌ Control Circuit‌ lets‌ you‌ build.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It flips‌ a chemical into‌ its fluid‌ form and‌ back, which‌ is‌ what lets‌ gases ride‌ in fluid tanks‌ and buckets.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest8CB16916: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An elite circuit‌ and‌ Atomic Alloy.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ endgame‌ block‌ in the‌ base mod wants‌ these. The MekaSuit, the‌ Meka-Tool, the QIO‌ system‌ and‌ the SPS‌ all sit‌ behind this single‌ item.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Evolved Mekanism‌ adds four more circuit tiers‌ on top‌ of this one.
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6>Ultimate Control Circuit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest8DDE018A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed‌ it‌ an‌ ore block‌ and you get </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>2‌ dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Feed it‌ a dirty‌ dust‌ and‌ you get‌ a clean‌ one. Feed it redstone‌ and you‌ get </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>enriched redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This one machine sits‌ at the‌ end of every‌ ore‌ chain in‌ the‌ mod, so you will end‌ up‌ owning several.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>It also‌ turns‌ compressed‌ items back‌ into‌ their loose form, which‌ is handy more often‌ than‌ you would think.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.quest9408C6DC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>4,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ and pushes‌ out </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>4,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also charges anything‌ you drop‌ inside it, which makes‌ it‌ the simplest‌ way‌ to keep your tools‌ topped‌ up before you‌ own‌ a‌ chargepad.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Each higher‌ tier‌ multiplies both numbers‌ by four.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questA62F1C9A: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What A Basic‌ Circuit Unlocks</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ machine‌ in Mekanism‌ sits behind‌ a‌ circuit‌ tier. This is‌ the first rung, and the‌ machines‌ here are the‌ ones you‌ can build‌ almost‌ immediately.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Follow‌ this lane sideways‌ to‌ see what‌ each‌ circuit‌ tier opens‌ up.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#3FA9C8>What tier one‌ buys you</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questA87644C9: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What An‌ Elite Circuit‌ Unlocks</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Chemical‌ Injection‌ Chamber, which‌ is the‌ step from‌ 3x to 4x‌ ore processing.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ is also where machine upgrades‌ start paying‌ for themselves, since one‌ upgraded‌ machine now‌ beats‌ four plain ones.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#3FA9C8>Now the‌ upgrades‌ pay off</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questAF6FAEC0: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Set It‌ Up Once</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Shift‌ right click a‌ machine‌ you have‌ already‌ configured to copy its‌ settings, then‌ right click every‌ other‌ machine‌ to paste.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sides, filters, auto‌ eject, redstone‌ mode, all of it‌ comes across.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questB2A1564E: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Item, Fluid And Gas</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The plastic‌ line and‌ the ethylene line‌ both‌ run through‌ here.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Pressurized Reaction Chamber</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questDDD3A910: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>64,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>64,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Elite Energy Cube</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questF56D0F75: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>32,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ pulls </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>8,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Elite Mechanical Pipe</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism.questFFA67604: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron‌ infused with </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This‌ single‌ item‌ is the‌ gate on the‌ entire Advanced‌ tier. Cables, pipes, tubes, transporters, conductors, tanks and‌ energy‌ cubes‌ all step‌ up once‌ you have it.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] You‌ can also‌ right click an existing cable‌ with the‌ alloy to upgrade‌ it‌ in place. No‌ need‌ to break anything.

## <grad from=#FFD65C to=#FFF2C0 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Everyday Set</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fast, durable‌ and made‌ from‌ waste‌ you were‌ throwing away.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#FFD65C to=#FFD65C>Quite‌ durable</grad>

## <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Armour And‌ Tools</shadow></grad>

## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One Click, Top‌ Tier</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ tier installer from‌ Basic‌ to‌ Multiversal, crafted into‌ one‌ item.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click any‌ compatible machine and it‌ jumps‌ straight to </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>Multiversal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, running </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>17</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> jobs at‌ once, without stopping‌ at the‌ eight‌ tiers‌ in between.</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Four‌ More Alloys</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two of those‌ materials‌ do‌ not exist‌ yet, so‌ the ladder loops‌ back through the machines‌ and‌ the transmuter before‌ it can‌ finish.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mekanism's‌ ladder ends at </grad><grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.8>Atomic‌ Alloy</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Evolved carries‌ on with four more, and each‌ one is‌ the gate on‌ a‌ whole tier‌ of‌ everything.</grad></shadow>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.8>Hypercharged</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> needs uranium.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.8>Subatomic</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> needs antimatter.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.8>Singular</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> needs better‌ gold.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Osmium, tin, lead, uranium and fluorite‌ get‌ variants that spawn‌ in netherrack, end‌ stone and‌ several‌ modded‌ stone types.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They drop‌ exactly‌ what the‌ overworld‌ versions‌ drop, so nothing‌ about your processing‌ setup changes. It‌ just means‌ a‌ trip‌ to the‌ Nether is‌ no longer a‌ trip away‌ from your ore supply.</grad></shadow>

# <grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Turning‌ Waste Into‌ Gold</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ recipe‌ takes </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks scaled‌ by how much gas‌ it‌ uses.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It buffers </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>10,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy and‌ draws </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick‌ while running.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Spent‌ nuclear‌ waste‌ does not decay‌ in‌ a barrel. This‌ is‌ the‌ machine that‌ finally gives you‌ something to‌ do with‌ it.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A hollow box of </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>APT Casing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, with </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>APT‌ Ports</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for things‌ going in and‌ out‌ and </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Supercharging Elements</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> feeding‌ it‌ power.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The casing itself is‌ an </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>SPS‌ Casing</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> run through the‌ Nucleosynthesizer‌ with </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> antimatter, so‌ this multiblock‌ is‌ expensive before you‌ have placed a single‌ block‌ of it.</grad></shadow>

## <grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What It‌ Does</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It transmutes‌ an item‌ using‌ a‌ radioactive gas. The‌ headline‌ recipe is </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>spent nuclear waste</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> giving </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Better‌ Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, at </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> waste per‌ ingot‌ and </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>900</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per block.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ input tank‌ holds </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>5,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
