<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>The whole‌ vein. All of‌ it</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Vein Mining Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest13C: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Roughly‌ iron level, cheap‌ to replace, and‌ the‌ paxel‌ means one‌ slot instead‌ of three.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest13E: ## <grad from=#8FE33F to=#DCFFA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Your Dose, On‌ Screen</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Puts‌ your‌ absorbed radiation‌ dose‌ on the suit overlay‌ so you‌ find‌ out before‌ it starts‌ hurting.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest141: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour on‌ its own, which‌ is‌ not‌ why you‌ wear it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The helmet is‌ where‌ breathing, vision, food and radiation‌ live. It is‌ also the‌ piece‌ that‌ shows the suit's‌ status‌ overlay, so you‌ can‌ actually‌ see how‌ much charge you‌ have left.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Seven‌ modules fit‌ here. They‌ are‌ listed beside‌ this quest.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest16F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Adds jump‌ height at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>0.1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ extra‌ motion, up to‌ four‌ levels.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It also raises your‌ step‌ height so you‌ walk‌ up‌ full blocks‌ without‌ jumping at all.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Hydraulic Propulsion Unit</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Keeps‌ firing‌ while you hold right‌ click, at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra per‌ shot.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Auto Fire Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest185: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel And Sword</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Craft an‌ axe, a pickaxe‌ and a shovel‌ of‌ the same‌ material‌ together with a stick‌ and‌ you get a‌ Paxel‌ that‌ does all‌ three, plus‌ enough damage to‌ count as a weapon.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ material‌ has one, including wood, stone, iron, gold, diamond‌ and netherite. It‌ is three‌ inventory‌ slots‌ back, permanently.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest192: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks and‌ reaches‌ up to </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ needs‌ an antimatter pellet to‌ craft, and‌ it will change‌ how‌ you‌ move around‌ a‌ base permanently.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest19F: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Removes‌ the slowdown‌ from soul sand, honey, cobwebs, powder‌ snow‌ and water, and‌ stops‌ your view from bobbing.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You‌ can‌ also use items‌ at‌ full‌ speed while‌ sprinting‌ or flying.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Gyroscopic Stabilization Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest1C3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>24,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> hydrogen and fills‌ at </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Combat</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sets things‌ on‌ fire.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Heat</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damages‌ without setting‌ fires.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>Inferno</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is combat with‌ a much‌ wider spread.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also‌ smelts‌ any item‌ it hits‌ mid air, which is‌ a genuinely‌ useful way to cook a‌ dropped stack.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] It‌ will happily start‌ a‌ fire in‌ your‌ base. Point it away from‌ the‌ wooden parts.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest1DC: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put‌ the MekaSuit piece‌ or‌ the Meka-Tool‌ in‌ one‌ slot and‌ the module in‌ the other, and‌ it installs.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ runs‌ on‌ energy and‌ it works‌ both ways, so pulling‌ a module‌ back out to move it‌ somewhere else‌ costs you nothing‌ but‌ time.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Most modules‌ stack. Installing‌ four Energy Units is‌ not‌ the same as‌ installing‌ one, and‌ the interface‌ tells‌ you the maximum‌ for each.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest1E2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Adds‌ sprint‌ speed at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>0.1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of‌ extra‌ motion, and it‌ stacks up to‌ four times.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also lets‌ you‌ sprint‌ while your‌ hunger bar‌ is empty, which the‌ Nutritional Injection‌ Unit already makes moot.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Locomotive Boosting Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest1E3: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nothing‌ clever, just‌ a lot‌ of‌ durability out of a‌ metal‌ you are drowning‌ in.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest201: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Makes‌ your boots go clank. That is‌ the whole‌ module.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Motorized Servo Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest219: # <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Before‌ The‌ Suit</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Osmium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the workhorse, and‌ it hands out flat‌ extra‌ health.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Steel</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the solid‌ middle.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Refined Obsidian</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is‌ a wall. Enormous‌ health, and‌ it‌ slows you‌ right‌ down.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Refined Glowstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the opposite. Crit, dodge, speed‌ and luck.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>MekanismTools‌ turns most of‌ the‌ metals you‌ are‌ already‌ making into‌ full armour and‌ tool sets, and‌ adds a </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Paxel</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to‌ every‌ material‌ including the‌ vanilla ones.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>None‌ of these compete‌ with the‌ MekaSuit. All of them are available‌ a very‌ long time before‌ it, and‌ several of‌ them‌ carry bonuses you will‌ not‌ find anywhere else.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Roughly‌ In‌ Order</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Bronze</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>Lapis‌ Lazuli</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are early‌ and‌ cheap.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Armour And Tools</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest21E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Enormous durability. Not fast, and‌ not meant to be.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Refined Obsidian Tools</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest227: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Opposite Of Obsidian</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lethality on three‌ of‌ the four‌ pieces.</grad></shadow>
[!success] If‌ you‌ only make‌ one MekanismTools set, make‌ this one.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Light, fast, and‌ built for‌ hitting things‌ hard‌ rather‌ than absorbing‌ hits.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour‌ toughness and </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> max health across‌ the set.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ crit‌ damage and </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ crit chance‌ from‌ the‌ leggings.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> luck and </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ attack damage from the‌ helmet.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ dodge chance, </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent movement‌ speed and </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra‌ combat rolls‌ from‌ the‌ boots.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Refined Glowstone Armour</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest251: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same job‌ as a‌ diamond‌ set‌ for a‌ fraction of the cost, and‌ infinitely‌ renewable.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest27F: ## <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Pull Drops‌ In</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drags nearby‌ dropped‌ items to‌ you at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>250</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a‌ tick‌ per item, with‌ the range set by‌ how‌ many units you‌ install.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Turn it‌ off before‌ you‌ walk‌ through a mob‌ farm‌ you did‌ not‌ want‌ to empty.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Magnetic Attraction Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest29A: ## <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>See In‌ The Dark</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>500</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a tick‌ while‌ it is on, and‌ the brightness‌ is adjustable‌ rather‌ than‌ the flat vanilla‌ glare.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>Night‌ vision with‌ a‌ dimmer</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Vision Enhancement Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2A4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>500</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick and‌ removes the‌ water‌ penalty‌ on your‌ movement entirely.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Swim‌ like you are‌ not</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Hydrostatic Repulsor Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2A8: ## <grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>No‌ Airborne Penalty</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Removes‌ the mining speed‌ penalty for‌ not standing on solid ground.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With‌ gravitational modulation‌ switched on, this is‌ the‌ difference between‌ mining‌ and pretending to.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.6>Air Affinity Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2C5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ and takes </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>5,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nearly everything‌ powered in this‌ chapter has‌ one of these in its‌ recipe, and on‌ its own it‌ is‌ a perfectly‌ good‌ way to carry charge‌ out‌ to a remote‌ build.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2D5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tin, bronze nuggets and a </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Polyethene‌ Sheet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give you </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at‌ a‌ time.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every single‌ module in‌ this‌ chapter‌ is a‌ Module Base with something‌ else‌ built around it, so‌ make a‌ lot.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2E0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour, and‌ every module‌ that touches the‌ floor under‌ you.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fall damage‌ is‌ absorbed‌ at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per‌ half heart, exactly‌ like the free‌ runners, so these‌ replace them entirely.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2E5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Turns the tool‌ into shears‌ for entities and for leaves, at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a use.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest2FA: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Eating‌ From‌ A‌ Tank</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>64,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> nutritional paste‌ and‌ refills at </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>128</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> paste‌ is worth half a‌ food‌ point, so a full‌ canteen is‌ roughly six‌ hundred‌ and‌ forty food. You‌ will‌ never think about hunger‌ again.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest329: ## <grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One Way‌ Trip</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#3FA9C8 to=#B4EAF7 f=0.8>1,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ and sends you‌ to‌ any‌ teleporter frequency‌ you‌ have access to, instantly.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ needs a real Teleporter‌ at‌ the far end. This‌ is the‌ sending half‌ only, which‌ is‌ exactly what‌ you‌ want in a pocket.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest333: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Same‌ Flight, No‌ Slot Used</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>48,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> hydrogen and‌ fills at </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>256</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick, both double‌ the‌ standalone jetpack.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Normal, hover and‌ off, exactly as‌ before, and it‌ stacks‌ with‌ the Electrolytic‌ Breathing‌ Unit filling it for‌ you.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest335: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Multiplies the tool's‌ damage, at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>2,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage dealt.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stack enough‌ of them‌ and the‌ Meka-Tool‌ stops‌ being a‌ compromise‌ weapon.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Attack Amplification Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest343: ## <grad from=#8FE33F to=#DCFFA8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Other Half</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Reads the radiation‌ where‌ you are standing‌ rather than‌ the dose‌ you‌ have‌ taken.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Together with the‌ Dosimeter‌ this is‌ how‌ you‌ notice a‌ leaking reactor from‌ outside the‌ building.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8FE33F to=#8FE33F>How cooked‌ is‌ this‌ room</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest34D: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One Charge, Four‌ Pieces</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Moves </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>10,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a tick between‌ your‌ suit‌ pieces, and optionally‌ into‌ the rest of‌ your inventory.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Without it, each piece‌ drains‌ separately and the‌ boots die‌ first.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>The boots‌ die‌ first‌ without it</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Charge Distribution Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest357: # <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Best Armour In‌ The Game</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each piece‌ holds </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>16,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ before modules, and charges‌ at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a‌ tick.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Energy‌ Units raise‌ that‌ steeply, so a fully‌ loaded suit holds far‌ more.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] An‌ empty suit is‌ just twenty‌ armour with‌ no‌ tricks. Keep‌ a chargepad‌ by‌ the door.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four‌ pieces, each one‌ a‌ netherite‌ piece of‌ armour‌ rebuilt around </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Polonium Pellets</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Ultimate Control‌ Circuits</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Induction Cells</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Polyethene‌ Sheets</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On‌ its own‌ the suit‌ gives </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour‌ and </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> toughness. That‌ is already‌ better than netherite. The reason‌ it‌ is not close‌ is what‌ happens when‌ it‌ has‌ power.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What A Powered‌ Full‌ Suit Absorbs</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>With‌ all‌ four‌ pieces on‌ and charge in‌ the tank, it‌ takes </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent of‌ the‌ damage‌ from fire, lava, falling, freezing, cacti, anvils, lightning, wither, dragon‌ breath and‌ anything else it‌ does not‌ have a specific rule for.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ one exception‌ is the Warden's‌ sonic‌ boom, which it‌ only‌ absorbs </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>75</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent of.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>The best armour‌ in the‌ game</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest366: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gives‌ the Meka-Tana‌ a sweeping attack, for‌ an extra </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>125,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per swing.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest384: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Any‌ Food, Any Amount</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Throw‌ literally any‌ food‌ item‌ in and‌ it comes out as </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>nutritional‌ paste</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Rotten‌ flesh works. Poisonous potatoes‌ work. This is‌ where your‌ junk‌ food‌ goes to become‌ useful.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest38C: ## <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Now‌ With Protection</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour‌ and </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> toughness‌ on top of everything‌ the plain‌ ones‌ do.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Refined obsidian‌ is the‌ only‌ extra‌ ingredient, so upgrade‌ the moment you have‌ some.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Armored Free Runners</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest3AD: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Pick A‌ Colour</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Needs‌ a‌ Laser, a Pigment‌ Mixer and a‌ Painting Machine‌ to craft, and‌ then‌ lets‌ you set‌ the suit‌ to any colour‌ you like.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6>Color Modulation Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest3BF: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Getting‌ That‌ Last‌ Bucket Out</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ any‌ tank in‌ any‌ Mekanism‌ interface to‌ draw its contents‌ into the‌ dropper, or shift‌ right‌ click‌ to dump‌ the dropper‌ into it.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is‌ how you‌ empty a machine that has‌ the wrong‌ gas in it‌ without‌ breaking the‌ block.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest3C5: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Absorbs‌ laser damage‌ instead‌ of‌ taking it, and‌ refunds‌ part of it back‌ into the‌ suit‌ as charge.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Laser Dissipation Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest3C8: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The fortune enchantment, installable‌ up to‌ three times for the three‌ levels.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It conflicts‌ with Silk Touch, so‌ pick‌ one and‌ switch‌ modes when you need‌ the‌ other.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Ore Refinement Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest41D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every piece gives </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra‌ max‌ health, so the full‌ set is </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> more, which‌ is four‌ whole‌ hearts.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each‌ piece also adds‌ a‌ small amount‌ of‌ attack‌ damage, </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent from‌ the chestplate and </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ from the‌ rest.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Osmium is‌ the‌ metal‌ you already‌ have the‌ most of, which makes‌ this the‌ easiest big survivability jump in‌ the mod.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest422: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each level shortens the‌ Meka-Bow's‌ draw, for </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>50,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra energy per‌ shot‌ per‌ level.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>Faster than‌ you‌ can aim</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Draw Speed Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest425: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Starter‌ Set</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bronze is‌ copper‌ and‌ tin infused‌ together, which means you can‌ make‌ it before you‌ have found‌ a single‌ diamond.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Straightforward‌ armour‌ with no tricks‌ attached, and‌ a shield‌ to‌ match.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#9AA6B0>Before‌ you found‌ a diamond</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest437: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Freezes‌ water‌ into ice as‌ you step‌ onto it, with‌ a‌ bigger‌ radius per‌ unit‌ installed.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Frost Walker Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest47B: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Debugging A‌ Network</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click any transmitter‌ and it‌ prints the‌ whole‌ network. Capacity, current‌ throughput, how many‌ blocks‌ are attached and what‌ is connected.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>400</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per‌ read and‌ holds </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>60,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The first‌ tool‌ to‌ reach for‌ when power is arriving‌ somewhere‌ it should not.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#C8AE86>Why‌ is my‌ cable sad</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest486: # <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Cheap Stuff‌ That‌ Still Matters</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Portable‌ Teleporter</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sends you‌ home from‌ anywhere.</grad></shadow>

[!tip] The‌ armoured‌ versions of the‌ runners‌ and the‌ jetpack‌ take‌ a chestplate‌ or boots slot‌ and give‌ you real‌ armour‌ on‌ top. There is‌ no reason‌ to use the‌ plain ones‌ once you can afford the‌ armoured.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>None of‌ this is endgame and‌ all‌ of it is‌ worth making. Most‌ of it‌ also‌ turns‌ into a‌ MekaSuit‌ module later, so nothing here‌ is wasted.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Free‌ Runners</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cancel‌ fall damage‌ and let‌ you‌ walk‌ up blocks.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Jetpack</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> flies‌ on hydrogen.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Scuba gear</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> breathes underwater.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Canteen</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> feeds‌ you‌ from a tank.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>What you‌ wear before the‌ suit</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest4CB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Applies‌ looting to‌ whatever you kill, at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>125,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per‌ hit.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest4DA: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Standing In Fire, Productively</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Generates </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>10.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick‌ for every degree‌ the surroundings‌ are above‌ ambient, per‌ unit‌ installed. Fire counts‌ as‌ about </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> degrees above, lava as </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A full‌ set of‌ these‌ also negates </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ of heat‌ damage‌ on‌ its own.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The‌ output scales with how‌ much‌ of your legs‌ are actually‌ submerged, so a‌ swim‌ in‌ lava charges you‌ properly.
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>Swim‌ in lava, get‌ paid</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Geothermal Generator Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest4E6: # <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One‌ Slot, All‌ Of‌ Them</shadow></grad>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per block mined, or </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with silk touch.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>2,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage dealt.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks teleported, up to </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>

[!info] Ten‌ modules‌ fit into‌ it, and‌ the combination decides what‌ kind‌ of tool it‌ is. Vein‌ mining‌ plus excavation‌ escalation‌ turns it into‌ a strip miner. Farming plus‌ shearing‌ turns it into‌ a harvester.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Atomic Disassembler</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> rebuilt‌ with polonium pellets, ultimate circuits, induction‌ cells‌ and plastic.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Out of‌ the box‌ it is‌ a‌ pickaxe, an‌ axe, a shovel, a hoe, shears‌ and‌ a sword, with </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> bonus‌ damage‌ and </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> efficiency. That‌ is roughly‌ a diamond tool, and‌ it is‌ the least‌ interesting‌ thing‌ about it.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>16,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy before‌ modules and charges‌ at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest4F6: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>6</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour, and‌ the piece that handles‌ how you‌ move.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ is also‌ the only‌ place‌ the‌ geothermal generator‌ fits, which turns standing in‌ lava‌ from a death‌ sentence into‌ a power‌ source.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>Lava‌ is‌ a battery now</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest505: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fast and strong for‌ how early‌ they‌ are, and they‌ break quickly. Keep‌ the‌ repair‌ material handy.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Lapis Lazuli Tools</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest525: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>32,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ second while gliding, and‌ no elytra‌ in your chest slot.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Cheaper to‌ run than‌ gravitational modulation, and considerably‌ faster‌ over long‌ distances.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest52E: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ single most‌ protective non‌ powered‌ armour‌ here, and it makes‌ you‌ pay for‌ it.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>+16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> max‌ health‌ across the‌ set, with </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>6</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of it on‌ the chestplate.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ less damage‌ taken.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ more‌ healing received.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>In‌ exchange you‌ lose </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>35</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent movement speed, </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ attack damage, </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ attack speed and a chunk‌ of spell‌ power and dodge.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] This‌ is‌ a set‌ for‌ standing still and taking‌ hits. If‌ you fight by‌ moving, wear‌ something‌ else.
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Refined Obsidian Armour</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest532: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One in each of‌ the four‌ pieces gives you‌ the‌ same protection‌ as‌ a full hazmat suit.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That‌ means‌ you can work‌ on‌ a‌ reactor without‌ changing‌ clothes, which is exactly‌ what you want at‌ three‌ in the morning.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8FE33F to=#DCFFA8 f=0.6>Radiation Shielding Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest560: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Raises‌ the‌ tool's‌ efficiency well‌ past‌ its base of </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and you‌ can dial‌ the‌ level down‌ in the‌ field‌ when‌ you want‌ to save charge.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Excavation Escalation Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest566: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Katana Blade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for‌ the sword, and a </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Bow‌ Riser</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus two </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Fiberglass‌ Bow Limbs</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for the bow.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Ordinary crafting‌ bench items, made‌ of the metals‌ you‌ already have‌ piles‌ of.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest575: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> base damage, </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>250,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ shot, and a‌ beam‌ that reaches </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every‌ shot adds </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ heat. At </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ it‌ stops firing‌ and needs a second‌ to‌ cool, shedding </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent a second‌ after a‌ one second‌ delay.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>So‌ it‌ is a burst‌ weapon. Fire‌ ten, wait, fire ten‌ more.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest58F: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The‌ Ore‌ Processing Enabler</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per‌ block instead‌ of </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and it‌ is‌ worth‌ every point.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five ingots‌ per‌ ore only‌ works‌ on‌ ore blocks, so‌ this module is‌ what makes‌ the whole‌ 5x‌ chain‌ possible.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Silk Touch Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest5A2: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Gives‌ a chance to drop‌ a‌ spawn egg for‌ whatever you‌ just killed.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Pair‌ it‌ with‌ the Attack‌ Amplification‌ Unit and the Meka-Tool‌ becomes a‌ genuinely‌ good way‌ to stock‌ a‌ mob‌ farm.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest5AB: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mines‌ a square‌ around the block you‌ hit, up‌ to </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>5x5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with enough units‌ installed.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Perfect for‌ tunnels, disastrous inside‌ a‌ base.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest5C0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ block‌ that pushes </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1,250,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a‌ tick‌ into‌ everything you‌ are‌ carrying, wirelessly, from a distance.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put‌ one in the middle‌ of‌ your base and‌ your suit, tool‌ and weapons‌ stay‌ topped‌ up wherever‌ you‌ walk.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest5D7: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nether stars, ultimate‌ alloy, an ultimate‌ induction‌ provider‌ and an </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>antimatter‌ pellet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy a tick and‌ lets‌ you fly freely, no‌ fuel and‌ no hovering‌ rules. Hold‌ sprint‌ to go faster.</grad></shadow>
[!success] This‌ is‌ the single‌ best‌ item‌ in Mekanism‌ and it is‌ worth every‌ step of‌ the‌ antimatter‌ chain.
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.6>Gravitational Modulating Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest5DD: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Multiplies‌ the base </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> damage of‌ whichever weapon‌ it is‌ installed‌ in.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Attack Amplification Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest624: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Diamond level‌ protection‌ made entirely out‌ of iron and coal, once‌ your‌ infuser loop is‌ running.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No bonuses‌ attached. It simply‌ works, and‌ it‌ is cheap‌ enough‌ to keep a spare‌ set.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest627: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Sunlight‌ In‌ The Hat</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Adds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>500</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a‌ tick per unit installed, whenever‌ you‌ can see the‌ sky.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stack‌ a‌ few and‌ the‌ suit tops itself‌ up while you walk‌ around‌ during the day.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6>Solar Recharging Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest630: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place it, power‌ it, and‌ it scans‌ the‌ chunk it sits in. After‌ that‌ a Seismic Reader‌ anywhere‌ in‌ that chunk‌ can‌ list the layers.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest639: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Absorbs </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent of‌ fall‌ damage while charged, at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per‌ half‌ heart it saves.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They‌ also‌ step‌ you up‌ full‌ blocks without jumping, which‌ you will miss badly‌ the‌ first time you‌ take them‌ off.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Holds </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>64,000</grad><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060> energy.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest660: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Splits the‌ water around‌ your head into hydrogen and‌ oxygen, and feeds‌ you the oxygen.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ fills‌ your jetpack‌ unit‌ with the hydrogen while‌ it‌ does it, so swimming‌ refuels‌ your‌ flight.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Drink the‌ ocean, breathe‌ it</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Electrolytic Breathing Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest669: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Down the middle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the‌ MekaSuit, one piece‌ at‌ a time, with‌ each piece's‌ modules‌ laid‌ out beside‌ it.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Right</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the Meka-Tool and‌ the‌ Meka-Weapons.</grad></shadow>
[!info] A module is‌ installed at‌ a Modification‌ Station, and‌ it‌ can be pulled‌ back‌ out later. Nothing‌ here‌ is‌ a mistake‌ you cannot undo.
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything‌ in‌ the other‌ chapters‌ was‌ infrastructure. This is‌ the part you‌ actually put‌ on.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It ends‌ with‌ the </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>MekaSuit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and‌ the </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Meka-Tool</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which between‌ them fly, mine, farm, feed‌ you, breathe for you, shrug‌ off lava‌ and teleport you a hundred‌ blocks. Neither of‌ them is a‌ straight‌ upgrade you‌ craft‌ once. Both are frames you‌ bolt‌ modules into, and the‌ modules‌ are‌ where the‌ real‌ power is.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Left</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is‌ the ordinary kit. Jetpacks, scuba gear, free‌ runners, and‌ six sets of‌ armour and‌ tools you‌ can‌ make‌ long before‌ the‌ suit.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>The‌ reason you‌ did all‌ that</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest670: ## <grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Fortune For Everything Else</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Raises‌ the‌ chance of a‌ good roll‌ on the‌ loot‌ you‌ pick up.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest67D: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Removes arrow‌ drop‌ for </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>75,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra‌ per shot, which‌ turns the Meka-Bow into‌ a‌ sniper rifle.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Gravity Dampener Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest685: ## <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Any Piece, Any Slot</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A‌ few‌ modules do‌ not‌ care which part of‌ the‌ suit they go‌ into.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>Energy‌ Units</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are‌ the important‌ ones. Everything‌ else here is‌ comfort or a specific‌ immunity.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest68D: ## <grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Never‌ Open A‌ Food Slot Again</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Holds </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>128,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> nutritional‌ paste and‌ tops your‌ hunger‌ up‌ automatically at </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>20,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per half‌ food.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fill it from‌ a canteen‌ or straight from a Nutritional‌ Liquifier.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#E0A64A to=#E0A64A>The hunger‌ bar is decoration</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Nutritional Injection Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest729: ## <grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Wear‌ It‌ As Armour</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour and </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> toughness, which is‌ better‌ than diamond, and it‌ still‌ flies.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Better‌ than diamond, and‌ it‌ flies</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest739: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Strips harmful effects‌ off you as they‌ land, at </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>40,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per tick of‌ effect removed.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It‌ also absorbs‌ magic‌ damage‌ at </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>1,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per‌ half‌ heart. You can set it‌ to remove‌ harmful, neutral‌ or beneficial‌ effects independently.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Debuffs? Never‌ heard‌ of‌ them</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.6>Inhalation Purification Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest73A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fires‌ arrows made of energy‌ for </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>125,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra‌ per shot, so you‌ never carry‌ arrows again.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6>Energy Arrows Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest741: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Sweeping</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds‌ a sweep attack‌ for </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>125,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Looting</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> applies‌ looting for </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>125,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] It‌ cannot‌ be enchanted. The modules are‌ the‌ enchantments.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> base damage‌ before‌ a‌ single module, at </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>625,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a swing.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click‌ teleports you‌ up to </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>100</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks‌ for </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>5,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks, which‌ turns‌ it into‌ a movement‌ tool as much‌ as a‌ weapon.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Modules Worth Having</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Attack Amplification</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> multiplies the‌ base fifty.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest756: - <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Draw Speed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shortens‌ the‌ pull, per level.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Gravity Dampener</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> removes arrow‌ drop entirely.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Auto‌ Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> keeps‌ firing while‌ you hold‌ the‌ button.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Damage‌ scales with‌ arrow speed, so draw speed‌ and‌ gravity dampening are‌ not just‌ convenience. They raise‌ the‌ damage‌ too.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> base‌ damage, scaled‌ by how‌ fast‌ the arrow is‌ travelling when it lands, at </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>625,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a‌ shot.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Flame mode costs </grad><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>825,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead.</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Modules‌ Worth Having</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF6ECF to=#FFCBEF f=0.8>Energy‌ Arrows</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> lets it‌ fire‌ without‌ ammunition.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest757: ## <grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What‌ Is‌ Under Me</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click and it‌ lists every‌ block layer‌ between‌ you‌ and bedrock, in‌ order.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It needs‌ a </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>Seismic Vibrator</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> running nearby‌ to have‌ scanned the chunk first. Costs </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>250</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy per‌ read and‌ holds </grad><grad from=#C8AE86 to=#EBD9B8 f=0.8>12,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest782: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Very‌ fast, and they‌ glow, which‌ is‌ more useful‌ in a‌ dark cave than‌ it sounds.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Refined Glowstone Tools</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest78A: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> armour, the‌ highest of‌ the four pieces, and‌ the slot‌ that carries flight.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The chestplate is‌ also where‌ the suit's energy‌ tends‌ to live, since‌ the‌ Charge Distribution Unit feeds‌ everything‌ else from here.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#63D2FF to=#63D2FF>Eight‌ armour‌ and‌ the flight</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest7D0: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right‌ click a‌ crop‌ and‌ it harvests‌ and replants it, in‌ a radius‌ you choose.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Costs </grad><grad from=#E0A64A to=#FFE0AC f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ per‌ use, which‌ is nothing.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest7D8: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Raises‌ both the‌ capacity and‌ the‌ charge‌ rate of‌ whatever‌ it is installed in, and‌ the scaling‌ is‌ steep enough‌ that a‌ few‌ of‌ these change‌ how the suit feels‌ entirely.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Without‌ them a MekaSuit‌ runs dry‌ fast. With them‌ it‌ lasts‌ a session.</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest7E9: # <grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Three Weapons, One‌ Frame</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>MekaWeapons builds‌ three‌ things on‌ the same‌ modular‌ idea‌ as the‌ suit. A sword, a bow and‌ a‌ laser gun, each holding </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>16,000,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ and charging‌ at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>350,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a tick.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All‌ three‌ start‌ at </grad><grad from=#63D2FF to=#CDEFFF f=0.8>50</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> base damage before‌ any‌ modules, which is‌ why‌ they‌ cost what‌ they cost.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] None of‌ them can‌ be enchanted. The‌ modules‌ are‌ the enchantments.
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.quest9FC: ## <grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Never Runs‌ Out</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Fires‌ without consuming‌ arrows for </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>120</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> energy‌ a‌ shot, and‌ holds </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>120,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Flip on‌ flame mode and every‌ arrow‌ ignites, for </grad><grad from=#F2C14E to=#FFE9AE f=0.8>1,200</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a shot instead.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F2C14E to=#F2C14E>Arrows‌ are for‌ the poor</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.questC4A: ## <grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>No‌ Underwater Penalty</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The same‌ idea, for‌ water‌ instead of‌ air.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#B47CFF to=#E3D0FF f=0.6>Aqua Affinity Unit</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.questDE4: <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Scuba Tank</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> goes‌ in the chest slot‌ and‌ holds </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>24,000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> oxygen. The </grad><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#D3FFE9 f=0.8>Scuba Mask</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> goes on‌ your head. Neither‌ works without‌ the‌ other.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Oxygen‌ is the‌ other‌ half of what your‌ Electrolytic Separator‌ makes, so‌ this is‌ effectively free.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The‌ tank‌ also‌ protects you‌ from poison gas and‌ from‌ drowning in general, not‌ just water.
<typewriter><grad from=#7FE0B0 to=#7FE0B0>Both‌ halves or‌ you‌ drown</grad>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.questE56: ## <grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Enchanting‌ Set</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every piece gives </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> extra armour, and the‌ whole set‌ raises the experience‌ you‌ collect.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Helmet and‌ boots‌ give </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent each, chestplate and leggings‌ give </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ each. Wearing all four‌ is </grad><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.8>30</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> percent‌ more‌ experience from‌ everything‌ you do.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Put this‌ on before a mob‌ grinder‌ session, then swap back‌ to something‌ that keeps‌ you‌ alive.
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#9AA6B0 to=#DCE4EA f=0.6>Lapis Lazuli Armour</grad></shadow>
ftbquests.chapter.mekanism_gear.title: <shadow><grad from=#A2FCD6 to=#1E9E5B>Mekanism: Gear</grad></shadow>
