## <grad from=#3FC8D4 to=#A8EFF5 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Imperium Essence</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sixty four </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for one essence. At this point you should be growing inferium rather than mining it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tier 4 is the biggest shelf in the mod. </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Lapis</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Steel</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Osmium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Ruby</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Fluix</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Signalum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are all here.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Experience Essence is the one to chase. It is the fuel the Enchanter runs on, and the Enchanter is the reason to build this whole farm.
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#4FD6E2>Sixty four a pop</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#BFF4F8 f=0.6>Imperium Essence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Supremium Block</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nine essence in, one block out, and shapeless back the other way. Storage, mostly.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is also the only thing the </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Master Infusion Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> can chew on, so it is the gate to the last upgrade in the chapter.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Nine at a time</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Supremium Block</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Mystical Agriculture</shadow></grad>
2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Build an </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Infusion Altar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and eight pedestals.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Infuse four of a material plus four essence onto a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Prosperity Seed Base</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
4. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Plant it, harvest it, craft eight essence back into the material.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>One Thing To Know</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Essence tools and armour are not in this pack, and neither are the augments that went in them.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>You plant a seed. It grows into iron. That is the mod.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Everything else is here. Crops, farmland, accelerators, furnaces, souls, spawners, the Awakening Altar, and the </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Enchanter</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which is the best thing in the mod and nobody notices it.</grad></shadow>
[!info] Cognizant Dust is crafted from a Nether Star instead of dropping to a weapon, so Awakened Supremium is still the top of the ladder. It is just a wither away.

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eighty eight crops are alive here, from </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>stone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>netherite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. A crop is always slower than the machine that makes the same thing, so this does not replace your ore chain. It runs beside it, while you are doing something else.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Loop</shadow></grad>

1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mine </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium Ore</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Prosperity Ore</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Farming Simulator 2026</grad>
Alright
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Mystical Agriculture</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FC8D4 to=#A8EFF5 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 4 Seeds</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty seven crops, the widest shelf in the mod. </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Gold</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Lapis</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Steel</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Osmium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Ruby</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Sapphire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Fluix</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Fluorite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Signalum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Lumium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Uranium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Nickel</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Invar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Electrum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and more.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the one to plant first. Its essence is the Enchanter's fuel, and it also crafts into bottles of enchanting through the </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience Droplet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Gold Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>four</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ingots, eight </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Steel Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>three</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and eight </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Osmium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>four</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#4FD6E2>Gold farm, no piglins</grad>
Any Tier 4 Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#BFF4F8 f=0.6>Tier 4 Seeds</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Inferium Furnace</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A furnace that cooks in </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>168</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks instead of 200, and burns fuel </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>16 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> faster to do it. Net cost per item is the same, you just get it sooner.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each tier is built from the one below, so this is the first rung of five.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>Slightly less waiting</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>Inferium Furnace</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FC8D4 to=#A8EFF5 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Experience Capsule</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Two </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Ingots</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and two </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soul Glass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. Hold it and it swallows the experience orbs you walk over.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is also the material for the </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> crop, which is the crop this whole wing has been walking towards.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Harvesting that crop gives </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and one </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience Droplet</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in a glass bottle is a Bottle o' Enchanting.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#4FD6E2>XP in a jar</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#BFF4F8 f=0.6>Experience Capsule</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Inferium Growth Accelerator</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Place it under a crop. Every </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 seconds</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> it sends one random tick to the </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>first</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> growable block in the column above it, scanning from two blocks up through the next </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>12</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>First, not all. So one accelerator under one plant is one plant getting helped, and stacking accelerators under the same crop multiplies the rate.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] The recipe makes three at a time. Build a tower of them under a single column of crops and watch what happens.
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>Stack em up</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>Inferium Growth Accelerator</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Awakening Altar</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same shape as the Infusion Altar and the same eight positions, but built out of </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and orange wool.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The ring is mixed. </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Four Awakening Pedestals</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> hold the ingredients and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>four Essence Vessels</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> hold the elemental essence. Any of the eight spots takes either one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A vessel holds </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of a single essence, which is exactly what the biggest recipe asks for. It runs in </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, same as the other altar.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Ring of eight, again</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Awakening Altar</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Watering Can</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click water to fill it, then hold right click on your farm. It soaks farmland to full moisture and rolls a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>25 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance to random tick every plant in a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3x3x3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cube, four times a second.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It never runs out and it never breaks.</grad></shadow>
[!info] This is the fastest early growth in the mod. Accelerators beat it later because they work while you are gone, but nothing beats a can while you are standing there.
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Rain man</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Watering Can</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E09A3A to=#FFD08A f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tertium Farmland</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put your </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on this and the yield goes from 1.0 to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> a harvest.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty percent sounds small until it is running on a hundred and twenty plants under a watering can.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0A94A to=#F0A94A>Iron pays rent</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0A94A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Tertium Farmland</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Inferium Ore</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sixteen tries a chunk between </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>y -32</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>y 64</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, veins of eight. Each ore drops </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2 to 4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence and Fortune works on it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Every passive and hostile mob also has a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance to drop one when it dies. A mob farm is a second inferium mine and you probably already have one.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Inferium is the bottom of a 4 to 1 ladder. Every tier above it is paid for in inferium, and the top tier costs 1024 of them. You will never have enough.
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>This drops from.. everywhere</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>Inferium Ore</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Machine Frame</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron, redstone and stone. Cheap, and it is the middle of every machine this mod has.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>All of them burn furnace fuel rather than energy, and all of them accept an upgrade in a side slot.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Four of them come out of this branch. The Reprocessor, the Soul Extractor, the Soulium Spawner and the Harvester.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Frame it</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Machine Frame</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Passive Mob Crops</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Pig</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Cow</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Chicken</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Sheep</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Squid</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Fish</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Turtle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Slime</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> sit on tier 2. </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Rabbit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is tier 3.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The essence crafts into that mob's drops. Leather, wool, beef, ink, scutes. No pens, no breeding, nothing wandering off.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Slime</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the standout. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Three</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence is eight slime balls, with no swamp, no slime chunk and no moon phase.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Growing livestock</grad>
Any Passive Mob Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Passive Mob Crops</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Infusion Altar</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Stone, red wool and two gold. Cheap on purpose, because the pedestals are where the cost is.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop the seed base in the middle, put the ingredients on the pedestals, then right click the altar. It takes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which is five seconds, and the pedestals hand back whatever they did not use.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The altar keeps working while you walk away. Chunk loading is the only thing that stops it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Ring of eight</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Infusion Altar</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soul Extractor</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Feed it a mob drop and an empty jar and it pulls the soul straight out of the item. No killing needed.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Thirty six items are mapped. </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Beef</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Porkchop</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Mutton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Leather</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Bone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> souls each, an </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Arrow</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> gives </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.1</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Blaze Rods</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Ender Pearls</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Ghast Tears</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> give </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> an operation at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> fuel a tick, and it takes a machine upgrade to speed up. It turns any mob farm you already own into a jar factory.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>This closes the loop. Mob crop drops go back into the extractor, which fills the jars for the next mob crop.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Souls out of pork</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soul Extractor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FC8D4 to=#A8EFF5 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Imperium Furnace</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>29</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks an item, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>71 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> less fuel per item. Seven times faster than vanilla off the same coal.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#4FD6E2>Seven x, no power</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#BFF4F8 f=0.6>Imperium Furnace</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 1 Seeds</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Six crops live on tier 1. </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Stone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Dirt</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Wood</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Ice</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Deepslate</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> itself.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The Inferium seed is the odd one out. It is a plain crafting recipe, eight Inferium Essence around a wheat seed, no altar needed. Plant it and your inferium supply stops being a mining problem.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The rest are bulk, and cheap. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Three</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Wood Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is sixteen logs, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Dirt Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is sixteen gravel, and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Stone Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is eight flint.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>Stone printer</grad>
Any Tier 1 Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>Tier 1 Seeds</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 2 Seeds</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty one crops here. The ones worth planting first are </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Coal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Silicon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Sulfur</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Aluminum</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Amethyst</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Silicon</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the quiet one. Applied Energistics makes it by smelting certus quartz dust, and this skips that entirely. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Three</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence gives </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>eight</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> silicon.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Nature</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Dye</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> come out as an agglomeratio, a bundle that unpacks into a random pick of the group. Good for bulk, useless when you need one specific colour.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Silicon out of dirt</grad>
Any Tier 2 Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Tier 2 Seeds</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Mending, Farmed</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Wither Skeleton Skulls and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>256</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Experience Essence, on any item, first try.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Both halves are crops. The skulls come from eight </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> each, and the essence comes from the </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plant.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Bring both to the Enchanter and this quest is done. Then do it again for </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Fortune</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at 12 gold a level, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Silk Touch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at 32 slime balls, and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Efficiency V</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> at 80 redstone.</grad></shadow>
[!success] The farm has now replaced trading, grinding levels and the anvil in one block.
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>No librarian required</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Mending, Farmed</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E09A3A to=#FFD08A f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tertium Growth Accelerator</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>36</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks. A column this tall is easier to build vertically than to spread out, which is the design nudge here.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0A94A to=#F0A94A>Tall boy</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0A94A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Tertium Growth Accelerator</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Prudentium Farmland</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Same trade, one tier up. Tier 2 crops on Prudentium Farmland hit the full </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Mixing tiers costs you nothing except the second ten percent, so a farm sorted by tier is worth the extra walls.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Twenty percent richer</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Prudentium Farmland</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Prudentium Furnace</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>125</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks an item and fuel goes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>26 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> further per item than a vanilla furnace. This is the first tier that actually saves coal.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Coal goes further</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Prudentium Furnace</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Supremium Watering Can</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Five upgrades, each one wrapping the last can in that tier's ingots and four </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Mystical Fertilizer</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The top one covers an </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>11x11x11</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cube at a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>45 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance, and sneak right clicking air toggles it </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>on</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> so it waters by itself while you hold it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.8</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> random ticks a second on every plant inside the cube, all hundred and twenty one columns of it. Nothing else in the mod comes close.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The essence tools are gone from this pack but the watering cans are not, and they were always the best thing in that list. There is one more can, at the Awakening Altar.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Eleven by eleven rain</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Supremium Watering Can</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Cognizant Dust</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Nether Star</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with four </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Supremium Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> around it makes four dust.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Which means a wither, and the wither is already a farming problem. Eight </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is one skull, three skulls and four soul sand is a wither, and the </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Spawner</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> will make the skeletons for you if you would rather kill them by hand.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four dust is exactly one awakening, so one wither is one Awakened Supremium Block.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Fight it inside Witherproof Blocks. You built them two quests ago for exactly this.
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Star dust</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Cognizant Dust</grad></shadow>
# <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Enchanter</shadow></grad>
[gap=3]

3. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The level you get is however many </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>full sets</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of both ingredients you loaded, capped at the enchantment's maximum.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sharpness is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> quartz plus </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>64</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Experience Essence for level one. Load </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> quartz and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>320</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence and you get Sharpness V in one go.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Why It Matters</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>No levels spent, no bookshelves, no random rolls, no anvil.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>If the item cannot take the enchantment you get an </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>enchanted book</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead, so it doubles as a book press.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An enchanting table, a </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Ingot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and three </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It is the most underrated block in this mod and it should probably be the reason you built the farm.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Thirty nine enchantments are on the list, including </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Mending</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Silk Touch</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Fortune</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Infinity</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Mending is 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls and 256 Experience Essence. Both of those are crops. That is the whole trade.
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>How It Works</shadow></grad>
1. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put the item in the third slot.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

2. <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Put the enchantment's material in the first slot and </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Experience Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the second.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>No anvil, no cry</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Enchanter</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Infusion Crystal</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Prosperity Shards</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, four </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and a diamond.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It is a tool, not an ingredient. It sits in the middle of the essence upgrade recipe and takes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>one durability</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per craft, out of </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1000</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That is the only thing it does. Seeds are made at the altar and never touch it.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] There is a Master version at the far end that never wears out and eats whole blocks at a time. Until then, keep a spare in the crafting grid.
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>One thousand and done</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Infusion Crystal</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 5 Seeds</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight crops. </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Netherite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Enderium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Uraninite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Niotic Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Spirited Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>These are deliberately bad. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Nine</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Diamond Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes one diamond, and one plant gives at best </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence a harvest. That is one diamond for every eight harvests of one plant.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>That is the point. A tier 5 crop is not a faster way to get diamonds, it is a way to get them while you are asleep.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] Netherite Essence bypasses ancient debris entirely, which is the single biggest thing this tier unlocks.
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Diamonds grow on trees</grad>
Any Tier 5 Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Tier 5 Seeds</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soulium Dagger</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A golden sword between two </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Ingots</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> with dust above and below. It carries the damage of whatever sword you feed it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Killing a mob with it while holding a </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soul Jar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> puts </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>one soul</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the jar. That is the only way to fill one.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There are two upgraded versions built at the Infusion Altar. The </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Passive</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> dagger gets </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> souls from animals, the </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Hostile</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> one gets </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.5</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> from monsters. Both hit twice as hard as the basic and last twice as long.</grad></shadow>
[!info] The Enchanter can put Soul Siphoner on it, which raises the souls per kill again.
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Stabby stabby</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soulium Dagger</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Supremium Farmland</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Last farmland. Tier 5 crops are slow enough that the extra ten percent genuinely matters.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Supremium Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> for four blocks is 4096 Inferium worth of dirt. Nobody said this tier was reasonable.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Dirt worth 4096</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Supremium Farmland</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Inferium Essence</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The bottom of the ladder and the one you actually mine. Everything above it is inferium wearing a hat.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Nine of them press into an </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium Block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and the block route is how you move essence around without filling a double chest.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sixty four is not a lot. One </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Prudentium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> costs four of these, one </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Supremium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> costs </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1024</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>Green rock start</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>Inferium Essence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soul Jar</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A jar locks to the first mob type you put in it and fills up over several kills. A full jar is the material for that mob's seed.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>How many souls a jar needs depends on the mob. </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Ghast</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is 4, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Squid</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Fish</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Turtle</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Rabbit</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are 6, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Pig</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Cow</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Chicken</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Sheep</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Enderman</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Wither Skeleton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are 8, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Zombie</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Skeleton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Creeper</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Spider</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Blaze</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are 10, and </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Slime</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is 12.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>An empty jar can be emptied back out if you locked it to the wrong thing.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Mob in a jar</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soul Jar</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Prosperity Ore</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Deeper and rarer. Twelve tries a chunk between </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>y -60</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>y 24</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, veins of eight, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1 to 4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> shards each. Fortune works here too.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Prosperity is the structural half of the mod. It is not fuel. It is what seeds, ingots, gemstones and crystals are actually built out of, and there is no Prosperity crop, so it stays a mining job forever.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Both ores generate in stone and in deepslate, so a deepslate strip mine catches both at once.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>The other rock</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Prosperity Ore</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Master Infusion Crystal</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four shards, four </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Supremium Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and a </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Supremium Gemstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>never breaks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and it upgrades whole </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead of loose essence. Four Prudentium Blocks plus this crystal is one Tertium Block, which is thirty six essence converted in a single click.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Nine times the throughput and no durability. Every essence you push up the ladder after this is free of grinding.
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Infinite crystal glitch</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Master Infusion Crystal</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Eight Pedestals</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They go at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>three blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> out on the four compass lines and </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>two blocks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> diagonally, all level with the altar. The altar will not run with a gap in the ring.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A resource seed wants four of the material and four essence of that crop's </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>tier</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, not its own essence. An iron seed is four iron plus four </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Tertium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which is sixty four inferium once you follow the ladder back down.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Build the ring on a flat floor with a hopper feeding the altar. You will use it several hundred times before this chapter is over.
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Eight. Not seven</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Infusion Pedestals</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>What It Buys</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Three things, all awakened at the altar from the Supremium version you already own.</grad></shadow>

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Awakened Furnace</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of each element. </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>One tick</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> an item, and one coal does </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>160</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of them.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Awakened Watering Can</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of each element. A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>13x13x13</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> cube at a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>50 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> roll.</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Awakened Upgrade</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of each element. Cuts machine operation time to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.005</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and adds six blocks of range.</grad></shadow>
[!success] That is the end of the mod. An Awakened Harvester covering 15x15, an Awakened can raining on all of it, and a furnace that empties a stack before you close the screen.
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>One tick per item</grad>
Any Awakened Machine
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>What It Buys</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soul Glass</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soul Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> around any glass.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Soul Dust comes from smelting </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Smooth Soulstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so this is the payoff for the three pass smelt. Keep a stack of soulstone cooking in the background.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Ghost window</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soul Glass</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E09A3A to=#FFD08A f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Hostile Mob Crops</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Zombie</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Skeleton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Creeper</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Spider</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are tier 3. </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Blaze</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Ghast</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#7FE6EE to=#2FBAC7 f=0.8>Enderman</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are tier 4. </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is tier 5.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>This is the good half. Gunpowder, bones, string, blaze rods, ender pearls and ghast tears, all growing in a field where nothing can hit you.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> is the one worth the climb. Eight of it makes a skull, and three skulls is a wither.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Creeper Essence and Skeleton Essence together make a Blank Record. Grow your own music discs.
<typewriter><grad from=#F0A94A to=#F0A94A>Farming zombies</grad>
Any Hostile Mob Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0A94A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Hostile Mob Crops</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soulium Ore</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Each block in a soulstone cluster has a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>5 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance of being Soulium Ore instead. On a 64 block cluster that averages about three.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It drops </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1 to 3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Soulium Dust and Fortune applies. Smelting the ore gives one dust, so always break it instead.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Silk touch the ore and Fortune it later if you are short. Otherwise just strip the whole cluster, the soulstone is worth taking anyway.
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Five percent of a big rock</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soulium Ore</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Machine Upgrades</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>An </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Upgrade Base</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> wrapped in a tier's essence and ingots, then wrapped again for the next tier. Five crafts to reach the top.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Operation time drops to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.833</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.625</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.4</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.125</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> then </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>0.025</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> of base. A Tertium upgrade turns the Reprocessor's 200 ticks into 80.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>They also multiply fuel use by </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> to </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>48</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, so a faster machine eats a lot more coal. Fuel capacity goes up alongside it.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>The Reprocessor, Soul Extractor, Soulium Spawner and Harvester all take one. There is a sixth tier above Supremium, made at the Awakening Altar.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Side slot goes brr</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Machine Upgrades</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Harvester</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Iron, </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Ingots</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, a </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>Machine Frame</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and two diamond hoes.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It cuts every fully grown crop in range and replants it in the same tick. Base range is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>3x3</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and a machine upgrade adds one block a tier, so an Awakened one covers </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>15x15</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>100 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> an operation at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>40</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> fuel a tick, and it scans for a target between harvests for a quarter of that.</grad></shadow>
[!success] It takes the full drop table, so the second essence, the second seed and the Fertilized Essence all still roll. There is no automation penalty.
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Touch grass elsewhere</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Harvester</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soulium Spawner</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eats mob essence and spawns the real mob in a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>7x7</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> area around itself.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>16</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Zombie Essence for a zombie, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>32</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Wither Skeleton Essence for a wither skeleton. Nineteen recipes, one per mob crop you can grow.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A zombie spawn even rolls a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1 in 20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance of a zombie villager, which is a curing farm with no cave diving.</grad></shadow>
[!info] This is how a mob crop becomes a mob again. Grow the essence, spawn the mob, kill it for the drops the crop cannot give you.
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Legal spawner</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soulium Spawner</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#5FBF3A to=#A8E86B f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Seed Reprocessor</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Puts a seed back into </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>two</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence of its crop.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Crops drop a spare seed at the same </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 to 20 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance as the spare essence, so a farm that stops expanding is quietly piling up seeds it will never plant. This turns that pile back into product.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>200 ticks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> an operation at </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>20</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> fuel a tick, and it takes a machine upgrade to speed up.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#8CE05A to=#8CE05A>Undo button</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#8CE05A to=#D6FF9E f=0.6>Seed Reprocessor</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Inferium Farmland</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Right click farmland with an essence to convert it. One essence, one block, and it never wears out.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Standing on </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>any</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence farmland gives a crop a </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> chance of a second essence and a second seed. Standing on the farmland that matches its own </grad><grad from=#9BE65C to=#57C42E f=0.8>tier</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> adds another </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>So the ceiling is </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1.2</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> essence a harvest, and you only get there by matching the tier.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>Wet dirt, upgraded</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>Inferium Farmland</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FC8D4 to=#A8EFF5 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Imperium Growth Accelerator</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>48</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> blocks up. At this point a single column of crops on a tower of accelerators grows faster than you can harvest it by hand.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#4FD6E2>Tower of power</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#BFF4F8 f=0.6>Imperium Growth Accelerator</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Awakened Supremium</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Supremium Block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> in the altar, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>four Cognizant Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on the pedestals, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>10</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> each of air, earth, water and fire in the vessels.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Out comes an </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Awakened Supremium Block</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, which breaks into nine </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Awakened Supremium Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. From there it is ingots and gemstones the same way every other tier works.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>There is no crystal route to this tier and no way back down. The altar is the only door.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Tier six unlocked</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Awakened Supremium</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soulium Seed Base</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Prosperity Seed Base</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and two </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, shapeless.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Mob crops use this instead of the plain base. Four filled </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soul Jars</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> plus four essence of the crop's tier on the pedestals, this in the middle.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] The jars are consumed. Four full jars for one seed, and a full Zombie jar is ten kills.
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Blank, but haunted</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soulium Seed Base</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E8C84A to=#FFF0A8 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Four Elements</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Air</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Earth</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Water</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Fire</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> are their own tier, and it is the cheapest one in the mod. Their seeds want four </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, same as tier 1, and they grow on </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium Farmland</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The material is an </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>agglomeratio</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, a four item square of gravel, dirt, clay and one thing that names the element. A glass bottle for air, grass for earth, a water bucket for water, a lava bucket for fire.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Their essence does exactly one thing. It fills the </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Essence Vessels</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> on an Awakening Altar, and nothing else in the mod touches it.</grad></shadow>
[!tip] Plant all four early and let them pile up. Awakening a single block wants 10 of each, and the awakened furnace and watering can want 40 of each.
<typewriter><grad from=#F0D45A to=#F0D45A>Air, earth, water, fire</grad>
Any Elemental Seed
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0D45A to=#FFF6C4 f=0.6>The Four Elements</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E09A3A to=#FFD08A f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tertium Essence</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Sixteen </grad><grad from=#FFE98A to=#FFC93B f=0.8>Inferium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> deep. This is where the ladder starts to hurt and where the good crops begin.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Copper</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Obsidian</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Certus Quartz</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> all sit on this tier, so a Tertium supply is what turns the farm from a curiosity into a supply line.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F0A94A to=#F0A94A>Sixteen deep</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F0A94A to=#FFE0AC f=0.6>Tertium Essence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#3FC8D4 to=#A8EFF5 f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Imperium Farmland</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The tier with the most crops on it, so this is the farmland you will lay the most of.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Farmland never converts back and never gets trampled, so lay it once and forget it.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#4FD6E2>Lay it once</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#4FD6E2 to=#BFF4F8 f=0.6>Imperium Farmland</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Supremium Essence</shadow></grad>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>1024</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> Inferium. Read that again.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Supremium buys the last farmland, the last accelerator, the fastest furnace and the </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Master Infusion Crystal</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. There is one tier above it, and it is not made with a crystal.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Tier 5 crops are </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Diamond</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Emerald</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Netherite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Enderium</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Uraninite</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Niotic</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Spirited</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!warn] A tier 5 seed is four of the material plus four Supremium. That is 4096 Inferium for one seed. Automate the ladder before you try.
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>1024 inferium ahh essence</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Supremium Essence</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#9A6BE0 to=#CDB0FF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Soulium Ingot</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>A </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>Prosperity Ingot</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and two </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulium Dust</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, shapeless.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>It builds the dagger, the jar, the Enchanter, the Experience Capsule and every machine in this mod. This is the material the second half of the chapter runs on.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>There is no Soulium crop until tier 4, and even then it needs Soulium Dust as the material, so the Nether trip is not optional.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#A97FFF to=#A97FFF>Purple iron</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#A97FFF to=#DCC8FF f=0.6>Soulium Ingot</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E04B4B to=#FF9E9E f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Witherproof Block</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Four </grad><grad from=#FF8A8A to=#FF4141 f=0.8>Wither Skeleton Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> around a </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soulstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. The wither cannot break it, and there is a glass version made with </grad><grad from=#C9A6FF to=#8A5CFF f=0.8>Soul Glass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Grow the essence, spawn the skeletons, build the box, then fight the thing inside a room it cannot chew through.</grad></shadow>
<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#A0A0A0 to=#606060>Eight Wither Skeleton Essence also makes a skull, so the whole wither fight becomes a farming problem.</grad></shadow>
<typewriter><grad from=#F05A5A to=#F05A5A>Wither cant read</grad>
<shadow a=0.4><grad from=#F05A5A to=#FFC0C0 f=0.6>Witherproof Block</grad></shadow>
## <grad from=#E09A3A to=#FFD08A f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Tier 3 Seeds</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Twenty two crops, and this is the tier that pays for itself. </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Iron</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Copper</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Glowstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Obsidian</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Certus Quartz</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Tin</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Zinc</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Brass</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Lead</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> and </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Silver</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Eight </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Iron Essence</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>six</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ingots. Eight </grad><grad from=#FFC463 to=#FF9A2E f=0.8>Obsidian</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> makes eight blocks and you never dig another lava pool for them.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Eight Certus Quartz Essence also presses into an Inscriber Press. Silicon, Logic, Calculation or Engineering, your pick. Those normally only come out of a meteorite.
<typewriter><grad from=#F0A94A to=#F0A94A>Iron age skipped</grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>80</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> ticks an item, </grad><grad from=#FFD98A to=#FFB347 f=0.8>41 percent</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> less fuel per item. Two and a half times a vanilla furnace on speed.</grad></shadow>

[gap=5]
## <grad from=#7BC96F to=#C8ECBF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>The Catalyst</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Drop a </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Transmutation‌ Catalyst</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> or a </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Crumbling‌ Catalyst</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> into the‌ item‌ port‌ and leave it‌ there. It‌ is </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>never consumed</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>. It‌ only‌ picks‌ which recipes‌ the Font will‌ run.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Both fit‌ at once. Only‌ one‌ input‌ is claimed‌ by both: soul‌ soil gives ghast‌ tears with‌ one and soul sand with‌ the other, so‌ load a single‌ catalyst‌ when you‌ care‌ which.</grad></shadow>
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#7BC96F to=#C8ECBF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Feed</shadow></grad>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>One item into the </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Item‌ Port</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, six‌ slots each way</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7></grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>5000‌ FE</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> per‌ craft</grad></shadow>
[gap=3]

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The‌ Natural Altar, plus‌ the‌ part where </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>you stand next‌ to‌ it for three‌ minutes</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
- <shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Aura‌ is not‌ piped‌ in. It is </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>paid in‌ time</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7> instead.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>The altar can only‌ pull‌ three hundred aura‌ a tick‌ out of‌ the‌ world, so‌ the Font‌ runs‌ every recipe at that‌ rate. Gold powder‌ is‌ one second. Infused‌ Rock is‌ two. The‌ heaviest‌ conversions in‌ the book are over‌ three‌ minutes.</grad></shadow>
[!success] Nothing here drains‌ the aura‌ in your‌ chunks. The‌ clock‌ is the cost.
[!note] Look‌ the‌ controller up‌ in‌ JEI‌ for the‌ full list.
[gap=5]
[gap=5]
## <grad from=#7BC96F to=#C8ECBF f=0.6><shadow a=0.3>Build</shadow></grad>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>Base‌ of </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Infused‌ Brick</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, three by‌ three. Four‌ of those tiles‌ are the controller and‌ its‌ ports.</grad></shadow>

<shadow a=0.3><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>On top, corners are </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Golden‌ Stone Bricks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, edges‌ are </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Ancient Planks</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>, and‌ the‌ middle‌ is a‌ real </grad><grad from=#8FE07A to=#3F9E2C f=0.8>Natural‌ Altar</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7>.</grad></shadow>
[!info] You need a working‌ altar to‌ build‌ this. Golden Stone‌ Bricks come‌ off‌ the‌ altar too, so‌ there is no way‌ round‌ it.

ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest12C552C76EC: Ender‌ Cells‌ are the highlight‌ of this‌ mod, alongside Ender‌ Gates.
Store‌ energy‌ inside and use‌ it‌ wirelessly using‌ ender‌ gates, anywhere!
Capacity‌ is increased‌ by adding Batteries‌ which get‌ consumed.
Make sure‌ that‌ power‌ is being‌ stored inside‌ the right channel, and‌ that the‌ gates are set to the‌ right channel‌ as well.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest16A4C7E5276: The solar panel is the‌ lowest energy‌ generator alongside the‌ thermo‌ generator, but its‌ pretty‌ simple to set up. Place‌ the‌ panel in an‌ open‌ space‌ and it‌ will‌ generate power as‌ long as its day‌ and‌ its not obstructed‌ by any‌ block.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest1E62C8701AB: The‌ energizing‌ rod is used‌ to power‌ the orb‌ by‌ being‌ placed near‌ it, and‌ you can also use‌ multiple of‌ them. It‌ requires a‌ power source‌ so‌ make‌ sure its‌ connected to a power‌ generation‌ system.
I recommend making‌ at least‌ 2-3 for‌ faster‌ crafting‌ speed.
You can use‌ the‌ wrench to‌ configure‌ the‌ rod to‌ power a specific‌ orb if‌ there are‌ multiple‌ ones‌ next to‌ each other.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest1F1D7F220D1: The‌ Binding‌ Card can‌ be‌ binded‌ to a‌ player by right-clicking‌ with it‌ in your‌ hand. This‌ can‌ be placed‌ in the‌ Player Transmitter to‌ power any‌ item or equipment in your‌ inventory, as long‌ as you are‌ in‌ the same‌ dimension‌ as the transmitter.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest291E9301F3E: The‌ power of thunder, in your‌ hands.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest31E9AE81FB8: The‌ Player‌ Transmitter is‌ used‌ to charge the player's‌ equipment‌ and items wirelessly. This‌ can‌ be‌ done by‌ connecting‌ the transmitter to‌ a power source, and putting‌ a‌ Binding Card inside‌ it.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest3A313AF01E7: The‌ magmator generates‌ power using‌ lava. Make‌ sure‌ you have‌ a stable supply.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest4161BC5BBC9: The Reactor‌ is‌ a‌ multiblock and‌ the‌ best power generator that‌ this mod‌ has‌ to offer. You‌ will require‌ 36‌ reactor‌ blocks to‌ build it, and this is‌ automatic. Place‌ one block where‌ you want‌ it to‌ be‌ built, then‌ right click it‌ with‌ the blocks‌ in‌ your‌ main hand. This‌ will build the‌ multiblock in‌ a 3x4‌ area, so‌ make‌ sure its‌ clear.

The fuel‌ used to power‌ the reactor‌ is Uraninite, and nothing else. The reactor‌ can also‌ be augmented using‌ redstone‌ and coal‌ in‌ their designated slots. Doing this‌ will‌ make the heat‌ rise, which‌ will‌ increase the‌ fuel‌ consumption, alonside power generation. To‌ cool it down you‌ will‌ require a coolant, which‌ can be‌ liquid or‌ solid. This‌ means‌ ice blocks‌ and/or‌ a water source. For specific‌ values and‌ more‌ information check‌ the &nManual&r.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest45A3458B67A: Used‌ to‌ pick up, config‌ and rotate‌ Powah‌ blocks‌ and cables.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest4694C207FEE: The Manual has‌ all‌ of the‌ information‌ you‌ need about‌ the blocks and‌ items of‌ this mod, so‌ if‌ you‌ ever need‌ a quick‌ look at what‌ something does‌ or its stats, check it!
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest486EE3BEE91: The thermo‌ generator‌ is a pretty‌ interesting one. It‌ requires water‌ input‌ to‌ cool down and‌ function, as‌ well as‌ a‌ heat‌ source under‌ it. This can be‌ a magma‌ block or‌ lava. Electricity‌ output‌ depends on‌ the heat‌ source used, lava being‌ the highest‌ one.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest4C9BB0FA98D: The‌ Energy‌ Discharger‌ is used‌ to drain the‌ power from‌ items put‌ inside‌ it‌ and store‌ it in‌ an internal buffer, which‌ then can‌ be transferred or stored. This works‌ only with‌ Batteries or Cells.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest4DB10CDB42E: Just‌ energy cables. Configurable‌ using‌ the &nWrench&r.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest4ECA971BF00: Using the‌ newly created‌ dielectric‌ paste‌ and quite‌ a‌ bit of iron, we can‌ finally make‌ the‌ first materials‌ required to‌ get‌ into‌ this mod.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest505A752D6BA: The first‌ step in‌ creating your first &ePowah &fgenerator‌ is‌ making some &ndielectric‌ paste&r. This‌ does require you to‌ get‌ to the nether, so‌ put‌ your‌ fireproof pants‌ on‌ and go slaying!
Dielectric‌ paste will also be‌ required‌ in almost all‌ recipes, so make‌ sure you‌ stock‌ well‌ on this.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest545200654EF: The‌ furnator‌ uses fuel like coal‌ to generate‌ power.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest57122BCD68F: The‌ Energy Hopper‌ can charge‌ all‌ the‌ items in‌ the chest or block‌ with‌ an inventory that‌ its connected‌ to, when supplied‌ with‌ power. This‌ works only on‌ Batteries‌ or Cells.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest5A2DDE5D50D: &ePowah&r‌ is a‌ mod that adds‌ high &benergy &fgeneration options, including‌ a multiblock, as well as a‌ wireless way‌ to transport said‌ energy. Yes, thats‌ right, &lwireless transfer &rof‌ energy‌ which does not have‌ a‌ range limit at‌ all!
It‌ also‌ introduces a‌ way‌ to wirelessly charge‌ all your equipment and‌ items, even‌ across dimensions, for as‌ long as‌ your power‌ source‌ does‌ not run‌ out.
This‌ questline will guide you‌ through all‌ you‌ need to‌ know about‌ this‌ mod, so‌ make sure‌ you check it regularly.
&8This‌ questline‌ was made by &e@cristoic&r &8in‌ our discord‌ server, thanks for‌ his‌ amazing‌ work!
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest6413B1F6B45: This is‌ the "crafting‌ bench" you will‌ use‌ to progress through this‌ mod. Be‌ warned, higher tier materials‌ will‌ require‌ more power‌ to‌ craft, which can get‌ very high very fast. Check‌ JEI‌ or manual for‌ values.
You can‌ automate the‌ orb, although‌ it‌ can be‌ a‌ bit tricky. For an in-depth‌ tutorial check‌ the‌ links below.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest6EAAE060256: By using‌ a‌ photoelectric pane on‌ an‌ enderman‌ or endermite, you‌ can‌ obtain the Lens‌ of Ender. This can be‌ used‌ on a solar‌ panel to‌ make it‌ generate‌ power‌ even through‌ blocks.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest7750A55ECB0: Can‌ store and carry‌ energy, which will‌ charge equipment and items as‌ long as‌ its in your‌ inventory. When‌ added to‌ an‌ Ender Cell it will‌ get‌ consumed and increase‌ the‌ cell's‌ capacity. Any power‌ stored‌ in the battery‌ will get added to‌ the‌ network once consumed.
Be‌ careful which‌ channel you‌ add‌ the‌ Batteries to‌ in‌ the Ender Cell. This action‌ cannot be‌ reversed.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest7AA9032ACFD: The‌ Ender Gates‌ transfer power from the‌ Ender‌ Cell network. Wirelessly! Just stick‌ them to‌ the machine‌ or‌ cable‌ you want to‌ power‌ and make‌ sure‌ its‌ set to‌ the right channel. Don't‌ forget you‌ need power‌ inside‌ the‌ Ender Cell‌ to be‌ able to transfer‌ it ;). Higher tiers‌ transfer power faster.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest7B0A4FE2724: The‌ Dimensional Binding Card allows‌ charging‌ across dimensions. Obtained by‌ right-clicking an‌ Enderman or‌ Endermite‌ with‌ a binding card.
