ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest13: Infuses‌ nutrients‌ and light‌ into plants using‌ Redstone Flux.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest14: Spreads‌ potions within the‌ nearby area.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest17: Generates‌ Redstone‌ Flux using‌ extremely‌ hot fluids.
Increases the strength of an‌ applied potion.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest19: Seperates‌ items‌ into‌ their components, some‌ items will‌ procress into a‌ fluid component.
55%% Plasma, 1%% Platelets‌ and 45%% Red blood cells.
The‌ Redstone Flux‌ Cell and Fluxducts are‌ an‌ easy low cost‌ early game‌ method of‌ power‌ storage‌ and transportation!
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest1B: Infuses nearby Phyto-Soil‌ with Redstone‌ Flux.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest1C: Generates Redstone‌ Flux using‌ economic‌ arbitrage.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest28: Smelts‌ metals‌ and‌ things that require‌ high‌ temperatures.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest2B: Increases‌ production‌ speed‌ at the‌ cost of more‌ energy.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest32: Turns solid‌ materials into‌ fluids, at high heat. Very‌ useful‌ for advanced‌ blocks!
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest34: These Machines are‌ a little bit more‌ basic‌ than the other‌ ones but‌ they still‌ can‌ be‌ very useful!
Low‌ cost‌ ingot used‌ in many‌ crafts.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest35: Collects experience‌ from‌ nearby blocks which‌ have‌ produced‌ it.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest38: The Fluid‌ Cell‌ and fluiducts‌ are‌ an‌ easy low‌ cost early game‌ method of‌ fluid storage‌ and‌ transportation!
Classic‌ upgrades, makes everything‌ just better.
&8You‌ know, back in my‌ day we‌ didn't have these upgrades, we had‌ Upgrade Kits‌ and they actually‌ changed‌ the machine‌ texture!
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest3B: strengthen or support (an‌ object‌ or substance), especially with‌ additional‌ material.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest3C: Gems are‌ really‌ just pretty rocks‌ anyways
Captures‌ assorted aquatic life. Use bait‌ to‌ boost production and‌ adjust what‌ is caught.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest3E: The‌ Thermal Series‌ is a set‌ of mods‌ that add cool little machines‌ to minecraft.
&8Questline‌ was made by &eSoot (@sootyboy)&r &8in‌ Linggango‌ discord server.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest3F: Balanced, as all things‌ should‌ be.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest40: Alloy‌ made from‌ Redstone, Silver‌ and‌ Copper.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest42: Generates Redstone Flux‌ using‌ combustible fluids.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest49: Alloy made of‌ Lead, Diamond and‌ Ender Pearls. Doesn't‌ sound‌ very‌ healthy to eat‌ does‌ it?
Brews potions and‌ imbues fluids. You‌ might‌ want a‌ few of‌ these‌ in‌ a row.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest4E: Generates Redstone‌ Flux‌ using enchanted items.
Pay up, you‌ owe us‌ some‌ enchantments.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest51: Improves‌ your machines even‌ more further!
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest53: Why wait millions‌ of‌ years for‌ stone‌ to naturally form?
Squeezes and‌ deforms items. Can‌ use a‌ manufacturing‌ die‌ to determine‌ the‌ output.
UPS with my manga‌ be like
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest54: Refines‌ various‌ fluids‌ into other‌ products. Some fluids will‌ leave behind‌ a solid‌ component.
Products‌ may‌ or may‌ not be‌ drinkable
Electrum‌ was‌ often referred‌ to as "white gold" in ancient‌ times.
Extracts fluids‌ from‌ adjacent trees. Use‌ fertlizer to‌ boost‌ production.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest56: Prevents‌ RF‌ from being‌ lost after‌ coil saturation.
ftbquests.chapter.thermal_series.quest57: Produces‌ compost from organic‌ waste‌ in bulk.
When‌ you‌ no‌ no wanna‌ wait

<shadow><grad from=#C0C0C0 to=#5A5A5A f=0.3>Chains‌ connect blocks‌ together when a‌ piston moves‌ them.</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#8B4513 to=#CD853F f=0.6>More Wood With Careful Chopping</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#FFA333 to=#FCDFB8 f=0.8>Linggango</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> features‌ numerous </grad><grad from=#FFD700 to=#FFFF99 f=0.5>hidden mechanics</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> and </grad><grad from=#FFD700 to=#FFFF99 f=0.5>mechanics</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> that‌ you might easily‌ overlook during‌ normal </grad><grad from=#42FF42 to=#BAFFBA f=0.8>gameplay</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>This </grad><grad from=#FFD700 to=#FFFF99 f=0.5>questline</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> is dedicated to teaching you‌ essential </grad><grad from=#FFA333 to=#FCDFB8 f=0.8>Quality of‌ Life</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> (</grad><grad from=#FFA333 to=#FCDFB8 f=0.8>QoL</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>) tips to make‌ your‌ overall experience </grad><wave a=0.3 f=0.5 w=0.5><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>smoother</grad></wave><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>.</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#FFD700 to=#5A4200 f=0.3>Pistons are allowed to move‌ Tile Entities (blocks‌ with extra data‌ attached, like‌ Chests or‌ Furnaces).</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#4FD5BD to=#9EF9E8 f=0.25>Learn how‌ to‌ use‌ a hoe‌ better.</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>-Activate with </grad><grad from=#FF4D4D to=#FFD9D9 f=0.8>redstone</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> to‌ boost </grad><grad from=#FFA333 to=#FCDFB8 f=0.8>smelting‌ speed</grad></shadow>

The power given‌ depends on the number‌ and‌ type of </grad><grad from=#42FF42 to=#BAFFBA f=0.8>books</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> used.</grad></shadow>
<shadow><grad from=#5FA9C0 to=#D1E8EE f=0.3>Enchanted \&\ normal books‌ can be‌ placed and‌ thus‌ have‌ a block‌ form.</grad></shadow>

<shadow><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>With </grad><grad from=#FFABAB to=#D1C4FF f=0.8>enchantment infuser</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3>, you can choose‌ the </grad><grad from=#5FA9C0 to=#D1E8EE f=0.8>specific‌ enchantment</grad><grad from=#FFFFFF to=#C7C7C7 f=0.3> you want on‌ your tool.</grad></shadow>
